sql_infos.sql: SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS avg_standard_value_by_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) DESC) AS compound_rank FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value > 52134.49 AND a2t.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, tc.l1, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 24 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value_by_type DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, d.doc_id, d.year, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) DESC) AS compound_rank FROM assays a JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value >= '1' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '200' GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, d.doc_id, d.year HAVING AVG(cp.alogp) > '-5' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 63 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_mw ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, t.tid, t.pref_name AS target_name, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON a2t.tid = t.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 999424.4 AND 666087.45 AND t.tax_id = 88662.33 AND a2t.confidence >= 7.46 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, t.tid, t.pref_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 339.45 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY act.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 3 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_logp FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE act.standard_value > 658271.15 AND cp.mw_freebase < 932.62 AND cp.hba >= 3 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 74 ORDER BY a.assay_type, moving_avg_activity DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.assay_type IN (SELECT assay_type FROM assay_type WHERE assay_desc LIKE '%cell-based%') AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '500' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-2' AND '2' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0' AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2017 AND 2023 AND at.confidence >= 8 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 46 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '100' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 610;

SELECT a.assay_id, td.pref_name, cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_id, cp.molregno) AS avg_activity_per_assay_compound, COUNT(act.activity_id) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_id) AS activity_count_per_assay, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cp.alogp DESC) AS alogp_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.target_type ORDER BY cp.hba DESC) AS hba_rank_per_target_type FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -1.56 AND 0.2 AND cp.hba >= 13 AND d.year::integer >= 2013 AND a2t.confidence = 7 GROUP BY a.assay_id, td.pref_name, td.target_type, cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, act.standard_value, act.activity_id HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) > 30490.32 ORDER BY avg_activity_per_assay_compound DESC, alogp_rank LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE a.standard_value > 44964.6 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 495.72 AND 838.85 AND a.assay_id IN ( SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE doc_id = 58639 ) GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 9 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.published_value) AS min_published_value, MAX(ac.published_value) AS max_published_value FROM compounds c JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.published_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_value > 19843.72 AND d.year::integer >= 2011 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 2 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS synonyms_list, AVG(act.published_value) AS avg_published_value, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS target_count, MAX(tc.l3) AS top_target_class, AVG(a2t.confidence) AS avg_confidence, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS doc_count, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MAX(v.creation_date)) AS latest_version_year FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN version v ON v.creation_date > '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type LEFT JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND a2t.confidence >= 6 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2010 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 10 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 82 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 378;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, ', ') AS all_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS distinct_targets, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flagged_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp < '-2' AND act.standard_value BETWEEN '0.1' AND '10000' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2019 AND tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 12 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '1000' ORDER BY distinct_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS num_targets, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v.creation_date) AS data_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM v.creation_date) AS data_month FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN version v ON v.creation_date >= '2010-01-01' WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 343.15 AND 705.58 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -0.2 AND -4.83 AND v.creation_date BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v.creation_date) = 2014.79 AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM v.creation_date) IN (2.36, 2.76) AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY c.molregno, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v.creation_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM v.creation_date) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 8.81 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 6865.08 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_assays DESC LIMIT 90.74;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM compounds c JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 4892.11 AND 4938.7 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 237.14 AND 192.61 AND a.assay_type = 'B' AND act.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, a.assay_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 45.82 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 8511.94 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 21.5;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = c.molregno AND cr.doc_id = 4308 ) AND a.standard_value BETWEEN '0.1' AND '1000' AND cp.hba <= 7 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 4 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description AS assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.protein_accession, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, at2.relationship_type, at2.confidence AS target_confidence, at2.assay_organism, at2.assay_strain, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) AS total_records, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS max_standard_value, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno ) AS synonym_count, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a2.assay_id) FROM activities a2 WHERE a2.molregno = c.molregno AND a2.standard_value <= '0.0' ) AS active_assays_below_threshold FROM compounds c INNER JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno INNER JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno INNER JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id INNER JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id INNER JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid INNER JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid INNER JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at2.confidence = cl.confidence INNER JOIN assay_type aty ON a.assay_type = aty.assay_type INNER JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type LEFT JOIN relationship_type rt ON at2.relationship_type = rt.relationship_type WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN '-10.0' AND '-10.0' AND cp.mw_freebase >= '0.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 3 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2021 AND at2.confidence >= 1 AND td.tax_id = 531181 AND tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.protein_accession, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, at2.relationship_type, at2.confidence, at2.assay_organism, at2.assay_strain HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 999 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.0' ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, total_activities DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY td.organism) AS avg_organism_activity, SUM(ac.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY cp.alogp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_alogp, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms_list, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2 FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '500' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND ac.standard_value >= '0.1' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2016 AND at.confidence >= 5 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, td.organism, tc.l1, td.pref_name, tc.l2, ac.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 3 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < '1000' ORDER BY activity_rank, avg_organism_activity DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE c.molregno IN ( SELECT cr.molregno FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.doc_id = 5073 ) AND cp.hba >= 0 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp HAVING AVG(ac.standard_value) < '0.0' ORDER BY assay_count DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE c.molregno IN ( SELECT cr.molregno FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.doc_id = 4112 ) AND cp.hba >= 6 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS max_standard_value, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT td.pref_name, '; ') AS target_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes_l1, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno) AS ro3_pass_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno LEFT JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id LEFT JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '200' AND cp.alogp >= '-5' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = c.molregno AND cr.doc_id = a.doc_id ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM confidence_lookup cl WHERE cl.confidence = at.confidence AND cl.confidence_summary = 'High' ) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.ro3_pass HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 38 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0' ORDER BY activity_rank, avg_standard_value DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, ', ') AS compound_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, ', ') AS target_classes FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ay.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '200' AND cp.alogp >= '-5' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = c.molregno AND cr.doc_id = ay.doc_id ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM confidence_lookup cl WHERE cl.confidence = at.confidence AND cl.confidence >= 4 ) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 36 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_activity, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_type, ', ') AS assay_types, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT td.pref_name, ', ') AS target_names FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON asy.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON asy.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN '0.1' AND '0.1' AND c.molweight BETWEEN '100' AND '100' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '-5' AND cp.hba >= 10 AND cp.hbd >= 5 AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 37 AND AVG(a.standard_value) <= '0.1' ORDER BY avg_activity ASC, assay_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description AS assay_desc, at.assay_desc AS assay_type_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tt.target_desc, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, cl.confidence_summary, WITH compound_activity_stats AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, a.assay_type) AS assays_per_type, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, td.organism) AS avg_activity_per_organism, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 698254.27 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 726.24 AND 415.05 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -3.18 AND 8.91 AND cp.hba <= 7.46 AND cp.hbd <= 6.61 AND td.tax_id = 9636.91 ) SELECT molregno, assay_type, target_name, target_organism, target_class_l1, target_class_l2, COUNT(DISTINCT assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(standard_value) AS max_activity, AVG(mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(alogp) AS avg_logp, SUM(hba) AS total_hba, SUM(hbd) AS total_hbd, MAX(assays_per_type) AS max_assays_per_type, AVG(avg_activity_per_organism) AS overall_organism_avg FROM compound_activity_stats WHERE activity_rank <= 23.35 GROUP BY molregno, assay_type, target_name, target_organism, target_class_l1, target_class_l2 HAVING AVG(standard_value) BETWEEN 194.0 AND 1995.44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT assay_id) >= 5.39 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC, num_assays DESC LIMIT 545.26;

WITH filtered_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.doc_id FROM activities a WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 23134.71 AND 55349.24 AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' ) SELECT c.molregno, a.assay_id, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(*) AS activity_count, d.year, d.journal, ass.description AS assay_description FROM filtered_activities a JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 963.88 AND 535.56 AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY c.molregno, a.assay_id, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, d.year, d.journal, ass.description HAVING COUNT(*) > 33.46 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 500.89;

a2t_relationship_type, tc.tc_id, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, v.creation_date, v.name AS version_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, '0.0') AS avg_corr_value FROM activities a JOIN assays a_s ON a.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a_s.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a.standard_flag = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id LEFT JOIN relationship_type rt ON a.relation = rt.relationship_type LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON a.standard_type = tp.standard_type AND a.relation = tp.relation AND a.standard_units = tp.standard_units LEFT JOIN target_type tt ON tp.target_type = tt.target_type LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON tp.protein_accession = td.protein_accession LEFT JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id AND td.tid = a2t.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN version v ON td.db_version = v.name WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > '0.0' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '100.0' AND cp.alogp > '-10.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 4 AND OVER (PARTITION BY ra.med_chem_friendly) AS max_violations_by_medchem FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.activity_rank <= 5 AND ra.avg_corr_value IS NOT NULL AND ra.avg_corr_value > '0.0' GROUP BY ra.molregno, ra.compound_name, ra.assay_type, ra.assay_desc, ra.standard_value, ra.standard_type, ra.target_type, ra.pref_name, ra.gene_names, ra.organism, ra.activity_rank, ra.avg_corr_value, WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.published_value, a.standard_flag, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, cs.synonyms, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value ASC, a.published_value ASC ) AS potency_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.molregno, td.tid ORDER BY a.standard_value ASC ) AS target_best_activity, AVG(a.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.molregno ) AS avg_compound_potency, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.molregno, td.organism ) AS activities_per_organism FROM activities a JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value BETWEEN 7241.8 AND 124740.77 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 999.08 AND 1202.21 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 3.07 AND 4.69 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0.25 AND d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL AND td.organism IS NOT NULL AND a2t.confidence >= 7.37 AND CAST(d.year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2016 AND 2013 ), compound_aggregates AS ( SELECT ra.molregno, ra.organism, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_potency, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_potency, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.tid) AS distinct_targets, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.l1, '; ') AS target_classes, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.pref_name, '; ') AS target_names, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.potency_rank = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_potency_counts FROM ranked_activities ra GROUP BY ra.molregno, ra.organism ), target_analysis AS ( SELECT ra.tid, ra.pref_name, ra.organism, ra.l1, ra.l2, ra.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.molregno) AS active_compounds, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS best_potency, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.doc_id) AS supporting_publications, MIN(CAST(ra.year AS INTEGER)) AS earliest_year, MAX(CAST(ra.year AS INTEGER)) AS latest_year FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.target_best_activity = 1 GROUP BY ra.tid, ra.pref_name, ra.organism, ra.l1, ra.l2, ra.l3 ) SELECT ca.molregno, c.molformula, c.canonical_smiles, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, ca.organism, ca.min_potency, ca.max_potency, ca.avg_potency, ca.distinct_assays, ca.distinct_targets, ca.target_classes, ca.target_names, ca.top_potency_counts, ta.pref_name AS most_potent_target, ta.best_potency AS target_best_potency, ta.active_compounds AS target_active_count, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY ca.distinct_targets DESC, ca.top_potency_counts DESC ) AS target_breadth_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.organism ORDER BY ca.min_potency ASC ) AS organism_potency_rank, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.organism, ta.l1 ) AS organism_class_count FROM compound_aggregates ca JOIN compounds c ON ca.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON ca.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN target_analysis ta ON ca.organism = ta.organism AND ca.min_potency = ta.best_potency WHERE ca.distinct_targets >= 2.8 AND ca.distinct_assays >= 4.62 AND ca.top_potency_counts >= 4.5 ORDER BY ca.distinct_targets DESC, ca.min_potency ASC, ca.avg_potency ASC LIMIT 593.91;

SELECT a.assay_id, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS active_compounds FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value <= '0.1' AND a.doc_id IN ( SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) >= 2003 ) AND act.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY a.assay_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 62 ORDER BY active_compounds DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value > '0' AND a.doc_id >= 56078 GROUP BY a.assay_id ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(act.activity_id) AS total_activities FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN '0.0' AND '1000.0' AND cp.mw_freebase > '200.0' AND cp.alogp < '-2.0' GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc HAVING COUNT(act.activity_id) > 456 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '500.0' ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, at.assay_type, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.tid) AS num_targets, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 34114.01 AND a2t.confidence >= 6 AND c.molweight BETWEEN 176.72 AND 994.87 GROUP BY a.assay_id, at.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 25 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 4313.36 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_targets DESC;

SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS active_assays, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency FROM activities a JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN assay_type t ON s.assay_type = t.assay_type WHERE a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value < '0.1' GROUP BY a.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 2 UNION ALL SELECT cr.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS active_assays, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency FROM compound_records cr JOIN activities a ON cr.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id WHERE a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > '1000' AND cr.doc_id = 365 GROUP BY cr.molregno HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < '10000' ORDER BY active_assays DESC, avg_potency DESC;

SELECT a1.assay_id AS assay_id_1, a2.assay_id AS assay_id_2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw FROM activities a JOIN assays a1 ON a.assay_id = a1.assay_id JOIN assays a2 ON a1.doc_id = a2.doc_id AND a1.assay_id < a2.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assay2target at ON a1.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN '0' AND '0' AND cp.mw_freebase > '100' AND td.tax_id = 10051 GROUP BY a1.assay_id, a2.assay_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) > 100 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '10' ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_activity_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '501.0' AND at.confidence >= 8 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 9 AND AVG(cp.mw_freebase) < '600.0' ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_molecular_weight ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, MAX(cp.hba) AS max_hba, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, SUM(CASE WHEN at.assay_type = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS type_b_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '|') AS all_synonyms, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, STDDEV(cp.mw_freebase) AS stddev_mw, CORR(cp.alogp, a.standard_value) AS alogp_value_correlation FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assay2target a2t ON ass.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON td.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession AND a.standard_type = tp.standard_type WHERE cp.num_ro5_violations >= 3 AND a.standard_value BETWEEN 7485.15 AND 573422.65 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2014 AND a2t.confidence >= 0 AND cp.mw_freebase > 828.4 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < 908.28 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 1 AND SUM(CASE WHEN at.assay_type = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 8 ORDER BY total_activities DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM compounds c JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE c.molregno IN ( SELECT DISTINCT molregno FROM compound_properties WHERE mw_freebase BETWEEN 867.62 AND 821.2 AND alogp BETWEEN -0.72 AND 2.05 ) AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 40.37 AND AVG(act.standard_value) <= 6068.81 ORDER BY avg_activity ASC, num_assays DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c LEFT JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE a.standard_value IS NULL OR (a.standard_value >= 193726.03 AND a.standard_value <= 163085.44) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) < 40.01 OR COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) IS NULL ORDER BY c.molregno LIMIT 88.67;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = c.molregno AND cr.doc_id = 325283 ) AND cp.hba >= 1 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY avg_potency ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND d.year::integer >= 2014 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno ) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < '1' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY td.organism) AS avg_organism_activity, SUM(ac.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY cp.alogp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_alogp, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms_list, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2 FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '500' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND ac.standard_value >= '0.1' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2011 AND at.confidence >= 5 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, td.organism, tc.l1, td.pref_name, tc.l2, ac.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 9 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < '1000' ORDER BY activity_rank, avg_organism_activity DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal, v.creation_date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v.creation_date) AS creation_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM v.creation_date) AS creation_month, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, a.assay_type) AS avg_activity_by_compound_assay, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS cumulative_active_compounds FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN version v ON v.creation_date >= '2010-01-01' WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 177.36 AND 980.59 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 4.08 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2010 AND 2011 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v.creation_date) > 2019 AND v.creation_date <= '2021-01-01' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal, v.creation_date, act.standard_flag, td.tid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 5 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 65.41 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_activity_by_compound_assay ASC, v.creation_date DESC LIMIT 814;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, CASE WHEN cp.num_ro5_violations = 0 AND cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' AND cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 'High' WHEN cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 AND cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS compound_quality, CASE WHEN cl.confidence = 9 THEN 'Definitive' WHEN cl.confidence = 8 THEN 'High' WHEN cl.confidence = 7 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS target_confidence FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0.1' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND td.tax_id = 9924 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 11 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '0.0' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0.0' AND at.confidence >= 1 AND td.tax_id = 9786 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 31 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '100.0' ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, assay_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(act.published_value) AS max_published_value, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno AND cs.synonyms IS NOT NULL) AS synonym_count, (SELECT MAX(d.year) FROM docs d WHERE d.doc_id = a.doc_id AND d.year ~ '^[0-9]{4}$') AS latest_year FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '5.0' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a2t.confidence >= 6 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_synonyms cs2 WHERE cs2.molregno = c.molregno) > 4 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, a.doc_id HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 32 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 870;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity_value, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE c.molregno IN ( SELECT cr.molregno FROM compound_records cr JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.year::integer BETWEEN 2000 AND 2008 ) AND cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-2' AND '-2' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY avg_activity_value ASC LIMIT 50;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c LEFT JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno LEFT JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value > 467990.98 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 576.62 AND 589.37 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < 75862.73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 8 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, tc.l1 AS target_class FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON (SELECT confidence FROM assay2target WHERE assay_id = a.assay_id ORDER BY confidence DESC LIMIT 1) = cl.confidence JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE act.standard_value >= 34814.38 AND act.standard_value <= 72192.9 AND cp.alogp >= 5.84 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno) > 15 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, tc.l1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 8 ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC;

SELECT td.pref_name, td.organism, a.assay_type, cl.l1, cl.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN target_class cl ON td.tid = cl.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.year::integer BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY td.pref_name, td.organism, a.assay_type, cl.l1, cl.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 5 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value;

SELECT td.pref_name, td.organism, a.assay_type, cl.l1, cl.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN target_class cl ON td.tid = cl.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.year::integer BETWEEN 2018 AND 2023 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY td.pref_name, td.organism, a.assay_type, cl.l1, cl.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 48 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, a2t.relationship_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON ac.molregno = cr.molregno AND ac.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE ac.standard_value BETWEEN 1075.32 AND 2314.12 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 625.59 AND 221.2 AND td.tax_id = 9848.82 AND a2t.confidence = 6.61 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, a2t.relationship_type), (td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4), (td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3), (td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2), (td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1), (td.tid, td.pref_name), (td.tid), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 60.56 ORDER BY td.tid, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, a2t.relationship_type;

WITH assay_aggregates AS ( SELECT a.assay_id, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_measurements FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 0 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 GROUP BY a.assay_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 8 ), compound_property_analysis AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, c.molweight, COUNT(DISTINCT act.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY act.standard_value) AS median_activity FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assay_aggregates aa ON act.assay_id = aa.assay_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '1000.0' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '0.0' AND (cp.hba <= 3 OR cp.hbd <= 2) AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 0 AND aa.avg_potency < '0.1' GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, c.molweight ), target_classification_analysis AS ( SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_activities FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_property_analysis cpa ON act.molregno = cpa.molregno WHERE td.tax_id IS NOT NULL AND td.organism NOT IN ('Unknown', 'N/A') AND tc.l1 IS NOT NULL AND (a2t.confidence >= 4 OR a2t.relationship_type = 'D') AND act.standard_value BETWEEN '0.1' AND '1000.0' GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 22 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ), document_analysis AS ( SELECT d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.molregno) AS compound_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency FROM docs d JOIN assays a ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id AND cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN compound_property_analysis cpa ON cr.molregno = cpa.molregno JOIN target_classification_analysis tca ON a.assay_id IN ( SELECT a2t.assay_id FROM assay2target a2t WHERE a2t.tid = tca.tid ) WHERE d.year >= '2000' AND d.journal IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 0 AND cpa.assay_count >= 6 GROUP BY d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 7 AND AVG(act.standard_value) BETWEEN '0.1' AND '1000.0' ) SELECT tca.tid, tca.pref_name AS target_name, tca.organism AS target_organism, tca.l1 AS target_class_level1, tca.l2 AS target_class_level2, COUNT(DISTINCT cpa.molregno) AS total_compounds, AVG(cpa.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(cpa.alogp) AS avg_logp, SUM(cpa.num_ro5_violations) AS total_ro5_violations, AVG(cpa.avg_activity) AS avg_compound_potency, MIN(cpa.median_activity) AS min_median_potency, MAX(cpa.assay_count) AS max_assays_per_compound, COUNT(DISTINCT da.doc_id) AS document_count, AVG(da.avg_potency) AS avg_document_potency, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT da.journal, '; ' ORDER BY da.journal) AS journals, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cpa.avg_activity) AS q1_potency, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cpa.avg_activity) AS q3_potency, STDDEV(cpa.avg_activity) AS stddev_potency FROM target_classification_analysis tca JOIN assay2target a2t ON tca.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_property_analysis cpa ON act.molregno = cpa.molregno JOIN document_analysis da ON a.doc_id = da.doc_id WHERE tca.assay_count >= 6 AND tca.compound_count >= 54 AND cpa.assay_count >= 4 AND da.assay_count >= 5 AND (tca.avg_potency < '0.1' OR cpa.avg_activity < '0.1') AND NOT (tca.l1 = 'Enzyme' AND tca.l2 = 'Oxidoreductase') GROUP BY tca.tid, tca.pref_name, tca.organism, tca.l1, tca.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cpa.molregno) >= 10 AND AVG(cpa.avg_activity) BETWEEN '0.1' AND '1000.0' AND SUM(cpa.num_ro5_violations) <= 20 ORDER BY total_compounds DESC, avg_compound_potency ASC LIMIT 338;

WITH assay_stats AS ( SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.doc_id, d.year::INTEGER AS publication_year, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0' AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1927 AND 1996 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.doc_id, d.year::INTEGER ), target_info AS ( SELECT at.assay_id, at.tid, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2 FROM assay2target at JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE at.confidence >= 1 ) SELECT ti.target_name, ti.target_organism, ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2, ast.assay_type, ast.publication_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ast.assay_id) AS num_assays, SUM(ast.unique_compounds) AS total_unique_compounds, AVG(ast.avg_standard_value) AS overall_avg_value, MIN(ast.min_standard_value) AS overall_min_value, MAX(ast.max_standard_value) AS overall_max_value FROM target_info ti JOIN assay_stats ast ON ti.assay_id = ast.assay_id GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ti.target_name, ti.target_organism, ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2, ast.assay_type, ast.publication_year), (ti.target_name, ti.target_organism, ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2), (ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2, ast.assay_type), (ti.target_class_l1, ast.assay_type, ast.publication_year), () ) HAVING SUM(ast.unique_compounds) >= 315 ORDER BY total_unique_compounds DESC, overall_avg_value DESC;

WITH assay_stats AS ( SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency, COUNT(*) AS total_measurements, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) DESC) AS assay_rank FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 874.63 AND a2t.confidence >= 5 AND td.tax_id = 9861 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence ), compound_activity AS ( SELECT c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT ast.assay_id) AS active_assays, AVG(ast.avg_potency) AS avg_potency_across_assays, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ast.assay_id) DESC, AVG(ast.avg_potency) DESC) AS compound_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assay_stats ast ON act.assay_id = ast.assay_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 384.73 AND 738.76 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 GROUP BY c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations ) SELECT ast.assay_type, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, cl.confidence_summary, ast.unique_compounds, ast.avg_potency, ast.min_potency, ast.max_potency, ast.total_measurements, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.molregno) AS ro5_compliant_compounds, AVG(ca.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(ca.alogp) AS avg_logp, ast.assay_rank FROM assay_stats ast JOIN target_dictionary td ON ast.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON ast.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN compound_activity ca ON ca.active_assays > 0 WHERE ast.assay_rank <= 4 AND ast.unique_compounds >= 79 GROUP BY ast.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, cl.confidence_summary, ast.unique_compounds, ast.avg_potency, ast.min_potency, ast.max_potency, ast.total_measurements, ast.assay_rank ORDER BY ast.assay_rank ASC, ast.unique_compounds DESC, ast.avg_potency ASC;

WITH compound_activity_stats AS ( SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_standard_activities FROM activities a WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 13926.91 AND a.standard_units = 'nM' GROUP BY a.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 6 ), compound_props_filtered AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly FROM compound_properties cp WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 171.76 AND 246.99 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -0.36 AND 0.3 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 ) SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cas.num_assays, cas.total_activities, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency, cas.num_standard_activities, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS num_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) AS num_documents FROM compounds c JOIN compound_props_filtered cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_activity_stats cas ON c.molregno = cas.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno WHERE c.molweight IS NOT NULL AND c.molweight BETWEEN 142.67 AND 780.73 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cas.num_assays, cas.total_activities, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency, cas.num_standard_activities HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) >= 12 ORDER BY cas.avg_potency ASC, c.molweight DESC LIMIT 803;

WITH compound_activity_stats AS ( SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_standard_activities FROM activities a WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 82024.93 AND a.standard_units = 'nM' GROUP BY a.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 1 ), compound_props_filtered AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly FROM compound_properties cp WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 356.48 AND 415.72 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 0.29 AND 6.91 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 ) SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cas.num_assays, cas.total_activities, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency, cas.num_standard_activities, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS num_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) AS num_documents FROM compounds c JOIN compound_props_filtered cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_activity_stats cas ON c.molregno = cas.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno WHERE c.molweight IS NOT NULL AND c.molweight BETWEEN 309.63 AND 682.98 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cas.num_assays, cas.total_activities, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency, cas.num_standard_activities HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) >= 20 ORDER BY cas.avg_potency ASC, c.molweight DESC LIMIT 909;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.canonical_smiles, c.molformula, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.standard_value) AS median_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flagged_count, d.year AS latest_assay_year, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '200.0' AND cp.alogp >= '-5.0' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2001 GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.canonical_smiles, c.molformula, d.year, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc ), target_class_analysis AS ( SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.ec_number, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS total_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, STDDEV(a.standard_value) AS stddev_potency, COUNT(DISTINCT cl.confidence) AS confidence_levels, MAX(cl.confidence) AS max_confidence, MIN(a2t.confidence) AS min_assay_confidence FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays ass ON a2t.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE td.tax_id = 9874 AND a2t.confidence >= 2 AND a.standard_value <= '0.0' AND td.in_drugstore = 1 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.ec_number, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 82 ) SELECT 'compound' AS result_type, cas.molregno, cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.assay_count, cas.activity_count, cas.avg_standard_value, cas.median_standard_value, cas.latest_assay_year, cas.assay_type, NULL AS pref_name, NULL AS organism, NULL AS total_assays, NULL AS unique_compounds, NULL AS avg_potency FROM compound_activity_summary cas WHERE cas.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND cas.assay_count >= 3 UNION ALL SELECT 'target' AS result_type, NULL AS molregno, NULL AS mw_freebase, NULL AS alogp, NULL AS assay_count, NULL AS activity_count, NULL AS avg_standard_value, NULL AS median_standard_value, NULL AS latest_assay_year, NULL AS assay_type, tca.pref_name, tca.organism, tca.total_assays, tca.unique_compounds, tca.avg_potency FROM target_class_analysis tca WHERE tca.avg_potency <= '0.0' AND tca.total_assays >= 9 ORDER BY result_type, avg_standard_value DESC NULLS LAST, avg_potency ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 2885;

SELECT a.assay_id, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT act.record_id) AS unique_records, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.tid) AS unique_targets, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid WHERE act.standard_value > '0' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '200' AND td.tax_id = 10001 GROUP BY a.assay_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 80 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS avg_standard_value_by_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) DESC) AS compound_rank FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value > 17761.56 AND a2t.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, tc.l1, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 62 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value_by_type DESC;

SELECT a.assay_type, a.assay_id, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_logp FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE a.assay_id IN ( SELECT a2.assay_id FROM assays a2 JOIN docs d ON a2.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2017 AND 2020 ) AND cp.mw_freebase > '200.0' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-2.0' AND '-2.0' AND a2t.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY a.assay_type, a.assay_id, td.pref_name, tc.l2, cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 24 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.molregno) AS distinct_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT a.doc_id) AS distinct_documents, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target at ON td.tid = at.tid JOIN assays a ON at.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON ac.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN 2.45 AND -1.05 AND cp.mw_freebase >= 361.79 AND ac.standard_value <= 3049.59 AND a.assay_type = 'A' GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.molregno) >= 331 ORDER BY distinct_assays DESC, distinct_compounds DESC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_ro3_pass, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_medchem_friendly FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid AND a2t.confidence > 5 JOIN assays ass ON a2t.assay_id = ass.assay_id AND ass.assay_type = 'B' JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno AND c.molweight > '200' JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 1 JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid AND tc.l1 IS NOT NULL JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id AND d.year::integer > 2011 JOIN compound_records cr ON a.molregno = cr.molregno AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a2t.relationship_type = 'D' AND cp.hba BETWEEN 3 AND 14 AND cp.hbd BETWEEN 0 AND 8 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) > 14 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) >= 31 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_compounds DESC LIMIT 92;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.doc_id, a.activity_id, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, c.inchi_key, cs.synonyms, d.year, d.journal, ass.assay_type, ass.description AS assay_description, cl.confidence_summary, a2t.relationship_type, a2t.confidence AS target_confidence, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank, AVG(a.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.molregno ORDER BY a.activity_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_standard_value FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a.standard_flag = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 709551.28 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 946.29 AND 497.81 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND d.year::integer >= 2007 ) SELECT molregno, assay_id, standard_value, activity_rank, moving_avg_standard_value, mw_freebase, alogp, hba, hbd, psa, num_ro5_violations, ro3_pass, med_chem_friendly, molweight, inchi_key, synonyms, year, journal, assay_type, assay_description, confidence_summary, relationship_type, target_confidence, target_name, target_organism, target_class_l1, target_class_l2 FROM ranked_activities WHERE activity_rank <= 7 ORDER BY molregno, activity_rank;

= s.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON s.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON s.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON s.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN avg_activity_by_type, total_activities, ro5_rank, COUNT(*) AS assay_count, MIN(standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(standard_value) AS max_potency, AVG(standard_value) AS avg_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM ranked_compounds WHERE potency_rank = 1 AND avg_activity_by_type < 6560.42 GROUP BY molregno, pref_name, assay_type, standard_type, potency_rank, avg_activity_by_type, total_activities, ro5_rank HAVING COUNT(*) > 66 AND AVG(standard_value) < HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 47 AND AVG(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) <= 180288.08 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, cp.molregno, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER(PARTITION BY act.molregno, a.assay_type) AS avg_standard_value_per_compound_assay_type, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY act.molregno) AS total_activities_per_compound, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC) AS mw_rank_in_assay_type, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY act.molregno, a.assay_id) AS flagged_activities_per_assay FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON cr.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.assay_type IN ('B', 'F', 'A') AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 6.37 AND 5.24 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 161.44 AND 313.76 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 4.53 AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 2004 AND 2023 AND a2t.confidence >= 3.95 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 430738.96 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, cp.molregno, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_flag, act.molregno, a.assay_id HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) > 311909.25 AND COUNT(*) > 59.53 ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC, avg_standard_value_per_compound_assay_type ASC;
