SELECT a.assay_id, cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a2t.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_desc, d.year, d.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.molregno, a2t.tid) AS avg_standard_value_by_compound_target, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a2t.tid ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank_per_target, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.molregno) AS total_standard_activities_per_compound FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 876543.83 AND 774357.65 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 2.91 AND -7.3 AND cp.hba BETWEEN 17.06 AND 12.27 AND cp.hbd BETWEEN 2.08 AND 14.16 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1.33 AND d.year >= '1900' GROUP BY a.assay_id, cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a2t.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_desc, d.year, d.journal, act.standard_value, act.standard_flag HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 46.71 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 421523.45 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value_by_compound_target ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE a.standard_value > 75339.9 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 222.1 AND 1009.59 AND a.assay_id IN ( SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE doc_id = 66061 ) GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 3 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE ac.standard_value > 288172.59 AND d.year::integer >= 2001 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING AVG(ac.standard_value) < 4011932.27 ORDER BY assay_count DESC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a2t.assay_organism, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_desc, tt.target_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS document_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms_list FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN assays a2 ON a2t.assay_id = a2.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a2.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN activities a ON a2.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase IS NOT NULL AND cp.alogp IS NOT NULL AND d.year >= '2000' AND a.standard_value <= '0.1' AND cp.mw_freebase >= '100' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a2t.assay_organism, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_desc, tt.target_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 76 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT cp.molregno) > 44 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

') AS assay_types FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays ass ON a2t.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities act ON ass.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE td.tax_id = 9703 AND a2t.confidence >= 1 AND act.standard_value BETWEEN 4154.0 AND 18653.83 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, cl.confidence_summary ), ranked_compounds AS ( SELECT cas.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cas.num_ro5_violations ORDER BY cas.avg_activity DESC) AS potency_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cas.assay_count DESC) AS assay_frequency_rank, AVG(cas.molweight) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations = 0 THEN 'Ro5_Compliant' ELSE 'Ro5_Violation' END) AS avg_mw_by_ro5_status, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cas.avg_activity) AS activity_percentile, LAG(cas.avg_activity, 1) OVER (ORDER BY cas.molweight) AS prev_compound_activity FROM compound_activity_summary cas WHERE cas.assay_count >= 46 ) SELECT rc.molregno, rc.molweight, rc.mw_freebase, rc.alogp, rc.hba, rc.hbd, rc.psa, rc.rtb, rc.num_ro5_violations, rc.assay_count, rc.doc_count, rc.avg_activity, rc.min_activity, rc.max_activity, rc.flagged_count, rc.all_synonyms, rc.potency_rank, rc.assay_frequency_rank, rc.avg_mw_by_ro5_status, rc.activity_percentile, rc.prev_compound_activity, ta.tid, ta.pref_name AS target_name, ta.organism AS target_organism, ta.target_type, ta.target_class_level1, ta.target_class_level2, ta.total_assays, ta.unique_compounds, ta.avg_potency AS target_avg_potency, ta.confidence_summary, ta.assay_types, d.year AS publication_year, d.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) AS total_records, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT act.standard_type, '; WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.ro3_pass, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, td.organism, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS rn FROM activities a JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ay.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 34751.34 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 703.64 AND 760.27 ) SELECT ra.assay_type, ra.assay_desc, ra.pref_name AS target_name, ra.organism AS target_organism, ra.confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_potency, AVG(ra.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(ra.alogp) AS avg_logp, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_compliant_count FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.rn = 1 GROUP BY ra.assay_type, ra.assay_desc, ra.pref_name, ra.organism, ra.confidence_summary HAVING AVG(ra.standard_value) < 45779.6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ra.molregno) >= 11 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, unique_compounds DESC;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS rank_by_value FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 87659.94 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 671.13 AND 795.58 ) SELECT ra.molregno, ra.assay_id, ra.standard_value, ra.standard_type, ra.mw_freebase, ra.alogp, ra.hba, ra.hbd, ra.psa, ra.rtb, ra.num_ro5_violations, ra.ro3_pass, ra.med_chem_friendly, ra.rank_by_value, AVG(ra.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY ra.molregno) AS avg_activity_per_compound, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ra.molregno) AS total_activities_per_compound FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.rank_by_value <= 2 ORDER BY ra.molregno, ra.rank_by_value;

tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 427538.99 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, t.tid, t.pref_name AS target_name, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON a2t.tid = t.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 972072.76 AND 813210.14 AND t.tax_id = 91984.64 AND a2t.confidence >= 2.61 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, t.tid, t.pref_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 913.25 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, SUM(cp.mw_freebase) AS total_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT td.pref_name, '; ') AS target_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l2, '; ') AS target_classes, COUNT(DISTINCT at2.tid) AS distinct_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS distinct_docs, MAX(d.year::INTEGER) AS latest_year, MIN(d.year::INTEGER) AS earliest_year FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities a ON cr.record_id = a.record_id AND cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target at2 ON ass.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at2.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id AND a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value >= '0.0' AND cp.mw_freebase <= '100.0' AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2018 AND 1923 AND cp.num_ro5_violations >= 5 AND at2.confidence >= 1 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 8 AND AVG(a.standard_value) BETWEEN '0.0' AND '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT at2.tid) >= 4 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 116;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.doc_id) AS distinct_documents, COUNT(DISTINCT at2.tid) AS distinct_targets, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON ass.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at2.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.alogp >= '-5.0' AND cp.hbd <= 6 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year >= '1990' GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 38 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY distinct_assays DESC, avg_activity ASC;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS distinct_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS distinct_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.tc_id) AS distinct_target_classes, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flagged_activities, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON asy.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON asy.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '300.0' AND cp.alogp >= '0.0' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2009 AND a2t.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 5 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '0.1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) >= 15 ORDER BY distinct_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS unique_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS unique_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS unique_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.l1) AS unique_l1_classes, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_value IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_activities, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp, MAX(cp.num_ro5_violations) AS max_ro5_violations, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities a ON cr.record_id = a.record_id AND cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON ass.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type LEFT JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type LEFT JOIN relationship_type rt ON a2t.relationship_type = rt.relationship_type WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '501.0' AND cp.alogp >= '-5.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2009 AND a2t.confidence >= 1 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) >= 3 AND AVG(cp.mw_freebase) < '800.0' ORDER BY unique_assays DESC, unique_targets DESC LIMIT 90;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, d.year, d.journal, cl.confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '500' AND cp.alogp >= '-5' AND cp.hba <= 10 AND cp.hbd <= 10 AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 2 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2011 AND a2t.confidence >= 7 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, d.year, d.journal, cl.confidence_summary HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 13 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' AND MIN(act.standard_value) >= '0' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS avg_value_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY td.organism ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) DESC) AS org_assay_rank FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0.0' AND d.year >= '1990' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '500.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 AND a2t.confidence >= 0 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 17 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '10000.0' ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, assay_count DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molformula, cs.synonyms, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.published_value) AS min_published_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY AVG(ac.standard_value) DESC) AS assay_rank FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cr.record_id = ac.record_id JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '100.0' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '0.0' AND a2t.confidence >= 2 AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molformula, cs.synonyms, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) > 78 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < '0.0' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) FROM activities a WHERE a.molregno = cp.molregno AND a.standard_value < 27.41) AS high_potency_activities, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = cp.molregno AND cr.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2019)) AS recent_records FROM compound_properties cp WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 757.54 AND 473.21 AND cp.alogp > 2.95 AND cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC, cp.alogp ASC;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a.assay_type, atype.assay_desc, cl.confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_ro3_pass, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_med_chem_friendly, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw_freebase, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp, AVG(cp.psa) AS avg_psa, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS num_documents, MIN(d.year::integer) AS min_year, MAX(d.year::integer) AS max_year FROM target_dictionary t JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type atype ON a.assay_type = atype.assay_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON act.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 46015.62 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 174.85 AND 640.04 AND d.year::integer >= 2010 AND a2t.confidence >= 7 GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a.assay_type, atype.assay_desc, cl.confidence_summary HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 17 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 407.74 ORDER BY num_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.target_type, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight FROM target_dictionary t JOIN assay2target at ON t.tid = at.tid JOIN assays a ON at.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 70439.63 AND 682549.63 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 606.64 AND 174.1 AND a.assay_type IN ('B', 'B') GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tid, t.pref_name, t.target_type, a.assay_type), (t.tid, t.pref_name, t.target_type), (t.tid, t.pref_name), (t.tid), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 2.96 ORDER BY t.tid, assay_count DESC;

SELECT tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, td.organism, a2t.assay_organism, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM target_class tc JOIN target_dictionary td ON tc.tid = td.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 2521.24 AND 5380.05 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 165.27 AND 839.53 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 2.07 AND 6.01 AND td.tax_id = 9781.74 AND a2t.confidence >= 3.55 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2019.65 AND 2004.67 AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_units = 'nM' GROUP BY tc.l1, tc.l2, td.organism, a2t.assay_organism, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < 979.36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) > 54.91 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, unique_compounds DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT td.pref_name AS target_name, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT c.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON ac.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 246.4 AND 556.17 AND (cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 OR cp.ro3_pass = 'Y') AND a.assay_type NOT IN ('{{p4}}', '{{p5}}') AND td.organism = '{{p6}}' GROUP BY td.pref_name, a.assay_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 4 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < 1831.77 ORDER BY avg_activity ASC, assay_count DESC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, AVG(CASE WHEN a.standard_units = 'nM' THEN a.standard_value ELSE NULL END) AS avg_nm_potency, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays ass ON a2t.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 7136.94 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 827.14 AND 1982.17 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 2.65 AND 7.14 AND a2t.confidence >= 0 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.year, 'YYYY')) BETWEEN 2023 AND 2022 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND ass.assay_type = 'B' GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 58 AND AVG(cp.mw_freebase) < 1496.59 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cp.molregno) >= 20 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_nm_potency ASC LIMIT 83;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a2t.confidence > 9 AND a2t.multi = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200.0' AND '501.0' AND td.tax_id = 9819 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_units = 'nM' GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 10 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' UNION ALL SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) AS doc_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, AVG(cp.hba) AS avg_hba, MAX(cp.hbd) AS max_hbd, MIN(cp.psa) AS min_psa FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a2t.confidence <= 2 AND cp.num_ro5_violations = 1 AND cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Yes' AND td.in_drugstore = 1 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2005 AND 2011 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) >= 9 AND AVG(cp.hba) > 1 AND MAX(cp.hbd) < 0 ORDER BY tid, pref_name;

SELECT td1.tid AS tid1, td2.tid AS tid2, td1.organism AS organism1, td2.organism AS organism2, tc1.l2 AS class1_l2, tc2.l2 AS class2_l2, at1.assay_type AS assay_type1, at2.assay_type AS assay_type2, cl1.confidence_summary AS confidence_summary1, cl2.confidence_summary AS confidence_summary2, COUNT(DISTINCT a1.activity_id) AS activity_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT a2.activity_id) AS activity_count2, assays as2 ON atgt2.assay_id = as2.assay_id JOIN activities a1 ON as1.assay_id = a1.assay_id JOIN activities a2 ON as2.assay_id = a2.assay_id JOIN compounds c1 ON a1.molregno = c1.molregno JOIN compounds c2 ON a2.molregno = c2.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp1 ON c1.molregno = cp1.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp2 ON c2.molregno = cp2.molregno JOIN compound_records cr1 ON c1.molregno = cr1.molregno JOIN compound_records cr2 ON c2.molregno = cr2.molregno JOIN docs d1 ON cr1.doc_id = d1.doc_id JOIN docs d2 ON cr2.doc_id = d2.doc_id JOIN target_class tc1 ON td1.tid = tc1.tid JOIN cp2.mw_freebase BETWEEN '0.0' AND '0.0' AND d1.year::INTEGER >= 1915 AND d2.year::INTEGER <= 1956 AND atgt1.confidence >= 2 AND atgt2.confidence <= 10 AND at1.assay_type LIKE 'A' AND at2.assay_type LIKE 'A' GROUP BY td1.tid, td2.tid, td1.organism, td2.organism, tc1.l2, tc2.l2, at1.assay_type, at2.assay_type, cl1.confidence_summary, cl2.confidence_summary HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a1.activity_id) > 206 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a2.activity_id) > 285 AND AVG(cp1.mw_freebase) > '0.0' AND AVG(cp2.mw_freebase) < '0.0' ORDER BY total_standard_value1 DESC, total_standard_value2 ASC LIMIT 694;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS num_targets, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM compound_properties cp INNER JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno INNER JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno INNER JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id INNER JOIN assay2target at ON asy.assay_id = at.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = cp.molregno AND cs.synonyms ILIKE '%' || '' || '%' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM target_class tc WHERE tc.tid = t.tid AND tc.l1 = '' ) AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 423.37 AND 625.99 AND a.standard_value BETWEEN 6539.2 AND 8203.71 GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 44.73 ) SELECT cas.*, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, at2.relationship_type, cl.confidence_summary FROM compound_activity_summary cas INNER JOIN activities a2 ON cas.molregno = a2.molregno INNER JOIN assays asy2 ON a2.assay_id = asy2.assay_id INNER JOIN assay2target at2 ON asy2.assay_id = at2.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid INNER JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at2.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a2.standard_value <= cas.min_potency * 1.1 AND td.organism = '' AND at2.confidence >= 6.82 ORDER BY cas.avg_potency ASC, cas.num_assays DESC LIMIT 144.08;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.doc_id, a.activity_id, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, c.inchi_key, cs.synonyms, d.year, d.journal, ass.assay_type, ass.description AS assay_description, cl.confidence_summary, a2t.relationship_type, a2t.confidence AS target_confidence, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank, AVG(a.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.molregno ORDER BY a.activity_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_standard_value FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a.standard_flag = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 22867.39 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 556.51 AND 749.57 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 AND d.year::integer >= 2000 ) SELECT molregno, assay_id, standard_value, activity_rank, moving_avg_standard_value, mw_freebase, alogp, hba, hbd, psa, num_ro5_violations, ro3_pass, med_chem_friendly, molweight, inchi_key, synonyms, year, journal, assay_type, assay_description, confidence_summary, relationship_type, target_confidence, target_name, target_organism, target_class_l1, target_class_l2 FROM ranked_activities WHERE activity_rank <= 9 ORDER BY molregno, activity_rank;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.relation, a.standard_units, a.standard_type, a.published_value, a.published_units, a.published_activity_type, a.activity_comment, a.doc_id, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, c.molformula, c.inchi_key, cs.synonyms, at.assay_desc, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, td.pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.protein_accession, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS potency_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_id ORDER BY a.published_value DESC) AS assay_activity_rank, AVG(a.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno) AS avg_potency_per_compound, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id) AS activity_count_per_assay FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ay.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.published_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 478.11 AND 412.9 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 1.23 AND 8.12 AND a.standard_value >= 840.15 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2022.39 AND 2020.08 ) SELECT ra.molregno, ra.pref_name AS target_name, ra.target_organism, ra.protein_accession, ra.l1 AS target_class_level1, ra.l2 AS target_class_level2, ra.l3 AS target_class_level3, ra.assay_desc, ra.confidence_summary, ra.potency_rank, ra.assay_activity_rank, ra.avg_potency_per_compound, ra.activity_count_per_assay, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.relation = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_relation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.potency_rank <= 8.92 AND ra.assay_activity_rank <= 8.6 GROUP BY ra.molregno, ra.pref_name, ra.target_organism, ra.protein_accession, ra.l1, ra.l2, ra.l3, ra.assay_desc, ra.confidence_summary, ra.potency_rank, ra.assay_activity_rank, ra.avg_potency_per_compound, ra.activity_count_per_assay HAVING AVG(ra.standard_value) < 182.74 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) >= 5.33 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, distinct_assays DESC LIMIT 70.45;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_units, a.published_value, a.published_activity_type, a.published_units, a.relation, a.activity_comment, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, c.molformula, c.canonical_smiles, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.protein_accession, tt.target_type, tt.target_desc, cl.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.target_classification, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank, AVG(a.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id) AS avg_activity_per_assay, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno) AS total_activities_per_compound FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 748562.29 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 576.26 AND 2744.77 AND cp.alogp >= -3.85 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 3 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2008 AND cl.confidence >= 2 AND a2t.multi = 0 ) SELECT ra.molregno, ra.assay_type, ra.pref_name AS target_name, ra.target_organism, ra.target_classification, ra.confidence_summary, ra.year, ra.journal, ra.total_activities_per_compound, ra.avg_activity_per_assay, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_activity, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_activity, STDDEV(ra.standard_value) AS stddev_activity, COUNT(*) AS num_activities, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.activity_rank = 1 AND ra.standard_value <= 5465779.13 AND ra.hba >= 18 AND ra.hbd <= 8 GROUP BY ra.molregno, ra.assay_type, ra.pref_name, ra.target_organism, ra.target_classification, ra.confidence_summary, ra.year, ra.journal, SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c INNER JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno INNER JOIN activities ac ON cr.record_id = ac.record_id INNER JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN -1.72 AND -4.65 AND cp.hba >= 0.39 AND cp.hbd <= 12.77 AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND (d.year >= '2000' OR d.year IS NULL) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 1.6 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < 1447.3 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, assay_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno AND cs.synonyms IS NOT NULL) AS synonym_count, (SELECT MIN(d.year) FROM docs d WHERE d.doc_id IN (SELECT cr.doc_id FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = c.molregno)) AS earliest_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_class FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value > 5137.62 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1933 AND 1927 AND cl.confidence >= 8 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 89 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 90385.34 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC, rank_by_class LIMIT 85;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS doc_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.organism ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS potency_rank_by_organism FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.alogp > '-5.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 4 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0.0' AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, td.organism HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 16 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '1000.0' ORDER BY potency_rank_by_organism, avg_standard_value DESC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) AS document_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_compliant_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.standard_value) AS median_potency, STDDEV(a.standard_value) AS potency_stddev FROM target_dictionary td INNER JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid INNER JOIN assays asy ON a2t.assay_id = asy.assay_id INNER JOIN activities a ON asy.assay_id = a.assay_id INNER JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno INNER JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON a.molregno = cr.molregno INNER JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id INNER JOIN assay_type at ON asy.assay_type = at.assay_type INNER JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid INNER JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 2704.77 AND 734827.03 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 430.7 AND 826.33 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -3.72 AND 8.45 AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) >= 30 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 7 AND AVG(a.standard_value) <= 436.29 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_potency ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target at ON td.tid = at.tid JOIN assays a ON at.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2019 AND td.tid IN ( SELECT at2.tid FROM assay2target at2 JOIN assays a2 ON at2.assay_id = a2.assay_id JOIN activities act2 ON a2.assay_id = act2.assay_id WHERE act2.standard_value < '1' AND at2.confidence >= 9 ) GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 8 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '50' ORDER BY assay_count DESC, compound_count DESC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target at ON td.tid = at.tid JOIN assays a ON at.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2022 AND td.tid IN ( SELECT at2.tid FROM assay2target at2 JOIN assays a2 ON at2.assay_id = a2.assay_id JOIN activities act2 ON a2.assay_id = act2.assay_id WHERE act2.standard_value < '1' AND at2.confidence >= 9 ) GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 13 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '50' ORDER BY assay_count DESC, compound_count DESC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms_list FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value BETWEEN 34308.62 AND 852821.55 AND a2t.confidence >= 9.62 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 1265.75 AND 454.88 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -4.29 AND -5.71 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = c.molregno AND cr.doc_id = a.doc_id AND cr.compound_name IS NOT NULL ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM docs d WHERE d.doc_id = a.doc_id AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2020.42 AND 1934.23 ) GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 28.03 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 289750.2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 17.8 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ac.standard_value) AS median_standard_value FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON ac.molregno = cr.molregno AND ac.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a2t.confidence >= 9 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '500.0' AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2009 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 7 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < '0.0' AND SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5 ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 83486.01 AND 27364.96 AND cp.mw_freebase > 791.06 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 8.41 AND 6.35 AND a_s.assay_type IN (SELECT assay_type FROM assay_type WHERE assay_desc LIKE '%''%') AND td.tid IN (SELECT tid FROM target_class WHERE l1 = '''' AND l2 IN ('''', '''')) GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 429.69 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 53330.2 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a2t.confidence > 7 AND a2t.multi = 0 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200.0' AND '501.0' AND td.tax_id = 10008 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_units = 'nM' GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 38 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' UNION ALL SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) AS doc_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, AVG(cp.hba) AS avg_hba, MAX(cp.hbd) AS max_hbd, MIN(cp.psa) AS min_psa FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a2t.confidence <= 0 AND cp.num_ro5_violations = 1 AND cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Yes' AND td.in_drugstore = 1 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) >= 3 AND AVG(cp.hba) > 3 AND MAX(cp.hbd) < 5 ORDER BY tid, pref_name;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.ec_number, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS unique_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.record_id) AS filtered_compounds_count, ( SELECT AVG(cp2.mw_freebase) FROM compound_properties cp2 WHERE cp2.molregno IN ( SELECT a3.molregno FROM activities a3 WHERE a3.assay_id IN ( SELECT at3.assay_id FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target at ON td.tid = at.tid JOIN assays asy ON at.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN activities a ON asy.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND td.tax_id >= 12353.38 AND d.year >= '2000' AND d.year <= '2000' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND at.relationship_type = 'D' AND asy.assay_type = 'B' AND cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.ec_number, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) >= 370.61 AND AVG(a.standard_value) BETWEEN 185.06 AND 3865.18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 20.14 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 618.99;

WITH compound_activity_stats AS ( SELECT a.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, AVG(a.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.molregno ORDER BY a.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_activity, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.molregno ORDER BY a.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_activity_count, a.standard_value, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 FROM activities a JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON asy.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON asy.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 1192.64 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 480.83 AND 987.88 AND a.assay_id IN ('1') ) SELECT l1, l2, pref_name, assay_desc, confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(moving_avg_activity) AS avg_moving_activity, AVG(alogp) AS avg_alogp, AVG(psa) AS avg_psa, SUM(num_ro5_violations) AS total_ro5_violations, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY standard_value) AS median_activity FROM compound_activity_stats WHERE cumulative_activity_count >= 27 GROUP BY l1, l2, pref_name, assay_desc, confidence_summary HAVING AVG(moving_avg_activity) < 458.73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT molregno) > 74 ORDER BY avg_moving_activity ASC, unique_compounds DESC LIMIT 223;

num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT a.standard_type) AS num_standard_types, COUNT(DISTINCT a.standard_units) AS num_standard_units, COUNT(DISTINCT a.published_activity_type) AS num_pub_activity_types, COUNT(DISTINCT a.relation) AS num_relations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.doc_id) AS num_documents, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cr.compound_name, '; ') AS all_compound_names FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 820539.17 AND 784392.1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 1677.83 AND 1217.53 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -0.86 AND 4.28 AND a.standard_flag = 0.83 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 60.7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 894.37 ), target_classification_summary AS ( SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, td.ec_number, td.tissue, td.cell_line, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS num_assays_linked, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays_with_data, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS num_activities, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS num_unique_compounds, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_activity_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_activity_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ay.assay_type) AS num_assay_types, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT td.gene_names, '; ') AS all_gene_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT td.synonyms, '; ') AS all_target_synonyms FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays ay ON a2t.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN activities a ON ay.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 792838.37 AND 859859.38 AND a2t.confidence >= 5.53 AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 1936.76 AND 1969.38 AND td.tax_id = 927865.27 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, td.ec_number, td.tissue, td.cell_line, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.hba, cas.hbd, cas.psa, cas.rtb, cas.num_ro5_violations, cas.all_synonyms, cas.all_compound_names, NULL AS target_classification, NULL AS organism, NULL AS target_type FROM compound_activity_summary cas WHERE cas.molweight BETWEEN 1558.66 AND 1887.12 AND cas.hba BETWEEN 8.24 AND 36.75 AND cas.hbd BETWEEN 29.9 AND 13.03 UNION ALL SELECT 'target' AS source_type, WITH ranked_compounds AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, t.tid, t.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, a.assay_type ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS rn_per_compound_assay FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at2.tid = t.tid JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 331.5 AND 674.86 AND cp.alogp > 9.63 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 9305.92 ), window_analysis AS ( SELECT rc.assay_type, rc.target_class_level1, rc.target_class_level2, rc.standard_value, AVG(rc.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY rc.target_class_level1, rc.target_class_level2 ORDER BY rc.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_standard_value, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY rc.target_class_level1, rc.target_class_level2 ORDER BY rc.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_count FROM ranked_compounds rc WHERE rc.rn_per_compound_assay = 1 ) SELECT wa.assay_type, wa.target_class_level1, wa.target_class_level2, COUNT(*) AS num_compounds, MIN(wa.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(wa.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, AVG(wa.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, AVG(wa.moving_avg_standard_value) AS avg_moving_avg, MAX(wa.cumulative_count) AS total_compounds_in_class FROM window_analysis wa GROUP BY wa.assay_type, wa.target_class_level1, wa.target_class_level2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 100 ORDER BY wa.target_class_level1, wa.target_class_level2, num_compounds DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE act.standard_value > 86912.07 AND a.assay_type = 'A' GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 49 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC LIMIT 100;
