SELECT common_molregno, common_tid, total_activities FROM ( SELECT a.molregno AS common_molregno, at.tid AS common_tid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_logp, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw FROM activities a JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ay.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.alogp > '-5' AND cp.mw_freebase < '200' AND d.year::integer >= 2007 AND tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' GROUP BY a.molregno, at.tid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 1 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '0.1' INTERSECT SELECT a.molregno AS common_molregno, at.tid AS common_tid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_logp, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw FROM activities a JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ay.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.hba >= 2 AND cp.hbd <= 3 AND at.confidence > 5 AND tc.l2 = 'Protease' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY a.molregno, at.tid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) <= 27 AND MIN(cp.alogp) > '0' ) AS intersected_results ORDER BY total_activities DESC, common_molregno, common_tid LIMIT 910;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, SUM(CASE WHEN at.assay_type = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assay_b_count, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.standard_value) AS median_standard_value, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS synonyms_list FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON ass.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2010 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 9 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_logp FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN docs d ON s.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 61207.28 AND 4539.88 AND d.year BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 38.24 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 7871.08 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.inchi_key, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY act.standard_value) AS median_standard_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_l1_avg_value FROM compound_properties cp INNER JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno INNER JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND cp.molregno = act.molregno INNER JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id INNER JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type INNER JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence INNER JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '200' AND cp.alogp >= '-5' AND cp.hba <= 6 AND cp.hbd <= 3 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.inchi_key, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 10 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 641;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS num_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ac.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS min_standard_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.med_chem_friendly ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) DESC, AVG(ac.standard_value) ASC NULLS LAST) AS rank_within_medchem FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cr.record_id = ac.record_id JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '1000' AND cp.alogp > '-5' AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 5 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < '0' ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) DESC) AS rank_by_activity_count FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '500.0' AND cp.alogp > '0.0' AND cp.hba >= 7 AND d.year::integer >= 2008 AND a2t.confidence >= 7 GROUP BY cp.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, a.assay_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 1 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY num_activities DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms_list FROM target_dictionary t JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON act.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value > 89961.04 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 401.93 AND 573.93 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2015 AND a2t.confidence >= 4 GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 16 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 67234.26 ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 236;

SELECT td.pref_name AS target_name, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT c.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON ac.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 376.06 AND 792.61 AND (cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 OR cp.ro3_pass = 'Y') AND a.assay_type NOT IN ('{{p4}}', '{{p5}}') AND td.organism = '{{p6}}' GROUP BY td.pref_name, a.assay_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 6 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < 3952.86 ORDER BY avg_activity ASC, assay_count DESC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS distinct_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT act.record_id) AS distinct_records, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 871.98 AND 676.6 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 8 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 61880.88 ORDER BY distinct_compounds DESC, avg_activity ASC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_ro3_pass, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_medchem_friendly FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid AND a2t.confidence > 6 JOIN assays ass ON a2t.assay_id = ass.assay_id AND ass.assay_type = 'B' JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno AND c.molweight > '200' JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 1 JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid AND tc.l1 IS NOT NULL JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id AND d.year::integer > 2018 JOIN compound_records cr ON a.molregno = cr.molregno AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a2t.relationship_type = 'D' AND cp.hba BETWEEN 8 AND 14 AND cp.hbd BETWEEN 4 AND 5 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) > 7 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) >= 92 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_compounds DESC LIMIT 73;

WITH assay_stats AS ( SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency, COUNT(*) AS total_measurements, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) DESC) AS assay_rank FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 783.48 AND a2t.confidence >= 5 AND td.tax_id = 9910 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence ), compound_activity AS ( SELECT c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT ast.assay_id) AS active_assays, AVG(ast.avg_potency) AS avg_potency_across_assays, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ast.assay_id) DESC, AVG(ast.avg_potency) DESC) AS compound_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assay_stats ast ON act.assay_id = ast.assay_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 435.47 AND 730.14 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 GROUP BY c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations ) SELECT ast.assay_type, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, cl.confidence_summary, ast.unique_compounds, ast.avg_potency, ast.min_potency, ast.max_potency, ast.total_measurements, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.molregno) AS ro5_compliant_compounds, AVG(ca.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(ca.alogp) AS avg_logp, ast.assay_rank FROM assay_stats ast JOIN target_dictionary td ON ast.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON ast.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN compound_activity ca ON ca.active_assays > 0 WHERE ast.assay_rank <= 5 AND ast.unique_compounds >= 30 GROUP BY ast.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, cl.confidence_summary, ast.unique_compounds, ast.avg_potency, ast.min_potency, ast.max_potency, ast.total_measurements, ast.assay_rank ORDER BY ast.assay_rank ASC, ast.unique_compounds DESC, ast.avg_potency ASC;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 0 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 428.65 AND 652.69 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 7.22 AND 8.46 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = c.molregno AND cr.doc_id = a.doc_id ) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 16.14 ) SELECT cas.molregno, cas.molweight, cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.hba, cas.hbd, cas.assay_count, cas.activity_count, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency, cs.synonyms AS primary_synonym, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1 FROM compound_activity_summary cas LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cas.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN activities act ON cas.molregno = act.molregno LEFT JOIN assay2target at2 ON act.assay_id = at2.assay_id LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE cas.avg_potency BETWEEN 8036.43 AND 5273.56 AND cas.hba <= 13.86 AND cas.hbd <= 11.53 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compounds c2 WHERE c2.molregno = cas.molregno AND c2.molweight BETWEEN 534.14 AND 543.66 ) GROUP BY cas.molregno, cas.molweight, cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.hba, cas.hbd, cas.assay_count, cas.activity_count, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency, cs.synonyms, td.pref_name, tc.l1 ORDER BY cas.avg_potency ASC, cas.assay_count DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type, a.relation, a.published_activity_type, at.assay_desc, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.protein_accession, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, tc.l3 AS target_class_l3, a2t.confidence AS assay_target_confidence, cl.confidence_summary, d.year AS publication_year, d.journal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.assay_id IN (SELECT assay_id FROM assay2target WHERE tid = td.tid) LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id AND td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > '0' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '100' AND cp.alogp >= '-5' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2008 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 ), aggregated_targets AS ( SELECT ra.molregno, ra.target_name, ra.target_organism, ra.target_class_l1, ra.target_class_l2, ra.assay_target_confidence, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.activity_rank = 1 GROUP BY ra.molregno, ra.target_name, ra.target_organism, ra.target_class_l1, ra.target_class_l2, ra.assay_target_confidence HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) >= 4 AND AVG(ra.standard_value) < '0' ) SELECT at.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cs.synonyms AS compound_synonym, at.target_name, at.target_organism, at.target_class_l1, at.target_class_l2, at.num_assays, at.avg_standard_value, at.min_standard_value, at.max_standard_value, at.ro3_pass_count, at.med_chem_friendly_count, at.assay_target_confidence, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY at.avg_standard_value ASC, at.num_assays DESC) AS overall_rank FROM aggregated_targets at JOIN compounds c ON at.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON at.molregno = cs.molregno ORDER BY overall_rank, at.molregno, at.target_name LIMIT 774;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description AS assay_description, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism ORDER BY c.molweight ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_activity, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism ORDER BY c.molweight ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_compound_count FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 458009.35 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -3.36 AND 0.17 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a.assay_type = 'B' GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, td.pref_name, td.organism, c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type ORDER BY a.assay_id, c.molweight;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.published_value) AS min_published_value, MAX(ac.published_value) AS max_published_value FROM compounds c JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.published_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_value > 50234.42 AND d.year::integer >= 2002 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 8 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value > 6235.1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 444.74 AND 522.72 AND c.molregno IN ( SELECT DISTINCT cr.molregno FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.doc_id IN ( SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) >= 2009 ) ) GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < 20394.96 ORDER BY assay_count DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw_freebase, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN docs d ON s.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::integer >= 1990 AND d.year::integer <= 2011 AND cp.mw_freebase > '200' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 50 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '10' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND d.year::integer >= 2013 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno ) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < '1' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_potency FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_units = 'nM' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = c.molregno AND cr.doc_id = a.doc_id ) AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 453.96 AND 408.41 AND ac.standard_value <= 38.15 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 9.7 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, assay_count DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) AS num_documents, MAX(d.year::INTEGER) AS latest_year FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value <= 4360.69 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 9.31 AND 4.29 AND cp.hba >= 15 AND cp.hbd <= 10 AND td.tid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT tid FROM target_class WHERE l1 = 'None' AND l2 = 'None' ) AND a.assay_id IN ( SELECT assay_id FROM assay2target WHERE confidence >= 1 ) AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2017 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 4 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 7999.51 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_assays DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.alogp, cp.psa, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 489.58 AND 297.97 AND a.assay_type LIKE 'A' AND td.organism LIKE 'A' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.alogp, cp.psa HAVING AVG(ac.standard_value) < 18351.3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 91.84 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, assay_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) AS activity_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ac.standard_value) DESC) AS standard_value_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 637.95 AND 145.56 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 6.85 AND 8.37 AND ac.standard_value > 6882.14 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) >= 39.27 ORDER BY standard_value_rank LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description AS assay_description, at.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, cr.record_id, cr.compound_name, act.activity_id, act.standard_value, act.published_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, act.relation, act.published_activity_type, act.activity_comment, cl.confidence_summary, cl.description AS confidence_description, a2t.multi, a2t.confidence AS assay_confidence, act2.standard_value < '0') AS low_activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, a.assay_type) AS avg_standard_value_per_assay_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid) AS target_activity_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_in_target_class, SUM(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.year ORDER BY d.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_standard_value_by_year FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON act.standard_flag = cl.confidence JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON td.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession AND a.assay_type = tp.assay_type WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '1000' AND cp.alogp >= '-5' AND cp.hba <= 6 AND cp.hbd <= 2 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2009 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 AND td.tax_id = 10040 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, at.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, cr.record_id, cr.compound_name, tp.relationship_type, tp.assay_organism, tp.organism, tp.protein_accession HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 9 ORDER BY avg_standard_value_per_assay_type DESC, c.molregno, a.assay_id;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.molregno, a.assay_type) AS avg_activity_by_type, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank_per_target FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '100.0' AND cp.alogp >= '-5.0' AND cp.hba <= 9 AND cp.hbd <= 10 AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 1 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0.0' AND a2t.confidence >= 5 AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 2006 AND 1998 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) > 34 ORDER BY avg_activity_by_type DESC, activity_rank_per_target LIMIT 1000;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, at.assay_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flagged_count, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS unique_documents, MIN(CAST(d.year AS INTEGER)) AS earliest_year, MAX(CAST(d.year AS INTEGER)) AS latest_year FROM target_dictionary td INNER JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid INNER JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id INNER JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id INNER JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno INNER JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno INNER JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id INNER JOIN assay_type at ON a_s.assay_type = at.assay_type INNER JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid INNER JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence INNER JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 79161.85 AND 985813.39 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 801.61 AND 260.22 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 8.86 AND -0.59 AND CAST(d.year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1907 AND 1907 AND a2t.confidence >= 3 AND a.standard_flag IN (0, 1) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, at.assay_type, tc.l1, tc.l2), (td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, at.assay_type, tc.l1), (td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, at.assay_type), (td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism), (td.tid, td.pref_name), (td.tid), (at.assay_type, tc.l1, tc.l2), (at.assay_type, tc.l1), (at.assay_type), (tc.l1, tc.l2), (tc.l1), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) >= 401 AND AVG(a.standard_value) <= 809739.77 ORDER BY td.tid, at.assay_type, tc.l1, tc.l2;

WITH compound_activity_stats AS ( SELECT a.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, AVG(a.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.molregno ORDER BY a.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_activity, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.molregno ORDER BY a.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_activity_count, a.standard_value, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 FROM activities a JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON asy.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON asy.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 8492.43 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 493.72 AND 984.29 AND a.assay_id IN ('1') ) SELECT l1, l2, pref_name, assay_desc, confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(moving_avg_activity) AS avg_moving_activity, AVG(alogp) AS avg_alogp, AVG(psa) AS avg_psa, SUM(num_ro5_violations) AS total_ro5_violations, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY standard_value) AS median_activity FROM compound_activity_stats WHERE cumulative_activity_count >= 11 GROUP BY l1, l2, pref_name, assay_desc, confidence_summary HAVING AVG(moving_avg_activity) < 652.15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT molregno) > 8 ORDER BY avg_moving_activity ASC, unique_compounds DESC LIMIT 994;

WITH compound_activity_stats AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(a.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_standard_activities FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 221678.73 AND CAST(d.year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2010 AND 2012 AND cp.hba >= 2 AND cp.hbd <= 5 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(a.activity_id) > 16 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 9764.75 ) SELECT cas.molregno, cas.molweight, cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.hba, cas.hbd, cas.num_assays, cas.num_activities, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency, cas.num_standard_activities, cs.synonyms AS primary_synonym FROM compound_activity_stats cas LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cas.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE cas.mw_freebase BETWEEN 255.7 AND 231.35 ORDER BY cas.avg_potency ASC, cas.num_activities DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_units, a.relation, a.published_activity_type, a.activity_comment, a.doc_id, c.molweight, c.molformula, c.canonical_smiles, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, td.protein_accession, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, cl.confidence_summary, a2t.confidence, a2t.relationship_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank, AVG(a.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, td.tid) AS avg_activity_per_target, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id) AS activity_count_per_assay FROM activities a JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assays a2 ON a.assay_id = a2.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a2.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 2040.78 AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_type IN ('IC50', 'Ki', 'EC50') AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 456.86 AND 626.0 AND cp.alogp <= -3.71 AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 1 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2012 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND a2t.relationship_type = 'D' ) SELECT ra.molregno, ra.pref_name AS target_name, ra.assay_type, ra.standard_type, ra.standard_value, ra.activity_rank, ra.avg_activity_per_target, ra.activity_count_per_assay, ra.molweight, ra.mw_freebase, ra.alogp, ra.hba, ra.hbd, ra.psa, ra.rtb, ra.num_ro5_violations, ra.ro3_pass, ra.med_chem_friendly, ra.l1 AS target_class_l1, ra.l2 AS target_class_l2, ra.l3 AS target_class_l3, ra.l4 AS target_class_l4, ra.l5 AS target_class_l5, ra.l6 AS target_class_l6, ra.l7 AS target_class_l7, ra.l8 AS target_class_l8, ra.target_classification, ra.confidence_summary, ra.pubmed_id, ra.year, ra.journal, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ra.molregno) AS total_activities_per_compound, SUM(ra.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY ra.molregno, ra.pref_name) AS total_activity_per_target, AVG(ra.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY ra.l1, ra.l2) AS avg_activity_per_target_class FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.activity_rank = 1 AND ra.avg_activity_per_target > 176.31 AND ra.activity_count_per_assay >= 8 ORDER BY ra.standard_value DESC, ra.molregno, ra.pref_name LIMIT 977;

SELECT a.assay_id, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_activity FROM assays a JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id WHERE ac.standard_value > 71351.65 AND ac.standard_flag = 0 GROUP BY a.assay_id ORDER BY avg_activity DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 833244.95 AND a.assay_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT a2t.assay_id FROM assay2target a2t JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid WHERE td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' ) GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < 5957.72 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, cl.confidence_summary, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.assay_id IN (SELECT act2.assay_id FROM activities act2 WHERE act2.standard_value > 43926.68 AND act2.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY act2.assay_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 919) AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 838.18 AND 1031.34 AND cp.alogp >= 6.53 AND cp.hba <= 9 AND cp.hbd <= 8 AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 4 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND d.year >= '1990' GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, cl.confidence_summary, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < 7541.96 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 55 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, activity_count DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.journal, d.year, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT act.record_id) AS total_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value BETWEEN 6110.61 AND 2956.12 AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 2010 AND 2002 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.journal, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 68 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_potency ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.record_id) AS total_activities, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_flag = 1 AND ac.standard_value > 31274.78 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2006 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ac.molregno) > 17 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < 1984.55 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT act.record_id) AS total_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 88393.18 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 951.24 AND 523.71 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -1.01 AND 14.72 AND act.doc_id IN ( SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2007 AND 2020 ) GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 100 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 8584.01 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, unique_compounds DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, aty.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism ORDER BY act.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_activity, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY cp.molregno, a.assay_type ) AS assays_per_compound_type, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC ) AS activity_rank_per_target FROM assays a JOIN assay_type aty ON a.assay_type = aty.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value > 116285.44 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 424.71 AND 496.49 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 5 AND d.year::integer >= 2020 AND a2t.confidence >= 5 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, aty.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 41 ORDER BY activity_rank_per_target, moving_avg_activity DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE a.standard_value > 70314.51 AND a.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY c.molregno ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 425.18 AND 848.98 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2004.15 AND 2019.79 AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < 7805.3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 5.69 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_activity ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_names FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 427.2 AND 614.62 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 3.01 AND 6.34 AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 6.86 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 9304.64 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_potency ASC LIMIT 908.38;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.hba) AS min_hba, MAX(cp.hbd) AS max_hbd, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE cp.alogp >= 7.76 AND cp.mw_freebase <= 565.07 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND s.assay_type = '{{p3}}' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 42 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molformula, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN 2.26 AND -1.57 AND d.journal LIKE 'Journal%' AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.hba >= 6.65 AND cp.hbd >= 8.26 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molformula, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 4.59 AND AVG(act.standard_value) BETWEEN 15.85 AND 47.76 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_activity ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molformula, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS num_targets, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l2, '; ') AS target_classes, MAX(cl.confidence) AS max_confidence, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) AS num_documents, MAX(d.year::INTEGER) AS latest_year FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON s.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON s.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON a2t.tid = t.tid JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN target_type tt ON t.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN relationship_type rt ON a2t.relationship_type = rt.relationship_type WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value BETWEEN 2502.47 AND 76859.57 AND cp.alogp >= 2.22 AND cp.hba <= 5 AND cp.hbd <= 5 AND (a.standard_flag = 1 OR a.standard_flag IS NULL) AND a2t.confidence >= 2 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2007 AND (tt.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' OR tt.target_type IS NULL) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molformula, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 1 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 684.22 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) >= 8 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, num_activities DESC, max_confidence DESC LIMIT 427;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = c.molregno AND cr.doc_id = 32211 ) AND a.standard_value BETWEEN '0.1' AND '1000' AND cp.hba <= 6 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 4 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c LEFT JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno LEFT JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id LEFT JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 579474.09 AND d.year::integer >= 2021 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 22 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 6105775.37 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 109;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE c.molregno IN ( SELECT cr.molregno FROM compound_records cr JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.year::integer > 2012 ) AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '-5' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 7 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN 3.72 AND 2.32 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1990 AND 1998 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 41 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY td.organism) AS avg_organism_activity, SUM(ac.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY cp.alogp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_alogp, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms_list, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2 FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '500' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND ac.standard_value >= '0.1' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2021 AND at.confidence >= 7 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, td.organism, tc.l1, td.pref_name, tc.l2, ac.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 5 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < '1000' ORDER BY activity_rank, avg_organism_activity DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE c.molweight BETWEEN '100' AND '100' AND cp.alogp > '-5' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 31 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(a.published_value) AS max_published_value, MIN(a.published_value) AS min_published_value, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT td.pref_name, '; ') AS target_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON ass.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 712740.42 AND 90748.99 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 9.57 AND -7.16 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 5.87 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1934.01 AND 2017.64 AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND a2t.confidence >= 3.48 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 54.48 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 179051.95 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno ) AS num_synonyms FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ay.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 734.99 AND 754.12 AND c.molweight BETWEEN 577.8 AND 296.59 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 0.75 AND -4.27 AND cp.hbd <= 7.31 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1.96 AND ay.assay_type = 'B' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 97.28 AND AVG(a.standard_value) BETWEEN 586.58 AND 36.68 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, num_activities DESC LIMIT 747.55;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE a.activity_id IN ( SELECT activity_id FROM activities WHERE assay_id IN ( SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE doc_id IN ( SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2006 ) ) ) AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '-5.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 4 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < '0.0' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.record_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_standard_flags, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, ', ') AS assay_descriptions, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, ', ') AS compound_synonyms_list, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw_freebase, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp, SUM(cp.hba) AS total_hba, SUM(cp.hbd) AS total_hbd, AVG(cp.psa) AS avg_psa, SUM(cp.rtb) AS total_rtb, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS num_documents, MIN(CAST(d.year AS INTEGER)) AS earliest_year, MAX(CAST(d.year AS INTEGER)) AS latest_year, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.tid) AS num_targets, AVG(a2t.confidence) AS avg_target_confidence, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cl.confidence_summary, ', ') AS confidence_summaries, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tt.target_desc, ', ') AS target_descriptions FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities a ON cr.record_id = a.record_id AND cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON asy.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON asy.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id AND a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON asy.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '100' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > '0.1' AND CAST(d.year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2005 AND 2018 AND a2t.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY cp.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 37 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.record_id) >= 238 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, num_assays DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cp.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '300' AND cp.alogp >= '-2' AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.molregno IN ( SELECT molregno FROM compound_synonyms WHERE synonyms LIKE '%acid%' ) GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 10 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, d.year, d.journal, cl.confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '500' AND cp.alogp >= '-5' AND cp.hba <= 1 AND cp.hbd <= 0 AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 2 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2011 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, d.year, d.journal, cl.confidence_summary HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 67 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' AND MIN(act.standard_value) >= '0' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.inchi_key, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY act.standard_value) AS median_standard_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_l1_avg_value FROM compound_properties cp INNER JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno INNER JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND cp.molregno = act.molregno INNER JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id INNER JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type INNER JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence INNER JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '200' AND cp.alogp >= '-5' AND cp.hba <= 16 AND cp.hbd <= 1 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.inchi_key, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 22 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 179;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cp.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE cp.molregno IN ( SELECT cr.molregno FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.doc_id = 50706 ) AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '-5.0' AND c.molweight BETWEEN '100.0' AND '100.0' GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 13 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase >= '200' AND cp.alogp <= '-5' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a2t.confidence >= 5 AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 47 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, assay_count DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) FROM activities a WHERE a.molregno = cp.molregno AND a.standard_value < 70.63) AS high_potency_activities, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = cp.molregno AND cr.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2016 AND 2020)) AS recent_records FROM compound_properties cp WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 597.3 AND 652.56 AND cp.alogp > 0.94 AND cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC, cp.alogp ASC;

act.record_id JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN version v ON v.creation_date >= '2000-01-01' WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 484.46 AND 127.78 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 7.08 AND -1.85 AND cp.hba BETWEEN 6.25 AND 6.39 AND cp.hbd BETWEEN 5.85 AND 5.94 AND cp.psa BETWEEN 71.62 AND 150.91 AND cp.rtb BETWEEN 12.96 AND 0.19 AND cp.num_ro5_violations BETWEEN 2.64 AND 3.75 AND c.molweight BETWEEN 826.47 AND 942.77 AND act.standard_value BETWEEN 136294.01
