AVG(act.standard_value) > 635984.51 ORDER BY avg_activity_per_target DESC, total_compound_activities DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cp.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_value > 65.99 AND ac.standard_value < 843323.94 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2010 AND d.year::INTEGER <= 2005 AND cp.mw_freebase >= 287.55 AND cp.mw_freebase <= 763.56 AND at.confidence >= 7 GROUP BY cp.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 26 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) > 785.24 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, num_assays DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cs1.molregno, cs1.synonyms AS synonym1, cs2.synonyms AS synonym2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight FROM compound_synonyms cs1 JOIN compound_synonyms cs2 ON cs1.molregno = cs2.molregno AND cs1.synonyms < cs2.synonyms JOIN compounds c ON cs1.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON cs1.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON cs1.molregno = a.molregno WHERE cp.mw_freebase > 282.17 AND cp.alogp < 2.76 GROUP BY cs1.molregno, cs1.synonyms, cs2.synonyms HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 9 ORDER BY activity_count DESC;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_activity_value FROM target_dictionary t JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON ac.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE a2t.confidence >= 4 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '600' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno AND cs.synonyms IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 5 AND MIN(ac.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_mw ASC;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS total_activities, COUNT(DISTINCT c.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions FROM target_dictionary t JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a_s.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON t.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession AND a_s.assay_type = tp.assay_type WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '300' AND a_s.doc_id IN ( SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) >= 2023 AND CAST(year AS INTEGER) <= 2018 ) AND a2t.confidence >= 5 AND a.standard_units = 'nM' GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 318 AND AVG(cp.alogp) BETWEEN '-5' AND '-2' ORDER BY total_activities DESC, avg_molecular_weight ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, td.organism, a2t.assay_organism, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM target_class tc JOIN target_dictionary td ON tc.tid = td.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 5296.79 AND 8567.66 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 552.13 AND 332.37 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -0.08 AND -2.54 AND td.tax_id = 9748.82 AND a2t.confidence >= 8.81 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2004.19 AND 2022.73 AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_units = 'nM' GROUP BY tc.l1, tc.l2, td.organism, a2t.assay_organism, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < 909.17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) > 61.47 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, unique_compounds DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT td.pref_name AS target_name, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT c.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON ac.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 314.89 AND 432.93 AND (cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 OR cp.ro3_pass = 'Y') AND a.assay_type NOT IN ('{{p4}}', '{{p5}}') AND td.organism = '{{p6}}' GROUP BY td.pref_name, a.assay_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 9 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < 4257.2 ORDER BY avg_activity ASC, assay_count DESC;

SELECT td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l2 AS target_class, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 55498.92 AND 80657.33 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 616.64 AND 520.73 AND a.assay_type = 'A' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (td.pref_name, tc.l2, a.assay_type), (td.pref_name, tc.l2), (td.pref_name), () ) ORDER BY td.pref_name, tc.l2, a.assay_type;

SELECT td.pref_name, a.assay_type, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND td.tax_id = 10009 GROUP BY td.pref_name, a.assay_type, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 17 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, compound_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(a.standard_value) DESC) AS potency_rank_in_class, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_logp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target at ON td.tid = at.tid JOIN assays a_s ON at.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a_s.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 1872.47 AND 1458.25 AND d.year >= '2000' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 266.47 AND 359.33 AND at.confidence >= 4.79 AND td.tax_id = 9769.65 GROUP BY td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) > 46.54 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 5668.99 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, unique_compounds DESC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal, a2t.relationship_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY d.year ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, STDDEV(cp.alogp) AS stddev_alogp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 309.43 AND 533.54 AND cp.alogp > 2.15 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2011 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal, a2t.relationship_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(act.activity_id) > 24 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 1849.97 ORDER BY moving_avg_standard_value DESC, unique_compounds DESC LIMIT 781;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal, a2t.relationship_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY d.year ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, STDDEV(cp.alogp) AS stddev_alogp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 486.21 AND 681.06 AND cp.alogp > -1.29 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2015 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal, a2t.relationship_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(act.activity_id) > 12 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 9668.78 ORDER BY moving_avg_standard_value DESC, unique_compounds DESC LIMIT 371;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT c.molregno) AS unique_compounds, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 95534.03 AND d.year::integer >= 2015 AND td.tax_id = 9662 AND a2t.confidence >= 7 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 213.62 AND 1343.68 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 36 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 9328.95 ORDER BY total_activities DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 408;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT c.molregno) AS unique_compounds, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 97743.18 AND d.year::integer >= 2009 AND td.tax_id = 9848 AND a2t.confidence >= 0 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 906.42 AND 1209.36 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 73 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 8659.32 ORDER BY total_activities DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 804;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS num_documents, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MIN(v.creation_date)) AS earliest_version_year FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN version v ON v.creation_date IS NOT NULL JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value > 84960.02 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 370.5 AND 820.69 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2020 AND a2t.confidence >= 7 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 42 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 68212.17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 37 ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT td1.pref_name AS target1_name, td2.pref_name AS target2_name, tc1.l2 AS target1_class_l2, tc2.l2 AS target2_class_l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a1.molregno) AS shared_compounds_count, AVG(cp1.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw_freebase_target1, AVG(cp2.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw_freebase_target2, AVG(a1.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value_target1, AVG(a2.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value_target2, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs1.synonyms, '; ') AS target1_compound_synonyms_sample, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs2.synonyms, '; ') AS target2_compound_synonyms_sample, COUNT(DISTINCT d1.doc_id) AS target1_document_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d2.doc_id) AS target2_document_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a1.molregno) DESC) AS shared_compounds_rank FROM target_dictionary td1 JOIN assay2target at1 ON td1.tid = at1.tid JOIN assays as1 ON at1.assay_id = as1.assay_id JOIN activities a1 ON as1.assay_id = a1.assay_id JOIN compounds c1 ON a1.molregno = c1.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp1 ON c1.molregno = cp1.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs1 ON c1.molregno = cs1.molregno JOIN compound_records cr1 ON c1.molregno = cr1.molregno JOIN docs d1 ON cr1.doc_id = d1.doc_id JOIN target_class tc1 ON td1.tid = tc1.tid JOIN target_dictionary td2 ON td1.tid < td2.tid JOIN assay2target at2 ON td2.tid = at2.tid JOIN assays as2 ON at2.assay_id = as2.assay_id JOIN activities a2 ON as2.assay_id = a2.assay_id JOIN compounds c2 ON a2.molregno = c2.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp2 ON c2.molregno = cp2.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs2 ON c2.molregno = cs2.molregno JOIN compound_records cr2 ON c2.molregno = cr2.molregno JOIN docs d2 ON cr2.doc_id = d2.doc_id JOIN target_class tc2 ON td2.tid = tc2.tid WHERE a1.standard_value >= '0.1' AND a2.standard_value >= '0.1' AND cp1.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '1000' AND cp2.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '1000' AND at1.confidence >= 0 AND at2.confidence >= 10 AND d1.year >= '1990' AND d2.year >= '1990' AND tc1.l2 = tc2.l2 AND a1.molregno = a2.molregno GROUP BY td1.pref_name, td2.pref_name, tc1.l2, tc2.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a1.molregno) > 63 AND AVG(a1.standard_value) < '1' AND AVG(a2.standard_value) < '1' ORDER BY shared_compounds_count DESC, avg_standard_value_target1 ASC, avg_standard_value_target2 ASC LIMIT 609;

SELECT td1.pref_name AS target1_name, td2.pref_name AS target2_name, tc1.l2 AS target1_class_l2, tc2.l2 AS target2_class_l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a1.molregno) AS shared_compounds_count, AVG(cp1.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw_freebase_target1, AVG(cp2.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw_freebase_target2, AVG(a1.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value_target1, AVG(a2.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value_target2, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs1.synonyms, '; ') AS target1_compound_synonyms_sample, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs2.synonyms, '; ') AS target2_compound_synonyms_sample, COUNT(DISTINCT d1.doc_id) AS target1_document_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d2.doc_id) AS target2_document_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a1.molregno) DESC) AS shared_compounds_rank FROM target_dictionary td1 JOIN assay2target at1 ON td1.tid = at1.tid JOIN assays as1 ON at1.assay_id = as1.assay_id JOIN activities a1 ON as1.assay_id = a1.assay_id JOIN compounds c1 ON a1.molregno = c1.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp1 ON c1.molregno = cp1.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs1 ON c1.molregno = cs1.molregno JOIN compound_records cr1 ON c1.molregno = cr1.molregno JOIN docs d1 ON cr1.doc_id = d1.doc_id JOIN target_class tc1 ON td1.tid = tc1.tid JOIN target_dictionary td2 ON td1.tid < td2.tid JOIN assay2target at2 ON td2.tid = at2.tid JOIN assays as2 ON at2.assay_id = as2.assay_id JOIN activities a2 ON as2.assay_id = a2.assay_id JOIN compounds c2 ON a2.molregno = c2.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp2 ON c2.molregno = cp2.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs2 ON c2.molregno = cs2.molregno JOIN compound_records cr2 ON c2.molregno = cr2.molregno JOIN docs d2 ON cr2.doc_id = d2.doc_id JOIN target_class tc2 ON td2.tid = tc2.tid WHERE a1.standard_value >= '0.1' AND a2.standard_value >= '0.1' AND cp1.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '1000' AND cp2.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '1000' AND at1.confidence >= 10 AND at2.confidence >= 3 AND d1.year >= '1990' AND d2.year >= '1990' AND tc1.l2 = tc2.l2 AND a1.molregno = a2.molregno GROUP BY td1.pref_name, td2.pref_name, tc1.l2, tc2.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a1.molregno) > 48 AND AVG(a1.standard_value) < '1' AND AVG(a2.standard_value) < '1' ORDER BY shared_compounds_count DESC, avg_standard_value_target1 ASC, avg_standard_value_target2 ASC LIMIT 528;

WITH compound_activity_stats AS ( SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_standard_activities FROM activities a WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 35942.85 AND a.standard_units = 'nM' GROUP BY a.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 20 ), compound_props_filtered AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly FROM compound_properties cp WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 382.44 AND 305.84 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 0.68 AND 0.45 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 3 ) SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cas.num_assays, cas.total_activities, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency, cas.num_standard_activities, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS num_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) AS num_documents FROM compounds c JOIN compound_props_filtered cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_activity_stats cas ON c.molregno = cas.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno WHERE c.molweight IS NOT NULL AND c.molweight BETWEEN 203.24 AND 472.24 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cas.num_assays, cas.total_activities, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency, cas.num_standard_activities HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) >= 19 ORDER BY cas.avg_potency ASC, c.molweight DESC LIMIT 86;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.record_id) AS distinct_records, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS distinct_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.tc_id) AS distinct_target_classes, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flagged_activities, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON asy.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON asy.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 6577.72 AND 27089.76 AND cp.mw_freebase >= 335.35 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.year::date) >= 2022 AND at.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) >= 14 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 4175.25 ORDER BY distinct_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities a ON cr.record_id = a.record_id JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN docs d ON asy.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target at ON asy.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '300.0' AND cp.alogp >= '-5.0' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > '0.0' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2011 AND tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 6 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '10.0' ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 679;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS unique_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS unique_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS unique_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.l1) AS unique_l1_classes, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_value IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_activities, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp, MAX(cp.num_ro5_violations) AS max_ro5_violations, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities a ON cr.record_id = a.record_id AND cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON ass.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type LEFT JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type LEFT JOIN relationship_type rt ON a2t.relationship_type = rt.relationship_type WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '501.0' AND cp.alogp >= '-5.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2013 AND a2t.confidence >= 0 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) >= 5 AND AVG(cp.mw_freebase) < '800.0' ORDER BY unique_assays DESC, unique_targets DESC LIMIT 69;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, td.organism, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) AS activity_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1, td.organism ORDER BY AVG(ac.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_avg_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cp.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '0.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 3 AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_flag = 1 AND a2t.confidence >= 3 AND d.year::integer >= 2018 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, td.organism, cl.confidence_summary, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) > 35 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < '0.0' ORDER BY tc.l1, td.organism, rank_by_avg_value, activity_count DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND cp.hba >= 11 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 0 AND cp.molregno IN ( SELECT cr.molregno FROM compound_records cr JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.year::INTEGER >= 2005 ) GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 7 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, assay_count DESC;

cumulative_activity_per_compound FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.activity_rank_per_assay <= 8 AND ra.avg_activity_per_compound > '0.0' AND ra.total_activities_per_assay >= 660 ORDER BY ra.molregno, ra.standard_value DESC;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type, a.relation, a.published_activity_type, at.assay_desc, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.protein_accession, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, tc.l3 AS target_class_l3, a2t.confidence AS assay_target_confidence, cl.confidence_summary, d.year AS publication_year, d.journal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.assay_id IN (SELECT assay_id FROM assay2target WHERE tid = td.tid) LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id AND td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > '0' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '100' AND cp.alogp >= '-5' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2019 AND a2t.confidence >= 3 ), aggregated_targets AS ( SELECT ra.molregno, ra.target_name, ra.target_organism, ra.target_class_l1, ra.target_class_l2, ra.assay_target_confidence, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.activity_rank = 1 GROUP BY ra.molregno, ra.target_name, ra.target_organism, ra.target_class_l1, ra.target_class_l2, ra.assay_target_confidence HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) >= 9 AND AVG(ra.standard_value) < '0' ) SELECT at.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cs.synonyms AS compound_synonym, at.target_name, at.target_organism, at.target_class_l1, at.target_class_l2, at.num_assays, at.avg_standard_value, at.min_standard_value, at.max_standard_value, at.ro3_pass_count, at.med_chem_friendly_count, at.assay_target_confidence, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY at.avg_standard_value ASC, at.num_assays DESC) AS overall_rank FROM aggregated_targets at JOIN compounds c ON at.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON at.molregno = cs.molregno ORDER BY overall_rank, at.molregno, at.target_name LIMIT 229;

SELECT CAST(tc.l1 AS VARCHAR(50)) AS target_class_l1, CAST(tc.l2 AS VARCHAR(50)) AS target_class_l2, CAST(tc.l3 AS VARCHAR(50)) AS target_class_l3, td.organism, a2t.relationship_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS num_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM target_class tc JOIN target_dictionary td ON tc.tid = td.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 183458.61 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 464.43 AND 588.46 AND a2t.confidence >= 7 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, td.organism, a2t.relationship_type), (tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, td.organism), (tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3), (tc.l1, tc.l2), (tc.l1), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 6 ORDER BY tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, td.organism, a2t.relationship_type;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description AS assay_description, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism ORDER BY c.molweight ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_activity, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism ORDER BY c.molweight ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_compound_count FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 521070.13 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -4.42 AND -8.17 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a.assay_type = 'B' GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, td.pref_name, td.organism, c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type ORDER BY a.assay_id, c.molweight;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.record_id) AS total_activities, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_flag = 1 AND ac.standard_value > 88125.06 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2002 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ac.molregno) > 73 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < 34237.61 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, act.published_activity_type, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, at2.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY td.target_type) AS avg_target_type_activity, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno) AS compound_activity_count FROM assays a JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id LEFT JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at2.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '500.0' AND cp.alogp > '-5.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, act.published_activity_type, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, at2.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 8 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.0' ORDER BY activity_rank, avg_target_type_activity DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, act.published_activity_type, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, at2.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY td.target_type) AS avg_target_type_activity, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno) AS compound_activity_count FROM assays a JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id LEFT JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at2.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '500.0' AND cp.alogp > '-5.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 3 AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, act.published_activity_type, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, at2.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 8 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.0' ORDER BY activity_rank, avg_target_type_activity DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING ) AS mw_moving_avg_activity, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 973.22 AND 1115.34 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2005 AND a2t.confidence >= 7 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, td.organism, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 26 ORDER BY num_compounds DESC, mw_moving_avg_activity LIMIT 500;

SELECT a.assay_id, cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a2t.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_desc, d.year, d.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.molregno, a2t.tid) AS avg_standard_value_by_compound_target, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a2t.tid ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank_per_target, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.molregno) AS total_standard_activities_per_compound FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 823053.86 AND 110853.44 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 6.91 AND 7.54 AND cp.hba BETWEEN 2.07 AND 5.65 AND cp.hbd BETWEEN 1.52 AND 14.24 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0.72 AND d.year >= '1900' GROUP BY a.assay_id, cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a2t.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_desc, d.year, d.journal, act.standard_value, act.standard_flag HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 2.68 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 289669.59 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value_by_compound_target ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT a.assay_id, t.pref_name, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(d.year || '-01-01' AS DATE)) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2017 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.assay_id, t.pref_name HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < 17.27 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, t.tid, c.molregno, at.assay_type, ty.target_type, cl.l1, cl.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS assay_rank FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at2.tid = t.tid JOIN target_type ty ON t.target_type = ty.target_type JOIN target_class cl ON t.tid = cl.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 6345.83 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 821.76 AND 567.31 AND d.year >= '2000' AND at2.confidence >= 3 GROUP BY a.assay_id, t.tid, c.molregno, at.assay_type, ty.target_type, cl.l1, cl.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 6 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 7651.28 AND MIN(cp.mw_freebase) > 505.4 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 423;

SELECT a1.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a1.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(a1.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(a2.published_value) AS max_published_value, SUM(cp.hba) AS total_hba, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.tc_id) AS target_class_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a1.molregno ORDER BY AVG(a1.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_avg_value FROM activities a1 JOIN activities a2 ON a1.molregno = a2.molregno AND a1.assay_id = a2.assay_id AND a1.standard_flag = a2.standard_flag AND a1.standard_value < a2.published_value JOIN compounds c ON a1.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON a1.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a1.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a1.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a1.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a1.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a1.standard_value > 614165.84 AND a2.published_value < 747575.46 AND cp.hba >= 9 AND cp.hbd <= 10 AND d.year >= '1990' GROUP BY a1.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a1.assay_id) > 45 AND AVG(a1.standard_value) < 417477.79 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, assay_count DESC LIMIT 850;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE ac.standard_value > 666335.37 AND d.year::integer >= 2004 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING AVG(ac.standard_value) < 9020066.84 ORDER BY assay_count DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE ac.standard_value > 9689.93 AND cp.mw_freebase < 176.81 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.year::date) >= 2003 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 7 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mol_weight, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.l1) AS distinct_target_classes FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 242.04 AND 2915.18 AND cp.alogp >= 4.73 AND act.standard_value <= 30168.82 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (SELECT creation_date FROM version LIMIT 1)) >= 2007.92 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < 42934.42 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 24.21 ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, MAX(td.tid) AS max_target_id, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities a ON cr.record_id = a.record_id AND c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ay.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase > 293.73 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -2.88 AND 3.02 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2003 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 14 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 632.05 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, a.assay_type, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS distinct_compounds, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flagged_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_avg_value FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 50005.66 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 9.98 AND -1.32 AND d.year::integer >= 2021 AND a2t.confidence >= 0 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, a.assay_type, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) > 41698.28 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 82 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, distinct_compounds DESC LIMIT 906;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.molregno) AS unique_compounds, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms_list, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assay_type at ON a_s.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a_s.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 2896.43 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2019 AND 2015 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 358.39 AND 188.08 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND a2t.confidence >= 3 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = a.molregno AND cr.doc_id = a.doc_id AND cr.compound_name IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 78 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 509.96 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 967;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.ec_number, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS unique_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.record_id) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cp.molregno) FROM compound_properties cp WHERE cp.molregno IN ( SELECT a2.molregno FROM activities a2 WHERE a2.assay_id IN ( SELECT at2.assay_id FROM assay2target at2 WHERE at2.tid = td.tid ) ) AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 440.32 AND 369.65 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -4.0 AND 3.17 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2.43 AND cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' ) AS filtered_compounds_count, ( SELECT AVG(cp2.mw_freebase) FROM compound_properties cp2 WHERE cp2.molregno IN ( SELECT a3.molregno FROM activities a3 WHERE a3.assay_id IN ( SELECT at3.assay_id FROM assay2target at3 WHERE at3.tid = td.tid AND at3.confidence >= 0.41 ) AND a3.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a3.standard_value BETWEEN 5623.34 AND 2037.91 ) ) AS avg_mw_filtered_activities FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target at ON td.tid = at.tid JOIN assays asy ON at.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN activities a ON asy.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND td.tax_id >= 34820.02 AND d.year >= '2000' AND d.year <= '2000' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND at.relationship_type = 'D' AND asy.assay_type = 'B' AND cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.ec_number, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) >= 225.47 AND AVG(a.standard_value) BETWEEN 4472.74 AND 7669.85 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 50.55 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 883.21;

WITH assay_stats AS ( SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.doc_id, at.assay_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency, COUNT(*) AS total_measurements FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 694276.77 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.doc_id, at.assay_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 925 ), target_analysis AS ( SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tt.target_desc, a2t.assay_id, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, tc.l3 AS target_class_level3, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY a2t.confidence DESC) AS conf_rank FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE td.tax_id = 10065 AND a2t.confidence >= 0 ), compound_properties_agg AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cs.synonyms AS primary_synonym, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) AS total_records, CASE WHEN cp.num_ro5_violations = 0 AND cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 'Optimal' WHEN cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 AND cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 'Good' WHEN cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 OR cp.ro3_pass = 'N' THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Poor' END AS druglikeness_category, CASE WHEN cp.mw_freebase < 300 THEN 'Small' WHEN cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 300 AND 500 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS molecular_size_category FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 1173.88 AND 441.06 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cs.synonyms ), assay_compound_activity AS ( SELECT ta.tid, ta.pref_name AS target_name, ta.organism AS target_organism, ta.target_desc, ta.target_class_level1, ta.target_class_level2, ta.target_class_level3, ta.confidence_summary, asa.assay_id, asa.assay_type, asa.assay_desc, asa.unique_compounds, asa.avg_potency, asa.min_potency, asa.max_potency, asa.total_measurements, cpa.molregno, cpa.molweight, cpa.molformula, cpa.mw_freebase, cpa.alogp, cpa.hba, cpa.hbd, cpa.psa, cpa.rtb, cpa.num_ro5_violations, cpa.ro3_pass, cpa.med_chem_friendly, cpa.druglikeness_category, cpa.molecular_size_category, cpa.primary_synonym, cpa.total_records, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, act.standard_value, act.published_value, act.standard_type, act.published_activity_type, act.standard_units, act.published_units, act.relation, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ta.tid, asa.assay_id, cpa.molregno ORDER BY act.standard_value ASC) AS potency_rank, CASE WHEN act.standard_value < 10 THEN 'High Potency' WHEN act.standard_value BETWEEN 10 AND 100 THEN 'Medium Potency' WHEN act.standard_value BETWEEN 100 AND 1000 THEN 'Low Potency' ELSE 'Very Low Potency' END AS potency_category, CASE WHEN cpa.druglikeness_category = 'Optimal' AND act.standard_value < 100 THEN 'Lead Candidate' WHEN cpa.druglikeness_category IN ('Optimal', 'Good') AND act.standard_value < 1000 THEN 'Potential Candidate' ELSE 'Research Compound' END AS development_stage FROM target_analysis ta JOIN assay_stats asa ON ta.assay_id = asa.assay_id JOIN activities act ON asa.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_properties_agg cpa ON act.molregno = cpa.molregno JOIN docs d ON asa.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE ta.conf_rank = 1 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND d.year::integer >= 2024 ) SELECT target_class_level1, target_class_level2, target_class_level3, assay_type, druglikeness_category, molecular_size_category, potency_category, development_stage, COUNT(DISTINCT tid) AS unique_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT assay_id) AS unique_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT molregno) AS unique_compounds, SUM(total_measurements) AS total_activity_measurements, AVG(avg_potency) AS avg_potency_across_assays, MIN(min_potency) AS overall_min_potency, MAX(max_potency) AS overall_max_potency, AVG(standard_value) AS avg_compound_potency, AVG(alogp) AS avg_logp, AVG(mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, SUM(CASE WHEN num_ro5_violations = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro5_compliant_compounds, SUM(CASE WHEN ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_compliant_compounds, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY standard_value) AS median_potency, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY standard_value) AS q1_potency, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY standard_value) AS q3_potency FROM assay_compound_activity WHERE potency_rank <= 37 GROUP BY target_class_level1, target_class_level2, target_class_level3, assay_type, druglikeness_category, molecular_size_category, potency_category, development_stage HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molregno) >= 1 AND AVG(standard_value) <= 5495.67 ORDER BY target_class_level1, target_class_level2, target_class_level3, unique_compounds DESC, avg_compound_potency ASC;

WITH assay_target_summary AS ( SELECT a.assay_id, a.doc_id, a.assay_type, at.tid, at.confidence, at.relationship_type, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY at.tid) AS target_assay_count FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE at.confidence >= 8 ), compound_activity_stats AS ( SELECT cr.molregno, cr.record_id, cr.doc_id, act.assay_id, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, act.activity_id, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, c.molweight, cs.synonyms, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY cr.molregno ORDER BY act.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_activity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY cr.molregno, act.assay_id ORDER BY ABS(act.standard_value) ) AS activity_rank FROM compound_records cr JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_properties cp ON cr.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value BETWEEN '0.1' AND '0.1' AND cp.mw_freebase > '100.0' ), journal_year_stats AS ( SELECT d.doc_id, d.year::integer AS pub_year, d.journal, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY d.journal ORDER BY d.year::integer ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_journal_pubs, AVG(d.pubmed_id) OVER ( PARTITION BY d.journal ORDER BY d.year::integer ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_pubmed FROM docs d WHERE d.year ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' AND d.year::integer >= 2019 ) SELECT cas.molregno, MAX(cs.synonyms) AS primary_synonym, ats.pref_name AS target_name, ats.organism AS target_organism, ats.l1 AS target_class_l1, ats.l2 AS target_class_l2, jys.journal, jys.pub_year, COUNT(DISTINCT cas.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(cas.standard_value) AS avg_activity_value, MIN(cas.moving_avg_activity) AS min_moving_avg, MAX(cas.moving_avg_activity) AS max_moving_avg, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp, SUM(cp.num_ro5_violations) AS total_ro5_violations, AVG(ats.confidence) AS avg_target_confidence, COUNT(DISTINCT ats.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, SUM(ats.target_assay_count) AS total_target_associations, AVG(jys.cumulative_journal_pubs) AS avg_cumulative_pubs, AVG(jys.moving_avg_pubmed) AS avg_moving_pubmed FROM compound_activity_stats cas JOIN assay_target_summary ats ON cas.assay_id = ats.assay_id JOIN journal_year_stats jys ON cas.doc_id = jys.doc_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON cas.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cas.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE cas.activity_rank = 1 AND ats.target_assay_count > 12 AND jys.cumulative_journal_pubs >= 926 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '-5.0' GROUP BY cas.molregno, ats.pref_name, ats.organism, ats.l1, ats.l2, jys.journal, jys.pub_year HAVING AVG(cas.standard_value) < '0.1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT cas.activity_id) > 28 AND SUM(cp.num_ro5_violations) <= 0 ORDER BY avg_activity_value DESC, total_activities DESC, avg_target_confidence DESC LIMIT 41;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, COUNT(DISTINCT a.standard_type) AS distinct_activity_types FROM activities a WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value > 648843.95 GROUP BY a.molregno ), compound_property_rank AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, c.molweight, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC) AS mw_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cp.alogp DESC) AS alogp_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.num_ro5_violations ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC) AS mw_rank_by_violations, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cp.hba) AS hba_dense_rank FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 244.26 AND 238.52 AND cp.alogp > -9.19 ) SELECT cas.molregno, cas.num_assays, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency, cas.total_activities, cas.distinct_activity_types, cpr.mw_freebase, cpr.alogp, cpr.hba, cpr.hbd, cpr.psa, cpr.rtb, cpr.num_ro5_violations, cpr.molweight, cpr.mw_rank, cpr.alogp_rank, cpr.mw_rank_by_violations, cpr.hba_dense_rank, AVG(cas.avg_potency) OVER (PARTITION BY cpr.num_ro5_violations) AS avg_potency_by_violation_class, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cpr.num_ro5_violations ORDER BY cas.avg_potency DESC) AS potency_rank_in_class, LAG(cas.avg_potency, 1) OVER (ORDER BY cpr.mw_freebase) AS prev_compound_potency, LEAD(cas.avg_potency, 1) OVER (ORDER BY cpr.mw_freebase) AS next_compound_potency, SUM(cas.total_activities) OVER (ORDER BY cpr.mw_freebase ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_activities FROM compound_activity_summary cas JOIN compound_property_rank cpr ON cas.molregno = cpr.molregno WHERE cas.num_assays >= 53 AND cas.total_activities > 909 ORDER BY cas.avg_potency DESC, cpr.mw_freebase LIMIT 100;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) as activity_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 349030.72 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -9.33 AND 2.11 ) SELECT cas.assay_id, cas.assay_type, cas.standard_type, COUNT(DISTINCT cas.molregno) as unique_compounds, AVG(cas.molweight) as avg_molweight, AVG(cas.alogp) as avg_alogp, MIN(cas.standard_value) as min_activity, MAX(cas.standard_value) as max_activity, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cas.standard_value) as median_activity FROM compound_activity_summary cas WHERE cas.activity_rank = 1 AND cas.hba >= 6 GROUP BY cas.assay_id, cas.assay_type, cas.standard_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cas.molregno) > 86 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_alogp ASC LIMIT 22;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ay.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '200' AND cp.alogp >= '-5' AND a.standard_value <= '0.1' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly ) SELECT cas.molregno, cas.molweight, cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.hba, cas.hbd, cas.psa, cas.rtb, cas.num_ro5_violations, cas.ro3_pass, cas.med_chem_friendly, cas.assay_count, cas.activity_count, cas.avg_standard_value, cas.min_standard_value, cas.max_standard_value, cas.standard_flag_count, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, ay.assay_type, ay.description AS assay_description, d.year AS publication_year, d.journal AS publication_journal FROM compound_activity_summary cas JOIN activities a ON cas.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ay.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cas.assay_count >= 42 AND cas.activity_count > 189 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2011 ORDER BY cas.avg_standard_value ASC, cas.assay_count DESC LIMIT 190;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.activity_id, a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_units, a.doc_id, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, cp.mol_id, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.molregno AS cp_molregno, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, c.molformula, c.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, cl.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, cl.description AS confidence_desc, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, cr.record_id, cr.compound_key, cr.compound_name, rt.relationship_type, rt.relationship_desc,
