SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.journal, d.year, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT act.record_id) AS total_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value BETWEEN 9370.76 AND 7997.64 AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 1995 AND 2013 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.journal, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 39 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_potency ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, aty.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism ORDER BY act.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_activity, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY cp.molregno, a.assay_type ) AS assays_per_compound_type, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC ) AS activity_rank_per_target FROM assays a JOIN assay_type aty ON a.assay_type = aty.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value > 150888.93 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 812.37 AND 547.11 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 3 AND d.year::integer >= 2009 AND a2t.confidence >= 2 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, aty.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 43 ORDER BY activity_rank_per_target, moving_avg_activity DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, cp.molregno, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER(PARTITION BY act.molregno, a.assay_type) AS avg_standard_value_per_compound_assay_type, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY act.molregno) AS total_activities_per_compound, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC) AS mw_rank_in_assay_type, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY act.molregno, a.assay_id) AS flagged_activities_per_assay FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON cr.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.assay_type IN ('B', 'F', 'A') AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -2.65 AND -4.23 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 260.01 AND 452.3 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1.36 AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 2007 AND 2020 AND a2t.confidence >= 1.22 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 588120.28 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, cp.molregno, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_flag, act.molregno, a.assay_id HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) > 21904.47 AND COUNT(*) > 28.27 ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC, avg_standard_value_per_compound_assay_type ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, t.tid, t.pref_name, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON a2t.tid = t.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value BETWEEN 899.18 AND 3287.16 AND d.year::integer >= 2002 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 729.02 AND 480.4 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, t.tid, t.pref_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 24 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 7106.37 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_activity ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name AS target_name, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS distinct_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT act.record_id) AS distinct_records, COUNT(DISTINCT act.standard_type) AS distinct_activity_types, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_activity_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_activity_value FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 5786.04 AND 20128.79 AND cp.mw_freebase > 389.82 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 23 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.standard_type) >= 4 ORDER BY distinct_compounds DESC, avg_molecular_weight ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name AS target_name, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS distinct_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT act.record_id) AS distinct_records, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS distinct_targets, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a2t.confidence >= 1.42 AND act.standard_value BETWEEN 3636.5 AND 3617.5 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 448.4 AND 410.06 AND d.year BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' AND tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 73.46 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 5625.4 ORDER BY distinct_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY act.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 3 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_logp FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE act.standard_value > 411288.49 AND cp.mw_freebase < 289.61 AND cp.hba >= 2 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 7 ORDER BY a.assay_type, moving_avg_activity DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_id ORDER BY act.activity_id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 52116.96 AND 62327.14 AND d.year >= '2000' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 727.89 AND 489.23 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 2.64 AND 6.77 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, act.activity_id, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 85.12 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, moving_avg_potency ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, at.assay_type, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.tid) AS num_targets, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 84786.28 AND a2t.confidence >= 7 AND c.molweight BETWEEN 114.93 AND 511.94 GROUP BY a.assay_id, at.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 48 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 7727.01 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_targets DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, t.pref_name, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(d.year || '-01-01' AS DATE)) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.assay_id, t.pref_name HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < 31.01 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC;

SELECT a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, tt.target_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS distinct_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS distinct_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT act.record_id) AS distinct_records, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_logp FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 5542.28 AND 11637.37 AND cp.mw_freebase > 700.29 AND a2t.confidence >= 2 GROUP BY a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, tt.target_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 8 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 8164.91 ORDER BY distinct_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 11;

SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS active_assays, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency FROM activities a JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN assay_type t ON s.assay_type = t.assay_type WHERE a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value < '0.1' GROUP BY a.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 4 UNION ALL SELECT cr.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS active_assays, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency FROM compound_records cr JOIN activities a ON cr.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id WHERE a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > '1000' AND cr.doc_id = 540 GROUP BY cr.molregno HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < '10000' ORDER BY active_assays DESC, avg_potency DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 209.46 AND 861.28 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2003.64 AND 2015.89 AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < 8553.54 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 1.65 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_activity ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS distinct_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT a.doc_id) AS distinct_documents, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_activity_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 367.36 AND 542.45 AND ac.standard_value >= 87.06 AND t.tax_id = 9801 AND tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 9 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) >= 3 ORDER BY distinct_assays DESC, avg_activity_value ASC LIMIT 29;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, SUM( CASE WHEN a.standard_value IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS active_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '500' AND a.standard_value < '0' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2018 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 9 ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_mw;

SELECT c.molregno, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, SUM(CASE WHEN at.assay_type = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS type_b_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid) AS target_activity_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(a.standard_value) DESC) AS activity_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON ass.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 63926355.02 AND 59590610.05 AND cp.mw_freebase > 674.66 AND cp.alogp < 6.09 AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2001 AND at.assay_type IN ('B', 'F') GROUP BY c.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, td.tid HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) > 33566.98 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 62 AND MAX(cp.mw_freebase) - MIN(cp.mw_freebase) > 283.34 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC, max_mw ASC LIMIT 968;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS num_activities, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS num_targets, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_types, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tt.target_desc, '; ') AS target_types, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS num_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS num_publications, AVG(cp.psa) AS avg_psa, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_compliant_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 806.74 AND 397.85 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 1.07 AND -0.26 AND cp.hba >= 8.19 AND cp.hbd <= 9.53 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND a2t.confidence >= 5.01 AND d.year::integer >= 2001.52 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 11.1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) >= 38.16 AND AVG(act.standard_value) <= 2893.85 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 47.64 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_activities DESC, num_targets DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno) AS synonym_count FROM compounds c JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 4470.6 AND 7263.57 AND a.assay_type = 'A' AND cp.mw_freebase >= 600.02 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 1.35 AND -1.91 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 8.53 AND AVG(act.standard_value) <= 5245.5 ORDER BY avg_activity ASC, assay_count DESC LIMIT 56.84;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mol_weight, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mol_weight, SUM(cp.num_ro5_violations) AS total_ro5_violations, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1, tc.l2 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) DESC) AS assay_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) DESC) AS compound_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) DESC) AS prev_assay_count FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value > '0.0' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '1000.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations >= 5 AND d.year >= '1990' AND a2t.confidence >= 4 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a.assay_type HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < '1000.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 22 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, compound_count DESC;

WITH assay_stats AS ( SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.doc_id, at.assay_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency, COUNT(*) AS total_measurements FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 788754.04 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.doc_id, at.assay_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 600 ), target_analysis AS ( SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tt.target_desc, a2t.assay_id, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, tc.l3 AS target_class_level3, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY a2t.confidence DESC) AS conf_rank FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE td.tax_id = 9749 AND a2t.confidence >= 5 ), compound_properties_agg AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cs.synonyms AS primary_synonym, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) AS total_records, CASE WHEN cp.num_ro5_violations = 0 AND cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 'Optimal' WHEN cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 AND cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 'Good' WHEN cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 OR cp.ro3_pass = 'N' THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Poor' END AS druglikeness_category, CASE WHEN cp.mw_freebase < 300 THEN 'Small' WHEN cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 300 AND 500 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS molecular_size_category FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 1604.49 AND 237.59 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cs.synonyms ), assay_compound_activity AS ( SELECT ta.tid, ta.pref_name AS target_name, ta.organism AS target_organism, ta.target_desc, ta.target_class_level1, ta.target_class_level2, ta.target_class_level3, ta.confidence_summary, asa.assay_id, asa.assay_type, asa.assay_desc, asa.unique_compounds, asa.avg_potency, asa.min_potency, asa.max_potency, asa.total_measurements, cpa.molregno, cpa.molweight, cpa.molformula, cpa.mw_freebase, cpa.alogp, cpa.hba, cpa.hbd, cpa.psa, cpa.rtb, cpa.num_ro5_violations, cpa.ro3_pass, cpa.med_chem_friendly, cpa.druglikeness_category, cpa.molecular_size_category, cpa.primary_synonym, cpa.total_records, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, act.standard_value, act.published_value, act.standard_type, act.published_activity_type, act.standard_units, act.published_units, act.relation, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ta.tid, asa.assay_id, cpa.molregno ORDER BY act.standard_value ASC) AS potency_rank, CASE WHEN act.standard_value < 10 THEN 'High Potency' WHEN act.standard_value BETWEEN 10 AND 100 THEN 'Medium Potency' WHEN act.standard_value BETWEEN 100 AND 1000 THEN 'Low Potency' ELSE 'Very Low Potency' END AS potency_category, CASE WHEN cpa.druglikeness_category = 'Optimal' AND act.standard_value < 100 THEN 'Lead Candidate' WHEN cpa.druglikeness_category IN ('Optimal', 'Good') AND act.standard_value < 1000 THEN 'Potential Candidate' ELSE 'Research Compound' END AS development_stage FROM target_analysis ta JOIN assay_stats asa ON ta.assay_id = asa.assay_id JOIN activities act ON asa.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_properties_agg cpa ON act.molregno = cpa.molregno JOIN docs d ON asa.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE ta.conf_rank = 1 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND d.year::integer >= 2009 ) SELECT target_class_level1, target_class_level2, target_class_level3, assay_type, druglikeness_category, molecular_size_category, potency_category, development_stage, COUNT(DISTINCT tid) AS unique_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT assay_id) AS unique_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT molregno) AS unique_compounds, SUM(total_measurements) AS total_activity_measurements, AVG(avg_potency) AS avg_potency_across_assays, MIN(min_potency) AS overall_min_potency, MAX(max_potency) AS overall_max_potency, AVG(standard_value) AS avg_compound_potency, AVG(alogp) AS avg_logp, AVG(mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, SUM(CASE WHEN num_ro5_violations = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro5_compliant_compounds, SUM(CASE WHEN ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_compliant_compounds, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY standard_value) AS median_potency, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY standard_value) AS q1_potency, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY standard_value) AS q3_potency FROM assay_compound_activity WHERE potency_rank <= 72 GROUP BY target_class_level1, target_class_level2, target_class_level3, assay_type, druglikeness_category, molecular_size_category, potency_category, development_stage HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molregno) >= 32 AND AVG(standard_value) <= 8127.41 ORDER BY target_class_level1, target_class_level2, target_class_level3, unique_compounds DESC, avg_compound_potency ASC;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 6750.36 AND 8776.84 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 284.71 AND 166.56 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations ), ranked_compounds AS ( SELECT cas.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations <= 1 THEN 'Low_Violation' ELSE 'High_Violation' END ORDER BY cas.avg_standard_value DESC ) AS potency_rank, CASE WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations <= 1 THEN 'Low_Violation' ELSE 'High_Violation' END AS violation_category FROM compound_activity_summary cas WHERE cas.activity_count >= 73.23 ) SELECT rc.molregno, rc.molweight, rc.mw_freebase, rc.alogp, rc.hba, rc.hbd, rc.psa, rc.rtb, rc.num_ro5_violations, rc.activity_count, rc.avg_standard_value, rc.min_standard_value, rc.max_standard_value, rc.potency_rank, rc.violation_category FROM ranked_compounds rc WHERE rc.potency_rank <= 49.81 ORDER BY rc.violation_category, rc.potency_rank;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, act.published_value, act.published_activity_type, act.published_units, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY c.molregno ORDER BY act.standard_value ASC ) AS best_activity_rank, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.molregno, a.assay_type ) AS assays_per_type, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.molregno, act.standard_type ) AS avg_activity_by_type FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 928684.76 AND d.year::integer >= 2023 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 7.4 AND -9.31 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 454.31 AND 249.83 ) SELECT molregno, molweight, mw_freebase, alogp, hba, hbd, psa, rtb, num_ro5_violations, ro3_pass, med_chem_friendly, assay_type, standard_value, standard_type, standard_units, published_value, published_activity_type, published_units, doc_id, year, journal, best_activity_rank, assays_per_type, avg_activity_by_type, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, MIN(standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(standard_value) AS max_activity FROM compound_activity_summary WHERE best_activity_rank = 1 GROUP BY molregno, molweight, mw_freebase, alogp, hba, hbd, psa, rtb, num_ro5_violations, ro3_pass, med_chem_friendly, assay_type, standard_value, standard_type, standard_units, published_value, published_activity_type, published_units, doc_id, year, journal, best_activity_rank, assays_per_type, avg_activity_by_type HAVING COUNT(*) > 97 ORDER BY standard_value ASC, molweight DESC LIMIT 240;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.doc_id, a.activity_id, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, c.inchi_key, cs.synonyms, d.year, d.journal, ass.assay_type, ass.description AS assay_description, cl.confidence_summary, a2t.relationship_type, a2t.confidence AS target_confidence, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank, AVG(a.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.molregno ORDER BY a.activity_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_standard_value FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a.standard_flag = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 870263.44 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 583.49 AND 997.45 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 AND d.year::integer >= 2004 ) SELECT molregno, assay_id, standard_value, activity_rank, moving_avg_standard_value, mw_freebase, alogp, hba, hbd, psa, num_ro5_violations, ro3_pass, med_chem_friendly, molweight, inchi_key, synonyms, year, journal, assay_type, assay_description, confidence_summary, relationship_type, target_confidence, target_name, target_organism, target_class_l1, target_class_l2 FROM ranked_activities WHERE activity_rank <= 5 ORDER BY molregno, activity_rank;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.doc_id, d.year, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS rn FROM activities a JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 2022 AND 2001 ) SELECT ra.molregno, cp.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(ra.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(ra.alogp) AS max_alogp FROM ranked_activities ra JOIN compounds cp ON ra.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON ra.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ra.rn = 1 GROUP BY ra.molregno, cp.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms HAVING AVG(ra.standard_value) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) >= 8 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.published_value, a.standard_type, a.relation, a.doc_id, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, c.molformula, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.protein_accession, tt.target_desc, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, a2t.confidence, a2t.relationship_type, a2t.assay_organism, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_desc, d.year, d.journal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank, AVG(a.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno ORDER BY a.assay_id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_standard, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY cp.alogp ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_mw_by_class, SUM(a.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY a.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_standard_by_target FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase IS NOT NULL AND cp.alogp IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 572636.2 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 760.74 AND 606.17 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 0.01 AND -0.65 AND a.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2007 AND 2022) AND td.tid IN (SELECT tid FROM target_class WHERE l1 = 'Enzyme') ) SELECT ra.molregno, ra.tid, ra.pref_name AS target_name, ra.target_organism, ra.protein_accession, ra.target_desc, ra.l1 AS target_class_l1, ra.l2 AS target_class_l2, ra.l3 AS target_class_l3, ra.confidence_summary, ra.assay_desc, ra.year, ra.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, AVG(ra.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(ra.alogp) AS avg_logp, SUM(ra.hba) AS total_hba, SUM(ra.hbd) AS total_hbd, AVG(ra.psa) AS avg_psa, SUM(ra.rtb) AS total_rotatable_bonds, SUM(ra.num_ro5_violations) AS total_ro5_violations, ra.moving_avg_standard, ra.moving_avg_mw_by_class, ra.cumulative_standard_by_target, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.ro3_pass, ', ') AS ro3_pass_status, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.med_chem_friendly, ', ') AS med_chem_status FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.activity_rank = 1 AND ra.moving_avg_standard > 23081.5 AND ra.moving_avg_mw_by_class BETWEEN 763.72 AND 476.7 GROUP BY ra.molregno, ra.tid, ra.pref_name, ra.target_organism, ra.protein_accession, ra.target_desc, ra.l1, ra.l2, ra.l3, ra.confidence_summary, ra.assay_desc, ra.year, ra.journal, ra.moving_avg_standard, ra.moving_avg_mw_by_class, ra.cumulative_standard_by_target HAVING AVG(ra.standard_value) > 126380.07 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) >= 17 AND SUM(ra.num_ro5_violations) <= 0 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, num_assays DESC, ra.cumulative_standard_by_target DESC LIMIT 26;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_units, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, c.molformula, cs.synonyms, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, cl.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.protein_accession, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank_per_assay, AVG(a.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno) AS avg_activity_per_compound, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_id) AS total_activities_per_assay FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > '0.0' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '100.0' AND CAST(d.year AS INTEGER) >= 2017 AND cl.confidence >= 6 ) SELECT ra.molregno, ra.assay_id, ra.standard_value, ra.standard_type, ra.standard_units, ra.mw_freebase, ra.alogp, ra.hba, ra.hbd, ra.psa, ra.rtb, ra.num_ro5_violations, ra.ro3_pass, ra.med_chem_friendly, ra.molweight, ra.molformula, ra.synonyms, ra.assay_type, ra.assay_desc, ra.doc_id, ra.pubmed_id, ra.year, ra.journal, ra.confidence, ra.confidence_summary, ra.tid, ra.pref_name, ra.target_organism, ra.protein_accession, ra.l1, ra.l2, ra.l3, ra.l4, ra.l5, ra.l6, ra.l7, ra.l8, ra.target_classification, ra.activity_rank_per_assay, ra.avg_activity_per_compound, ra.total_activities_per_assay, AVG(ra.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY ra.l1, ra.l2) AS avg_activity_by_target_class, SUM(ra.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY ra.molregno ORDER BY ra.standard_value DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_units, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, c.molformula, cs.synonyms, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, ass.assay_type, ass.description AS assay_description, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence, a2t.relationship_type, td.pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.ec_number, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS rn FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 552.15 AND 701.32 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2015 AND a2t.confidence >= 6 ), aggregated_compounds AS ( SELECT ra.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_activity, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.pref_name, '; ') AS target_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.l1 || ':' || ra.l2, '; ') AS target_classes FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.rn = 1 GROUP BY ra.molregno ), correlated_stats AS ( SELECT ac.molregno, ac.num_assays, ac.avg_activity, ac.min_activity, ac.max_activity, ac.ro3_pass_count, ac.med_chem_friendly_count, ac.all_synonyms, ac.target_names, ac.target_classes, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a2.assay_id) FROM activities a2 WHERE a2.molregno = ac.molregno AND a2.standard_value > (SELECT AVG(standard_value) FROM activities WHERE assay_id = a2.assay_id) ) AS assays_above_avg FROM aggregated_compounds ac ) SELECT cs.molregno, cs.num_assays, cs.avg_activity, cs.min_activity, cs.max_activity, cs.ro3_pass_count, cs.med_chem_friendly_count, cs.assays_above_avg, cs.all_synonyms, cs.target_names, cs.target_classes, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, c.molweight, c.molformula, c.canonical_smiles, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = cs.molregno AND cr.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1990 AND 2004) ) AS records_in_period FROM correlated_stats cs JOIN compound_properties cp ON cs.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON cs.molregno = c.molregno WHERE cs.num_assays >= 48 AND cs.avg_activity <= 9106.37 AND cs.assays_above_avg >= 11 ORDER BY cs.avg_activity ASC, cs.num_assays DESC LIMIT 235;

rc.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(rc.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(rc.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(rc.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, STDDEV(rc.standard_value) AS std_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN rc.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_standard_flags, COUNT(DISTINCT rc.assay_type) AS num_assay_types, COUNT(DISTINCT rc.standard_type) AS num_standard_types, COUNT(DISTINCT rc.relationship_type) AS num_relationship_types, COUNT(DISTINCT rc.confidence_summary) AS num_confidence_levels, COUNT(DISTINCT rc.year) AS num_publication_years, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT rc.journal, '; ') AS journals, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT rc.compound_name, '; ') AS compound_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT rc.compound_synonym, '; ') AS all_compound_synonyms FROM ranked_compounds rc WHERE rc.activity_rank = 1 GROUP BY rc.molregno, rc.molweight, rc.mw_freebase, rc.alogp, rc.hba, rc.hbd, rc.psa, rc.rtb, rc.num_ro5_violations, rc.ro3_pass, rc.med_chem_friendly, aa.strain, aa.cell_line, aa.protein_accession, aa.gene_names, aa.target_synonyms, aa.keywords, aa.protein_sequence, aa.protein_md5sum, aa.ec_number, aa.target_desc, aa.l1, aa.l2, aa.l3, aa.l4, aa.l5, = s.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON s.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON s.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON s.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase IS NOT NULL AND cp.alogp IS NOT NULL AND d.year::INTEGER >= 1999 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 3 AND a.standard_value < 3506.29 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 3.22 AND 1.08 ) SELECT molregno, pref_name, assay_type, standard_type, potency_rank, SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE act.standard_value > 82109.56 AND a.assay_type = 'A' GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 36 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(act.activity_id) AS total_activities FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN '0.0' AND '1000.0' AND cp.mw_freebase > '200.0' AND cp.alogp < '-2.0' GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc HAVING COUNT(act.activity_id) > 772 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '500.0' ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE ac.standard_flag = 1 AND ac.standard_value BETWEEN 915685.68 AND 526289.28 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1947 AND 1995 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ac.molregno) > 36 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_activity ASC;

SELECT a1.assay_id AS assay_id_1, a2.assay_id AS assay_id_2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw FROM activities a JOIN assays a1 ON a.assay_id = a1.assay_id JOIN assays a2 ON a1.doc_id = a2.doc_id AND a1.assay_id < a2.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assay2target at ON a1.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN '0' AND '0' AND cp.mw_freebase > '100' AND td.tax_id = 9658 GROUP BY a1.assay_id, a2.assay_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) > 57 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '10' ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, ', ') AS all_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS distinct_targets, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flagged_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp < '-2' AND act.standard_value BETWEEN '0.1' AND '10000' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2017 AND tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 12 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '1000' ORDER BY distinct_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, MAX(td.tid) AS max_target_id, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities a ON cr.record_id = a.record_id AND c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ay.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase > 592.46 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -2.14 AND 5.75 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2006 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 4 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 5154.91 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) AS num_documents, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms, MAX(td.pref_name) AS target_pref_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS num_targets, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw_freebase, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 738.48 AND 164.01 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 9.17 AND 2.35 AND a2t.confidence >= 1.04 AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 2021 AND 1991 AND act.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY c.molregno, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < 5340.27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 20 AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) >= 1 ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, MAX(cp.hba) AS max_hba, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, SUM(CASE WHEN at.assay_type = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS type_b_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '|') AS all_synonyms, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, STDDEV(cp.mw_freebase) AS stddev_mw, CORR(cp.alogp, a.standard_value) AS alogp_value_correlation FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assay2target a2t ON ass.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON td.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession AND a.standard_type = tp.standard_type WHERE cp.num_ro5_violations >= 5 AND a.standard_value BETWEEN 2370.71 AND 421892.49 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2007 AND a2t.confidence >= 7 AND cp.mw_freebase > 736.38 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < 387.33 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 21 AND SUM(CASE WHEN at.assay_type = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 7 ORDER BY total_activities DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = c.molregno AND cr.doc_id = 760362 ) AND cp.hba >= 17 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY avg_potency ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY td.organism) AS avg_organism_activity, SUM(ac.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY cp.alogp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_alogp, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms_list, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2 FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '500' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 AND ac.standard_value >= '0.1' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2007 AND at.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, td.organism, tc.l1, td.pref_name, tc.l2, ac.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 3 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < '1000' ORDER BY activity_rank, avg_organism_activity DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno LEFT JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND cp.hba >= 12 AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 3 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0' ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, a.assay_type) AS avg_activity_by_type, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.molweight DESC) AS molweight_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '0.0' AND cp.hba >= 17 AND cp.hbd <= 8 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.assay_type LIKE 'B%' AND td.pref_name LIKE '%kinase%' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2007 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 1 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY molweight_rank, avg_activity_by_type DESC LIMIT 219;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activities a2 WHERE a2.molregno = c.molregno AND a2.standard_value > 725.81) AS high_activity_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN docs d ON asy.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.num_ro5_violations < 0 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 0 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2006 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < 407.96 ORDER BY assay_count DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_activity, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l2, '; ') AS target_classes, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS num_targets FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cr.record_id = ac.record_id JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_value > 1807.02 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -2.2 AND 2.28 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 5 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2019 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM target_protein tp WHERE tp.protein_accession = td.protein_accession AND tp.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND tp.standard_value < 209.73 ) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 5 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < 65712.48 ORDER BY avg_activity ASC, num_assays DESC LIMIT 775;

SELECT a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 651.51 AND 130696.51 AND cp.mw_freebase >= 613.36 AND cp.alogp >= 8.77 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (a.assay_type, at.assay_desc), (td.pref_name), (tc.l1, tc.l2), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 45 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, compound_count DESC LIMIT 967;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.published_value) AS min_published_value, MAX(ac.published_value) AS max_published_value FROM compounds c JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.published_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_value > 21471.38 AND d.year::integer >= 2020 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 4 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.hba) AS max_hba_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value > '0.0' AND cp.mw_freebase < '100.0' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 49 ORDER BY assay_count DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_activity_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '501.0' AND at.confidence >= 8 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 8 AND AVG(cp.mw_freebase) < '600.0' ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_molecular_weight ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) AS record_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS target_count, MAX(tc.l3) AS primary_target_class FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE ac.standard_value BETWEEN 752830.03 AND 718838.0 AND cp.mw_freebase >= 358.48 AND a.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) >= 2008) AND td.tax_id = 9801 AND at.confidence >= 4 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 2 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < 521.04 AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) >= 1 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 669;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, SUM( CASE WHEN a.standard_value IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS active_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '500' AND a.standard_value < '0' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2023 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 9 ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_mw;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS num_targets, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v.creation_date) AS data_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM v.creation_date) AS data_month FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN version v ON v.creation_date >= '2010-01-01' WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 707.32 AND 443.88 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 0.85 AND -4.01 AND v.creation_date BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v.creation_date) = 2011.61 AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM v.creation_date) IN (3.42, 3.68) AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY c.molregno, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v.creation_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM v.creation_date) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 4.23 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 7696.15 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_assays DESC LIMIT 958.38;

SELECT c.molregno, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, MAX(cp.hba) AS max_hba, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, SUM(CASE WHEN at.assay_type = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS type_b_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '|') AS all_synonyms, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, STDDEV(cp.mw_freebase) AS stddev_mw, CORR(cp.alogp, a.standard_value) AS alogp_value_correlation FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assay2target a2t ON ass.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON td.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession AND a.standard_type = tp.standard_type WHERE cp.num_ro5_violations >= 5 AND a.standard_value BETWEEN 2255.87 AND 920791.25 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2020 AND a2t.confidence >= 7 AND cp.mw_freebase > 307.02 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < 37.19 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 23 AND SUM(CASE WHEN at.assay_type = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5 ORDER BY total_activities DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity_value, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 48846.14 AND a.standard_value < 99367743.12 AND ass.doc_id IN ( SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1992 AND 2019 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno AND LENGTH(cs.synonyms) > 65 ) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) > 8927.38 ORDER BY avg_activity_value DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1 AS target_class, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM compounds c INNER JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno INNER JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno INNER JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id INNER JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -3.57 AND 4.24 AND c.molweight > 328.92 AND td.tax_id = 9845 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 86 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 8704.87 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, activity_count DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(act.published_value) AS max_published_value, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno AND cs.synonyms IS NOT NULL) AS synonym_count, (SELECT MAX(d.year) FROM docs d WHERE d.doc_id = a.doc_id AND d.year ~ '^[0-9]{4}$') AS latest_year FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.num_ro5_violations <= 4 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '5.0' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_synonyms cs2 WHERE cs2.molregno = c.molregno) > 3 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, a.doc_id HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 31 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 284;

SELECT cp.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cp.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_value > 43.03 AND ac.standard_value < 376600.29 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2007 AND d.year::INTEGER <= 2013 AND cp.mw_freebase >= 470.8 AND cp.mw_freebase <= 799.5 AND at.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY cp.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 34 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) > 511.08 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, num_assays DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS total_activities, COUNT(DISTINCT c.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions FROM target_dictionary t JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a_s.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON t.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession AND a_s.assay_type = tp.assay_type WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '300' AND a_s.doc_id IN ( SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) >= 2009 AND CAST(year AS INTEGER) <= 2006 ) AND a2t.confidence >= 8 AND a.standard_units = 'nM' GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 658 AND AVG(cp.alogp) BETWEEN '-5' AND '-2' ORDER BY total_activities DESC, avg_molecular_weight ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_ro3_pass, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_medchem_friendly FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid AND a2t.confidence > 5 JOIN assays ass ON a2t.assay_id = ass.assay_id AND ass.assay_type = 'B' JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno AND c.molweight > '200' JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 1 JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid AND tc.l1 IS NOT NULL JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id AND d.year::integer > 2014 JOIN compound_records cr ON a.molregno = cr.molregno AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a2t.relationship_type = 'D' AND cp.hba BETWEEN 6 AND 14 AND cp.hbd BETWEEN 0 AND 1 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) > 19 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) >= 34 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_compounds DESC LIMIT 13;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a2t.assay_organism, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_desc, tt.target_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS document_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms_list FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN assays a2 ON a2t.assay_id = a2.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a2.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN activities a ON a2.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase IS NOT NULL AND cp.alogp IS NOT NULL AND d.year >= '2000' AND a.standard_value <= '0.1' AND cp.mw_freebase >= '100' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a2t.assay_organism, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_desc, tt.target_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 67 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT cp.molregno) > 13 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a2t.assay_organism, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS unique_documents, MIN(CAST(d.year AS INTEGER)) AS earliest_year, MAX(CAST(d.year AS INTEGER)) AS latest_year, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms_list FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a_s.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 16757.4 AND a.standard_value < 747321074.13 AND cp.mw_freebase >= 455.92 AND cp.mw_freebase <= 655.27 AND cp.alogp >= -2.16 AND cp.alogp <= 8.58 AND CAST(d.year AS INTEGER) >= 2003 AND CAST(d.year AS INTEGER) <= 2021 AND a2t.confidence >= 7 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a2t.assay_organism, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 86 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 5037.56 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cp.molregno) >= 12 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

WITH compound_activity_stats AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(a.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_standard_activities FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 132309.86 AND CAST(d.year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2005 AND 2002 AND cp.hba >= 6 AND cp.hbd <= 12 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(a.activity_id) > 9 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 3569.22 ) SELECT cas.molregno, cas.molweight, cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.hba, cas.hbd, cas.num_assays, cas.num_activities, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency, cas.num_standard_activities, cs.synonyms AS primary_synonym FROM compound_activity_stats cas LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cas.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE cas.mw_freebase BETWEEN 347.98 AND 313.85 ORDER BY cas.avg_potency ASC, cas.num_activities DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 946230.83 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 208.36 AND 641.09 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations ), ranked_compounds AS ( SELECT cas.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION cas.num_activities DESC ) AS rank_within_group, AVG(cas.avg_standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations = 0 THEN 'No Violations' WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations = 1 THEN 'One Violation' ELSE 'Multiple Violations' END ) AS group_avg_standard_value, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations = 0 THEN 'No Violations' WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations = 1 THEN 'One Violation' ELSE 'Multiple Violations' END ) AS compounds_in_group FROM compound_activity_summary cas WHERE cas.num_activities >= 42 ) SELECT rc.molregno, rc.molweight, rc.mw_freebase, rc.alogp, rc.hba, rc.hbd, rc.psa, rc.rtb, rc.num_ro5_violations, rc.num_assays, rc.num_activities, rc.avg_standard_value, rc.min_standard_value, rc.max_standard_value, rc.rank_within_group, rc.group_avg_standard_value, rc.compounds_in_group, CASE WHEN rc.num_ro5_violations = 0 THEN 'No Violations' WHEN rc.num_ro5_violations = 1 THEN 'One Violation' ELSE 'Multiple Violations' END AS ro5_violation_group FROM ranked_compounds rc WHERE rc.rank_within_group <= 54 ORDER BY rc.num_ro5_violations, rc.rank_within_group;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_units, a.doc_id, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa,
