(PARTITION BY a.molregno, td.target_type) as avg_by_target_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, td.organism) as activity_count_per_organism, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cp.num_ro5_violations DESC, cp.alogp DESC) as compound_rank FROM activities a JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 682375.71 AND 531083.59 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 676.23 AND 894.31 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -4.21 AND 4.27 AND d.pubmed_id > 1466995.94 AND a2t.confidence >= 3.04 AND td.tax_id > 36729.74 AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' AND td.in_drugstore = 1 AND td.in_starlite = 1 ), aggregated_results AS ( SELECT ra.molregno, ra.tid, ra.pref_name, ra.organism, ra.target_type, ra.l1, ra.l2, ra.l3, ra.target_classification, ra.confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) as distinct_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.doc_id) as distinct_documents, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.pubmed_id) as distinct_pubmeds, AVG(ra.standard_value) as avg_activity, MIN(ra.standard_value) as min_activity, MAX(ra.standard_value) as max_activity, STDDEV(ra.standard_value) as stddev_activity, AVG(ra.molweight) as avg_molweight, AVG(ra.mw_freebase) as avg_mw_freebase, AVG(ra.alogp) as avg_alogp, SUM(ra.hba) as total_hba, SUM(ra.hbd) as total_hbd, AVG(ra.psa) as avg_psa, SUM(ra.rtb) as total_rtb, MAX(ra.num_ro5_violations) as max_ro5_violations, ra.activity_rank, ra.avg_by_target_type, ra.activity_count_per_organism, ra.compound_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ra.target_type ORDER BY AVG(ra.standard_value) DESC) as target_type_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) DESC) as assay_count_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ra.standard_value)) as activity_percentile FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.target_classification, ra.confidence_summary, ra.activity_rank, ra.avg_by_target_type, ra.activity_count_per_organism, ra.compound_rank HAVING AVG(ra.standard_value) BETWEEN 45742.74 AND 181419.37 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) >= 72.14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ra.doc_id) > 5.09 AND AVG(ra.alogp) BETWEEN 7.2 AND -4.07 AND SUM(ra.hba) <= 18.96 AND SUM(ra.hbd) <= 0.48 ) SELECT ar.molregno, ar.tid, ar.pref_name as target_name, ar.organism, ar.target_type, ar.l1 as target_class_level1, ar.l2 as target_class_level2, ar.l3 as target_class_level3, ar.target_classification, ar.confidence_summary, ar.total_hbd, ar.avg_psa, ar.total_rtb, ar.max_ro5_violations, ar.activity_rank, ar.avg_by_target_type, ar.activity_count_per_organism, ar.compound_rank, ar.target_type_rank, ar.assay_count_rank, ar.activity_percentile, c.canonical_smiles, c.molformula, cs.synonyms as compound_synonym, d.journal as primary_journal, d.year as publication_year, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ar.avg_activity DESC, ar.distinct_assays DESC) as overall_rank, AVG(ar.avg_activity) OVER (PARTITION BY ar.target_type) as target_type_avg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ar.organism ORDER BY ar.avg_activity DESC) as organism_rank FROM aggregated_results ar JOIN compounds c ON ar.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON ar.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON ar.distinct_documents = d.doc_id WHERE ar.target_type_rank <= 92.01 AND ar.assay_count_rank <= 768.28 AND ar.activity_percentile >= 0.79 ORDER BY ar.avg_activity DESC, ar.distinct_assays DESC, ar.compound_rank, ar.target_type_rank LIMIT 205.69;

WITH ranked_compounds AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(cp.hba) AS min_hba, MAX(cp.hbd) AS max_hbd FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON asy.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 883.84 AND 560.82 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND asy.assay_type = 'B' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < 8680.28 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 4.35 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, MAX(td.tid) AS max_target_id, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities a ON cr.record_id = a.record_id AND c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ay.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase > 339.86 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -1.31 AND 4.14 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2005 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 5 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 2572.28 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS unique_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS unique_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS unique_targets, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_activity_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '100.0' AND cp.alogp < '-5.0' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 5 ORDER BY unique_assays DESC, avg_molecular_weight ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE cp.mw_freebase > 399.86 AND ac.standard_value BETWEEN 4.06 AND 21.38 AND c.molweight < 264.66 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 2 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < 23.77 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c LEFT JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE a.standard_value IS NULL OR (a.standard_value >= 830149.01 AND a.standard_value <= 598905.21) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) < 59.58 OR COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) IS NULL ORDER BY c.molregno LIMIT 993.19;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON s.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 7430.57 AND 1405.08 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 3.33 AND 9.2 AND cp.hba >= 16.88 AND cp.hbd >= 0.48 AND td.tax_id = 9696.37 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < 1941.1 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_potency ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno) AS synonym_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ay.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 814851.08 AND 651580.09 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 4.2 AND 0.46 AND c.molweight BETWEEN 1174.75 AND 184.34 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) > 828109.44 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS num_targets, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l2, '; ') AS target_classes FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno LEFT JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id LEFT JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id LEFT JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type LEFT JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND cp.hba >= 1 AND cp.hbd <= 5 AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 5 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0' ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, num_activities DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value > 93751.06 AND cp.hba <= 6 AND cp.hbd <= 10 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -3.32 AND -2.92 ORDER BY c.molregno, activity_rank LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, conf.confidence_summary, doc.year, doc.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, td.tid) AS avg_potency_per_target, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS potency_rank_per_target FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup conf ON a2t.confidence = conf.confidence JOIN docs doc ON a.doc_id = doc.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = doc.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 230.64 AND 145.48 AND cp.psa BETWEEN 102.39 AND 29.58 AND act.standard_value > 169395.95 AND doc.year::integer BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009 AND a2t.confidence >= 2 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, conf.confidence_summary, doc.year, doc.journal HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) >= 6 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 732817.43 ORDER BY c.molregno, td.tid, potency_rank_per_target;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_type, a.description AS assay_desc, at.assay_desc AS assay_type_desc, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, tc.l3 AS target_class_l3, cl.confidence_summary, d.year AS publication_year, d.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) AS record_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND cp.hba >= 10 AND cp.hbd <= 2 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 AND act.standard_value < '0.1' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2009 AND a2t.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_type, a.description, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 9 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) >= 18 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 620;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.psa, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS doc_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN assay_type atype ON a.assay_type = atype.assay_type JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type LEFT JOIN version v ON v.creation_date = (SELECT MAX(creation_date) FROM version) WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN 2.65 AND 9.25 AND cp.psa BETWEEN 128.98 AND 192.69 AND c.molweight BETWEEN 127.57 AND 409.83 AND act.standard_value BETWEEN 964327.19 AND 282597.81 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2006.35 AND 2008.6 AND at.confidence >= 5.13 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.psa, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 85.6 AND AVG(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) < 279669.15 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE c.molregno IN ( SELECT cr.molregno FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.doc_id = 9030 ) AND cp.hba >= 9 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp HAVING AVG(ac.standard_value) < '0.0' ORDER BY assay_count DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, t.tid, t.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank_in_assay_type FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON a2t.tid = t.tid JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid WHERE act.standard_value > 36566.84 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -2.18 AND -0.88 AND a.assay_type = 'A' AND tc.l1 = 'A' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, t.tid, t.pref_name, tc.l1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 7 ORDER BY activity_rank_in_assay_type, act.standard_value DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT common_molregno, common_tid, total_activities FROM ( SELECT a.molregno AS common_molregno, at.tid AS common_tid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_logp, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw FROM activities a JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ay.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.alogp > '-5' AND cp.mw_freebase < '200' AND d.year::integer >= 2004 AND tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' GROUP BY a.molregno, at.tid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 2 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '0.1' INTERSECT SELECT a.molregno AS common_molregno, at.tid AS common_tid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_logp, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw FROM activities a JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ay.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.hba >= 0 AND cp.hbd <= 1 AND at.confidence > 6 AND tc.l2 = 'Protease' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY a.molregno, at.tid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) <= 48 AND MIN(cp.alogp) > '0' ) AS intersected_results ORDER BY total_activities DESC, common_molregno, common_tid LIMIT 576;

SELECT cp.mol_id, c.molregno, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_in_class FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND act.standard_value > '0.1' AND d.year >= '1990' AND a2t.confidence = 6 GROUP BY cp.mol_id, c.molregno, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 64 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '100' ORDER BY rank_in_class, avg_activity DESC LIMIT 179;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flagged_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.tid) AS target_count, MAX(td.pref_name) AS pref_target_name, AVG(CASE WHEN cl.confidence IS NOT NULL THEN cl.confidence ELSE 0 END) AS avg_confidence_score FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON asy.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value <= '1' AND td.tax_id = 9917 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 49 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS synonyms_list, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT td.pref_name, '; ') AS target_names, SUM(CASE WHEN at.assay_type = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS type_b_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.standard_value) AS median_standard_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assay2target a2t ON ass.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE ( (cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 207.25 AND 584.44 AND cp.alogp >= 0.16) OR (cp.hba >= 7.53 AND cp.hbd <= 0.1 AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 2.26) ) AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2004.19 AND 2006.86 AND (td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' OR a2t.assay_organism = 'Human') AND NOT (tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' AND tc.l2 = 'Protease') AND a.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 31.52 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 6107.23 AND MIN(cp.mw_freebase) >= 277.73 ORDER BY total_activities DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 162.59;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, SUM(cp.mw_freebase) AS total_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT td.pref_name, '; ') AS target_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l2, '; ') AS target_classes, COUNT(DISTINCT at2.tid) AS distinct_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS distinct_docs, MAX(d.year::INTEGER) AS latest_year, MIN(d.year::INTEGER) AS earliest_year FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities a ON cr.record_id = a.record_id AND cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target at2 ON ass.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at2.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id AND a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value >= '0.0' AND cp.mw_freebase <= '100.0' AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1962 AND 2012 AND cp.num_ro5_violations >= 4 AND at2.confidence >= 10 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 14 AND AVG(a.standard_value) BETWEEN '0.0' AND '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT at2.tid) >= 86 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 815;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, at.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, a.assay_id, td.tid, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.published_value) AS min_published_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY act.standard_value) AS median_standard_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON td.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession WHERE (cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '500.0' OR cp.alogp >= '-2.0') AND (cp.hba <= 9 AND cp.hbd <= 0) AND (a2t.confidence >= 8 OR a2t.relationship_type = 'D') AND d.year >= '2000' AND (act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1) AND (tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' OR tc.l2 = 'Kinase') AND NOT (td.organism = 'Homo sapiens') AND (tp.standard_value IS NULL OR tp.standard_value > '0.0') GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, at.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, a.assay_id, td.tid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 23 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.0' AND SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 7 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 685;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase >= '200' AND cp.alogp <= '-5' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a2t.confidence >= 8 AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 42 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, assay_count DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_id, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS document_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.tid) AS target_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY act.standard_value) AS median_standard_value, STDDEV(act.standard_value) AS stddev_standard_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN docs d ON act.doc_id = d.doc_id AND a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 134.37 AND 752.58 AND cp.alogp >= 0.62 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND d.year::integer >= 2019 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_id, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 8 AND AVG(act.standard_value) <= 7959.89 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) >= 13 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, activity_count DESC, target_count DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) DESC, AVG(a.standard_value) ASC) AS activity_rank FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 135.59 AND 374.08 AND cp.alogp <= -0.73 AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 1 AND d.year >= '2000' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 1 AND AVG(a.standard_value) > 744.79 ORDER BY activity_rank LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, at.assay_desc, tt.target_desc, rt.relationship_desc, v.name AS version_name, v.creation_date, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) AS record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.tid) AS target_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.molregno ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank FROM compound_properties cp INNER JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno INNER JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno INNER JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id INNER JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON act.standard_flag = cl.confidence INNER JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type LEFT JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno AND d.doc_id = cr.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value > '0.0' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '500.0' AND cp.alogp >= '-5.0' AND cp.hba <= 7 AND cp.hbd <= 4 AND cp.psa >= '0.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 2 AND d.year >= '2000' AND a2t.confidence > 10 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, act.standard_value, act.published_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, act.published_activity_type, act.activity_comment, cl.confidence_summary, cl.description, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, td.protein_accession, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, at.assay_desc, tt.target_desc, rt.relationship_desc, v.name, v.creation_date HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 44 AND AVG(act.standard_value) > '0.0' ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, activity_count DESC, cp.molregno LIMIT 189;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS target_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ass.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN activities a2 ON cp.molregno = a2.molregno AND a.activity_id != a2.activity_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 400.3 AND 372.19 AND cp.alogp >= -0.08 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2012 AND at.confidence >= 0 GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 2 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 9003.7 ORDER BY total_activities DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) FROM activities a WHERE a.molregno = cp.molregno AND a.standard_value < 14.37) AS high_potency_activities, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = cp.molregno AND cr.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2014)) AS recent_records FROM compound_properties cp WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 651.41 AND 266.59 AND cp.alogp > 2.74 AND cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC, cp.alogp ASC;

SELECT t.target_type, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS num_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM target_dictionary t JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 5467.6 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 430.16 AND 846.1 AND a2t.confidence >= 3 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.target_type, tc.l1, a.assay_type), (t.target_type, tc.l1), (t.target_type), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 63 ORDER BY t.target_type, tc.l1, a.assay_type;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, a.assay_type, at.assay_organism, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flagged_count FROM target_dictionary t JOIN assay2target at ON t.tid = at.tid JOIN assays a ON at.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 213009.13 AND act.standard_value < 82604098.25 AND cp.mw_freebase > 300.52 AND cp.mw_freebase < 714.63 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tid, t.pref_name, a.assay_type, at.assay_organism), (t.tid, t.pref_name, a.assay_type), (t.tid, t.pref_name), (t.tid), () ) ORDER BY t.tid, t.pref_name, a.assay_type, at.assay_organism;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count FROM target_dictionary t INNER JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid INNER JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid INNER JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id INNER JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id INNER JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno INNER JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno INNER JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase > '100.0' AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2023 AND 2010 AND a2t.confidence >= 4 GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 23 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' AND MIN(cp.mw_freebase) >= '100.0' ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.molregno) AS distinct_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT a.doc_id) AS distinct_documents, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target at ON td.tid = at.tid JOIN assays a ON at.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON ac.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN 3.96 AND -2.69 AND cp.mw_freebase >= 355.31 AND ac.standard_value <= 3408.59 AND a.assay_type = 'A' GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.molregno) >= 396 ORDER BY distinct_assays DESC, distinct_compounds DESC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.year::integer BETWEEN 2016 AND 2007 AND a2t.confidence >= 2 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '100.0' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year')) <= d.year::integer GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 32 AND AVG(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) < '0.0' ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, AVG(CASE WHEN a.standard_units = 'nM' THEN a.standard_value ELSE NULL END) AS avg_nm_potency, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays ass ON a2t.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 7346.9 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 176.6 AND 1681.45 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -0.01 AND 7.98 AND a2t.confidence >= 3 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.year, 'YYYY')) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2010 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND ass.assay_type = 'B' GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 16 AND AVG(cp.mw_freebase) < 601.11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cp.molregno) >= 36 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_nm_potency ASC LIMIT 57;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS unique_assays, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.standard_value) AS median_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_compliant_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp, AVG(cp.psa) AS avg_psa, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT d.journal, '; ') AS publishing_journals FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays ass ON a2t.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 2106.92 AND 6501.81 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 882.11 AND 641.27 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -4.84 AND 2.62 AND a2t.confidence >= 0.26 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2006.37 AND 2006.9 AND td.tax_id = 9742.02 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) >= 44.67 AND COUNT(*) >= 721.86 AND AVG(a.standard_value) BETWEEN 3667.31 AND 2563.99 AND SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 40.26 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_potency ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_records cr ON act.molregno = cr.molregno AND act.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 755017.22 AND 21251.77 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 835.2 AND 307.12 AND d.year >= '2000' AND a2t.confidence >= 2.75 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 50.67 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 627702.52 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 140.18 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, compound_count DESC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_ro3_pass, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_medchem_friendly FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid AND a2t.confidence > 7 JOIN assays ass ON a2t.assay_id = ass.assay_id AND ass.assay_type = 'B' JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno AND c.molweight > '200' JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 2 JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid AND tc.l1 IS NOT NULL JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id AND d.year::integer > 2020 JOIN compound_records cr ON a.molregno = cr.molregno AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a2t.relationship_type = 'D' AND cp.hba BETWEEN 2 AND 7 AND cp.hbd BETWEEN 3 AND 4 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) > 17 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) >= 16 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_compounds DESC LIMIT 79;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT a.standard_type) AS num_standard_types, COUNT(DISTINCT a.standard_units) AS num_standard_units, COUNT(DISTINCT a.published_activity_type) AS num_pub_activity_types, COUNT(DISTINCT a.relation) AS num_relations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.doc_id) AS num_documents, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cr.compound_name, '; ') AS all_compound_names FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 883538.72 AND 407850.83 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 1300.93 AND 1817.83 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -9.11 AND -6.46 AND a.standard_flag = 0.93 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 15.92 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 704.61 ), target_classification_summary AS ( SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, td.ec_number, td.tissue, td.cell_line, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS num_assays_linked, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays_with_data, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS num_activities, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS num_unique_compounds, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_activity_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_activity_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ay.assay_type) AS num_assay_types, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT td.gene_names, '; ') AS all_gene_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT td.synonyms, '; ') AS all_target_synonyms FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays ay ON a2t.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN activities a ON ay.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 769540.5 AND 130530.17 AND a2t.confidence >= 6.92 AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 1966.99 AND 1908.32 AND td.tax_id = 608848.88 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, td.ec_number, td.tissue, td.cell_line, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) >= 565.11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 2650.23 ) SELECT 'compound' AS source_type, cas.molregno AS entity_id, cas.molformula AS entity_name, cas.num_assays, cas.num_activities, cas.avg_standard_value, cas.min_standard_value, cas.max_standard_value, cas.num_standard_types, cas.num_standard_units, cas.num_pub_activity_types, cas.num_relations, cas.num_documents, cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.hba, cas.hbd, cas.psa, cas.rtb, cas.num_ro5_violations, cas.all_synonyms, cas.all_compound_names, NULL AS target_classification, NULL AS organism, NULL AS target_type FROM compound_activity_summary cas WHERE cas.molweight BETWEEN 1235.03 AND 1662.36 AND cas.hba BETWEEN 22.75 AND 10.29 AND cas.hbd BETWEEN 27.12 AND 6.12 UNION ALL SELECT 'target' AS source_type, tcs.tid AS entity_id, tcs.pref_name AS entity_name, tcs.num_assays_linked AS num_assays, tcs.num_activities, tcs.avg_activity_value AS avg_standard_value, tcs.min_activity_value AS min_standard_value, tcs.max_activity_value AS max_standard_value, NULL AS num_standard_types, NULL AS num_standard_units, NULL AS num_pub_activity_types, NULL AS num_relations, NULL AS num_documents, NULL AS mw_freebase, NULL AS alogp, NULL AS hba, NULL AS hbd, NULL AS psa, NULL AS rtb, NULL AS num_ro5_violations, NULL AS all_synonyms, NULL AS all_compound_names, tcs.target_classification, tcs.organism, tcs.target_type FROM target_classification_summary tcs WHERE tcs.num_assays_with_data >= 36.45 AND tcs.num_unique_compounds >= 37.56 ORDER BY entity_id, source_type;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.published_activity_type, a.relation, a.activity_comment, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, c.molformula, cs.synonyms, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_desc, d.year, d.journal, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS rank_within_assay, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id) AS activity_count_per_assay FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '200' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2001 AND a.standard_units = 'nM' ), aggregated_compounds AS ( SELECT ra.molregno, ra.pref_name AS target_name, ra.organism, ra.target_type, ra.l1 AS target_class_l1, ra.l2 AS target_class_l2, ra.year, ra.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.standard_type = 'IC50' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ic50_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.standard_type = 'Ki' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ki_count, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_activity, STDDEV(ra.standard_value) AS stddev_activity, AVG(ra.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(ra.alogp) AS avg_alogp, SUM(ra.hba) AS total_hba, SUM(ra.hbd) AS total_hbd, AVG(ra.psa) AS avg_psa, SUM(ra.rtb) AS total_rtb, SUM(ra.num_ro5_violations) AS total_ro5_violations, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.confidence_summary, '; ') AS confidence_levels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.rank_within_assay = 1 AND ra.activity_count_per_assay >= 9 GROUP BY ra.molregno, ra.pref_name, ra.organism, ra.target_type, ra.l1, ra.l2, ra.year, ra.journal HAVING AVG(ra.standard_value) < '1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) > 5 AND SUM(ra.num_ro5_violations) <= 3 ) SELECT ac.*, cp2.ro3_pass, cp2.med_chem_friendly, td2.gene_names, td2.protein_accession, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ac.avg_activity ASC, ac.total_activities DESC) AS compound_rank FROM aggregated_compounds ac JOIN compound_properties cp2 ON ac.molregno = cp2.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON ac.molregno = cr.molregno LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td2 ON cr.doc_id = td2.tid WHERE cp2.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' AND (cp2.ro3_pass = 'Y' OR cp2.ro3_pass IS NULL) AND ac.total_ro5_violations <= 2 ORDER BY compound_rank, ac.avg_activity ASC LIMIT 211;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_units, a.doc_id, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, td.protein_accession, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.target_classification, cl.confidence_summary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, td.tid ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) as activity_rank, AVG(a.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, td.target_type) as avg_by_target_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, td.organism) as activity_count_per_organism, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cp.num_ro5_violations DESC, cp.alogp DESC) as compound_rank FROM activities a JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 689017.45 AND 425182.7 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 248.11 AND 414.74 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 5.81 AND -1.26 AND d.pubmed_id > 2196894.86 AND a2t.confidence >= 9.3 AND td.tax_id > 51985.66 AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' AND td.in_drugstore = 1 AND td.in_starlite = 1 ), aggregated_results AS ( SELECT ra.molregno, ra.tid, ra.pref_name, ra.organism, ra.target_type, ra.l1, ra.l2, ra.l3, ra.target_classification, ra.confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) as distinct_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.doc_id) as distinct_documents, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.pubmed_id) as distinct_pubmeds, AVG(ra.standard_value) as avg_activity, MIN(ra.standard_value) as min_activity, ra.activity_count_per_organism, ra.compound_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ra.target_type ORDER BY AVG(ra.standard_value) DESC) as target_type_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) DESC) as assay_count_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ra.standard_value)) as activity_percentile FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.activity_rank = 1 AND ra.avg_by_target_type > 897222.15 AND ra.activity_count_per_organism >= 235.78 GROUP BY ra.molregno, ra.tid, ra.pref_name, ra.organism, ra.target_type, ra.l1, ra.l2, ra.l3, ra.target_classification, ra.confidence_summary, c.molformula, cs.synonyms as compound_synonym, d.journal as primary_journal, d.year as publication_year, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ar.avg_activity DESC, ar.distinct_assays DESC) as overall_rank, ar.assay_count_rank <= 669.44 AND ar.activity_percentile >= 0.96 ORDER BY ar.avg_activity DESC, ar.distinct_assays DESC, ar.compound_rank, ar.target_type_rank LIMIT 896.61;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_units, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, c.molformula, cs.synonyms, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, ass.assay_type, ass.description AS assay_description, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence, a2t.relationship_type, td.pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.ec_number, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS rn FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 646.24 AND 657.44 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2012 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 ), aggregated_compounds AS ( SELECT ra.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_activity, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.pref_name, '; ') AS target_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.l1 || ':' || ra.l2, '; ') AS target_classes FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.rn = 1 GROUP BY ra.molregno ), correlated_stats AS ( SELECT ac.molregno, ac.num_assays, ac.avg_activity, ac.min_activity, ac.max_activity, ac.ro3_pass_count, ac.med_chem_friendly_count, ac.all_synonyms, ac.target_names, ac.target_classes, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a2.assay_id) FROM activities a2 WHERE a2.molregno = ac.molregno AND a2.standard_value > (SELECT AVG(standard_value) FROM activities WHERE assay_id = a2.assay_id) ) AS assays_above_avg FROM aggregated_compounds ac ) SELECT cs.molregno, cs.num_assays, cs.avg_activity, cs.min_activity, cs.max_activity, cs.ro3_pass_count, cs.med_chem_friendly_count, cs.assays_above_avg, cs.all_synonyms, cs.target_names, cs.target_classes, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, c.molweight, c.molformula, c.canonical_smiles, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = cs.molregno AND cr.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1993 AND 2004) ) AS records_in_period FROM correlated_stats cs JOIN compound_properties cp ON cs.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON cs.molregno = c.molregno WHERE cs.num_assays >= 42 AND cs.avg_activity <= 1290.34 AND cs.assays_above_avg >= 0 ORDER BY cs.avg_activity ASC, cs.num_assays DESC LIMIT 379;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.ro3_pass, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, td.organism, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS rn FROM activities a JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ay.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 73659.6 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 623.89 AND 228.59 ) SELECT ra.assay_type, ra.assay_desc, ra.pref_name AS target_name, ra.organism AS target_organism, ra.confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_potency, AVG(ra.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(ra.alogp) AS avg_logp, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_compliant_count FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.rn = 1 GROUP BY ra.assay_type, ra.assay_desc, ra.pref_name, ra.organism, ra.confidence_summary HAVING AVG(ra.standard_value) < 96726.65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ra.molregno) >= 26 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, unique_compounds DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS active_compounds FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value <= '0.1' AND a.doc_id IN ( SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) >= 2015 ) AND act.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY a.assay_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 97 ORDER BY active_compounds DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.journal, d.year, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT act.record_id) AS total_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value BETWEEN 8772.02 AND 6542.8 AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 2016 AND 2004 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.journal, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 47 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_potency ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.record_id) AS total_activities, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_flag = 1 AND ac.standard_value > 11658.47 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2007 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ac.molregno) > 49 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < 73872.26 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, d.year, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM assays a JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id WHERE d.year::integer BETWEEN 1996 AND 1995 AND a.assay_type = 'A' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, d.year HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.molregno) >= 31 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_activity DESC LIMIT 583;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, t.tid, t.pref_name AS target_name, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON a2t.tid = t.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 645775.56 AND 25097.49 AND t.tax_id = 73072.13 AND a2t.confidence >= 3.34 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, t.tid, t.pref_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 506.85 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING ) AS mw_moving_avg_activity, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 187.71 AND 1195.78 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2007 AND a2t.confidence >= 10 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, td.organism, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 20 ORDER BY num_compounds DESC, mw_moving_avg_activity LIMIT 500;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.assay_type IN (SELECT assay_type FROM assay_type WHERE assay_desc LIKE '%cell-based%') AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '500' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-2' AND '2' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0' AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2004 AND 2022 AND at.confidence >= 5 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 12 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '100' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 983;

SELECT a.assay_id, td.pref_name, cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_id, cp.molregno) AS avg_activity_per_assay_compound, COUNT(act.activity_id) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_id) AS activity_count_per_assay, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cp.alogp DESC) AS alogp_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.target_type ORDER BY cp.hba DESC) AS hba_rank_per_target_type FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -0.11 AND 9.55 AND cp.hba >= 6 AND d.year::integer >= 2002 AND a2t.confidence = 6 GROUP BY a.assay_id, td.pref_name, td.target_type, cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, act.standard_value, act.activity_id HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) > 67500.31 ORDER BY avg_activity_per_assay_compound DESC, alogp_rank LIMIT 100;

SELECT a1.assay_id AS primary_assay, a2.assay_id AS related_assay, t.pref_name AS target_name, COUNT(DISTINCT act1.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act1.standard_value) AS avg_potency FROM assays a1 JOIN assays a2 ON a1.assay_type = a2.assay_type AND a1.assay_id != a2.assay_id JOIN assay2target at1 ON a1.assay_id = at1.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at1.tid = t.tid JOIN activities act1 ON a1.assay_id = act1.assay_id JOIN activities act2 ON a2.assay_id = act2.assay_id AND act1.molregno = act2.molregno WHERE act1.standard_value BETWEEN 797803.87 AND 382471.23 AND at1.confidence >= 2.3 AND t.tax_id = 9795.23 GROUP BY a1.assay_id, a2.assay_id, t.pref_name HAVING AVG(act1.standard_value) < 1962.72 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp < '-2' AND d.year >= '2010' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 9 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c LEFT JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno LEFT JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id LEFT JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 459753.17 AND d.year::integer >= 2001 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 81 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 7013938.19 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 215;
