SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_activity, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_activity_count, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay_type aty ON ay.assay_type = aty.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON ay.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN '0' AND '0' AND cp.mw_freebase > '100' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '-5' AND a.standard_flag = 0 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 8 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '0' ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_activity ASC;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp < '-2' AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2012 AND 2008 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) > '0' ORDER BY assay_count DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS unique_targets, SUM(CASE WHEN tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enzyme_targets, AVG(CASE WHEN atp.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' THEN a.standard_value END) AS human_avg_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay2target atp ON ass.assay_id = atp.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON atp.tid = t.tid JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON atp.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 301.02 AND 749.91 AND cp.alogp >= 3.53 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2022 AND 2015 AND atp.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 50 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 1435.74 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) >= 1 ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(a.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.molregno) AS avg_activity_value, MIN(cs.synonyms) AS sample_synonym, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-2' AND '3' GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 7 ORDER BY num_assays DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_activities, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT td.pref_name) AS target_names, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.tc_id) AS target_classes_count FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON asy.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN docs d ON asy.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 13 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT tc.tc_id) >= 4 ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 61;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a2t.tid, td.pref_name, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200.0' AND '300.0' AND td.tax_id = 9631 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.molregno IN ( SELECT DISTINCT cr.molregno FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.doc_id IN ( SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) >= 2018 ) ) GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a2t.tid, td.pref_name HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) <= '0.1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 3 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, td.organism, d.year, cl.confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY act.standard_value) AS median_standard_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS target_rank FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '100' AND cp.alogp >= '-5' AND cp.hba <= 6 AND cp.hbd <= 2 AND a2t.confidence >= 3 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2018 AND td.tax_id = 9851 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, td.organism, d.year, cl.confidence_summary, td.tid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 32 AND AVG(act.standard_value) <= '0' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.organism ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS potency_rank_by_organism, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l2) AS avg_potency_per_target_class, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.num_ro5_violations) AS compounds_per_ro5_violation FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at2.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value > 91683.6 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -9.75 AND -4.95 AND cp.hba >= 15 AND cp.hbd >= 8 AND d.year::integer >= 2011 AND at2.confidence >= 10 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 96 ORDER BY potency_rank_by_organism, avg_potency_per_target_class DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS document_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.tid) AS target_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_organism) AS organism_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank_by_class FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND cp.hba >= 1 AND cp.hbd <= 1 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.assay_type IN ( SELECT assay_type FROM assays WHERE doc_id IN ( SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE year::integer >= 2001 ) ) AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a2t.confidence >= 7 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 1 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

cl.description, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence, a2t.relationship_type, a2t.assay_organism, a2t.assay_strain, td.pref_name, td.gene_names, td.organism, td.protein_accession, td.target_type, tt.target_desc, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification HAVING COUNT(act.activity_id) > 9 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 779095.37 ORDER BY cp.molregno, a.assay_type, SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS target_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS document_count, MIN(CAST(d.year AS INTEGER)) AS earliest_year, MAX(CAST(d.year AS INTEGER)) AS latest_year FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ay.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 767750.95 AND 374769.44 AND CAST(d.year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1994 AND 1968 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 1761.9 AND 1683.19 GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 99 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 811622.66 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS num_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ac.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS min_standard_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.med_chem_friendly ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) DESC, AVG(ac.standard_value) ASC NULLS LAST) AS rank_within_medchem FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cr.record_id = ac.record_id JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '1000' AND cp.alogp > '-5' AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 6 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < '0' ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp1.molregno AS molregno1, cp2.molregno AS molregno2, a1.assay_id AS assay_id1, a2.assay_id AS assay_id2, td1.pref_name AS target1, td2.pref_name AS target2, tc1.l1 AS class_l1_1, tc2.l1 AS cp1.molregno = cs1.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs2 ON cp2.molregno = cs2.molregno JOIN compound_records cr1 ON cp1.molregno = cr1.molregno JOIN compound_records cr2 ON cp2.molregno = cr2.molregno JOIN activities ac1 ON cr1.record_id = ac1.record_id JOIN activities ac2 ON cr2.record_id = ac2.record_id JOIN assays a1 ON ac1.assay_id = a1.assay_id JOIN assays a2 ON ac2.assay_id = a2.assay_id JOIN assay2target at1 ON a1.assay_id = at1.assay_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON a2.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td1 ON at1.tid = td1.tid JOIN target_dictionary td2 ON at2.tid = td2.tid JOIN target_class tc1 ON td1.tid = tc1.tid JOIN target_class tc2 ON td2.tid = tc2.tid JOIN docs d1 ON a1.doc_id = d1.doc_id JOIN docs d2 ON a2.doc_id = d2.doc_id WHERE cp1.mw_freebase BETWEEN 479.28 AND 462.36 AND cp2.mw_freebase BETWEEN 358.33 AND 809.35 AND ac1.standard_value > 89590.81 AND ac2.standard_value > 63818.87 AND d1.year::INTEGER >= 1997 AND d2.year::INTEGER >= 2005 AND at1.confidence >= SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS total_activities, COUNT(DISTINCT c.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions FROM target_dictionary t JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a_s.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON t.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession AND a_s.assay_type = tp.assay_type WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '300' AND a_s.doc_id IN ( SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) >= 2012 AND CAST(year AS INTEGER) <= 2022 ) AND a2t.confidence >= 6 AND a.standard_units = 'nM' GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 422 AND AVG(cp.alogp) BETWEEN '-5' AND '-2' ORDER BY total_activities DESC, avg_molecular_weight ASC LIMIT 100;

WITH ranked_compounds AS ( SELECT c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, ac.standard_value, ac.standard_units, ac.standard_type, d.year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_id ORDER BY ac.standard_value DESC) AS potency_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE ac.standard_value > 86158.99 AND d.year::integer >= 2019 ) SELECT assay_id, molregno, mw_freebase, alogp, standard_value, standard_units, year, potency_rank FROM ranked_compounds WHERE potency_rank <= 7 ORDER BY assay_id, potency_rank;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.year, 'YYYY')) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2006 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '100.0' GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) > '0.0' ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC;

SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS active_assays, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency FROM activities a JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN assay_type t ON s.assay_type = t.assay_type WHERE a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value < '0.1' GROUP BY a.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 10 UNION ALL SELECT cr.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS active_assays, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency FROM compound_records cr JOIN activities a ON cr.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id WHERE a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > '1000' AND cr.doc_id = 288 GROUP BY cr.molregno HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < '10000' ORDER BY active_assays DESC, avg_potency DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS num_targets, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_compliant_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, MAX(act.doc_id) AS latest_doc_id, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.l1) AS target_classes_l1, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value <= 17.8) AS high_potency_activities, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase) AS median_mw, AVG(CASE WHEN at.assay_type = 'B' THEN act.standard_value ELSE NULL END) AS avg_binding_potency FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON a2t.tid = t.tid JOIN target_type tt ON t.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON act.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN relationship_type rt ON a2t.relationship_type = rt.relationship_type LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON t.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession AND a.assay_type = tp.assay_type WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 213.59 AND 739.93 AND d.year::integer >= 2013 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND (act.relation IS NULL OR act.relation IN ('=', '~')) GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 6 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 4476.48 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) > 4 AND SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 0 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase) BETWEEN 310.44 AND 502.11 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_assays DESC LIMIT 532;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.record_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno) AS num_synonyms FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN -0.87 AND -4.81 AND cp.hba BETWEEN 9.3 AND 6.46 AND cp.hbd BETWEEN 2.55 AND 4.38 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 71.54 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 2.27 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 3168.31 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_activities DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism) AS avg_activity_per_assay_organism, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism) AS count_activities_per_assay_organism, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id AND act.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value > '0.0' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '0.0' AND '0.0' AND cp.alogp >= '-10.0' AND d.year::integer >= 1929 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 4 AND act.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal, td.organism HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) > 24 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.0' ORDER BY activity_rank, avg_activity_per_assay_organism DESC;

331.93 AND 876.42 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations ), ranked_compounds AS ( SELECT cas.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations = 0 THEN 'No Violations' WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations = 1 THEN 'One Violation' ELSE 'Multiple Violations' END ORDER BY cas.avg_standard_value DESC, cas.num_activities DESC ) AS rank_within_group, AVG(cas.avg_standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations = 0 THEN 'No Violations' WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations = 1 THEN 'One Violation' ELSE 'Multiple Violations' END ) AS group_avg_standard_value, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations = 0 THEN 'No Violations' WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations = 1 THEN 'One Violation' ELSE 'Multiple Violations' END ) AS compounds_in_group FROM compound_activity_summary cas WHERE cas.num_activities >= 1 ) SELECT rc.molregno, rc.molweight, rc.mw_freebase, rc.alogp, rc.hba, rc.hbd, rc.psa, rc.rtb, rc.num_ro5_violations, rc.num_assays, rc.num_activities, rc.avg_standard_value, rc.min_standard_value, rc.max_standard_value, rc.rank_within_group, rc.group_avg_standard_value, rc.compounds_in_group, CASE WHEN rc.num_ro5_violations = 0 THEN 'No Violations' WHEN rc.num_ro5_violations = 1 THEN 'One Violation' ELSE 'Multiple Violations' END AS ro5_violation_group FROM ranked_compounds rc WHERE rc.rank_within_group <= 74 ORDER BY rc.num_ro5_violations, rc.rank_within_group;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_units, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, c.molformula, cs.synonyms, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, ass.assay_type, ass.description AS assay_description, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence, a2t.relationship_type, td.pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.ec_number, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS rn FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 578.95 AND 751.53 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2017 AND a2t.confidence >= 6 ), aggregated_compounds AS ( SELECT ra.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_activity, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.pref_name, '; ') AS target_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.l1 || ':' || ra.l2, '; ') AS target_classes FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.rn = 1 GROUP BY ra.molregno ), correlated_stats AS ( SELECT ac.molregno, ac.num_assays, ac.avg_activity, ac.min_activity, ac.max_activity, ac.ro3_pass_count, ac.med_chem_friendly_count, ac.all_synonyms, ac.target_names, ac.target_classes, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a2.assay_id) FROM activities a2 WHERE a2.molregno = ac.molregno AND a2.standard_value > (SELECT AVG(standard_value) FROM activities WHERE assay_id = a2.assay_id) ) AS assays_above_avg FROM aggregated_compounds ac ) SELECT cs.molregno, cs.num_assays, cs.avg_activity, cs.min_activity, cs.max_activity, cs.ro3_pass_count, cs.med_chem_friendly_count, cs.assays_above_avg, cs.all_synonyms, cs.target_names, cs.target_classes, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, c.molweight, c.molformula, c.canonical_smiles, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = cs.molregno AND cr.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1991 AND 2010) ) AS records_in_period FROM correlated_stats cs JOIN compound_properties cp ON cs.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON cs.molregno = c.molregno WHERE cs.num_assays >= 31 AND cs.avg_activity <= 8862.74 AND cs.assays_above_avg >= 4 ORDER BY cs.avg_activity ASC, cs.num_assays DESC LIMIT 19;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type, a.relation, a.published_activity_type, at.assay_desc, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.protein_accession, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, tc.l3 AS target_class_l3, a2t.confidence AS assay_target_confidence, cl.confidence_summary, d.year AS publication_year, d.journal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.assay_id IN (SELECT assay_id FROM assay2target WHERE tid = td.tid) LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id AND td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > '0' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '100' AND cp.alogp >= '-5' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2001 AND a2t.confidence >= 2 ), aggregated_targets AS ( SELECT ra.molregno, ra.target_name, ra.target_organism, ra.target_class_l1, ra.target_class_l2, ra.assay_target_confidence, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.activity_rank = 1 GROUP BY ra.molregno, ra.target_name, ra.target_organism, ra.target_class_l1, ra.target_class_l2, ra.assay_target_confidence HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) >= 9 AND AVG(ra.standard_value) < '0' ) SELECT at.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cs.synonyms AS compound_synonym, at.target_name, at.target_organism, at.target_class_l1, at.target_class_l2, at.num_assays, at.avg_standard_value, at.min_standard_value, at.max_standard_value, at.ro3_pass_count, at.med_chem_friendly_count, at.assay_target_confidence, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY at.avg_standard_value ASC, at.num_assays DESC) AS overall_rank FROM aggregated_targets at JOIN compounds c ON at.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON at.molregno = cs.molregno ORDER BY overall_rank, at.molregno, at.target_name LIMIT 381;

SELECT a.assay_id, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS active_compounds FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value <= '0.1' AND a.doc_id IN ( SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) >= 2007 ) AND act.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY a.assay_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 12 ORDER BY active_compounds DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value > 765765.37 AND act.standard_value < 762429.67 GROUP BY a.assay_id ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 884482.59 AND a.assay_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT a2t.assay_id FROM assay2target a2t JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid WHERE td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' ) GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < 4271.29 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(act.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, cl.confidence_summary FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at2.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_flag = 1 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND (act.standard_value > '100.0' OR act.standard_value < '0.0') AND a.assay_type IN ('A', 'A') AND d.year >= '1990' AND at2.confidence >= 3 AND NOT (td.organism = 'Escherichia coli' AND tc.l1 = 'Enzyme') GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, cl.confidence_summary HAVING COUNT(act.activity_id) > 56 AND AVG(act.standard_value) BETWEEN '1.0' AND '10.0' ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 646;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, d.year, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw FROM assays a JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE d.year::integer >= 2000 AND d.year::integer <= 1998 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase > 343.53 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 71 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, d.year, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw FROM assays a JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE d.year::integer >= 2009 AND d.year::integer <= 1992 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase > 985.61 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 11 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY act.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 3 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_logp FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE act.standard_value > 956885.3 AND cp.mw_freebase < 760.61 AND cp.hba >= 10 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 57 ORDER BY a.assay_type, moving_avg_activity DESC;

SELECT a1.assay_id AS primary_assay, a2.assay_id AS related_assay, t.pref_name AS target_name, COUNT(DISTINCT act1.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act1.standard_value) AS avg_potency FROM assays a1 JOIN assays a2 ON a1.assay_type = a2.assay_type AND a1.assay_id != a2.assay_id JOIN assay2target at1 ON a1.assay_id = at1.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at1.tid = t.tid JOIN activities act1 ON a1.assay_id = act1.assay_id JOIN activities act2 ON a2.assay_id = act2.assay_id AND act1.molregno = act2.molregno WHERE act1.standard_value BETWEEN 460790.0 AND 911089.67 AND at1.confidence >= 5.74 AND t.tax_id = 9860.63 GROUP BY a1.assay_id, a2.assay_id, t.pref_name HAVING AVG(act1.standard_value) < 30410.83 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_names FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 994.18 AND 1018.63 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -2.18 AND -0.64 AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 4.22 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 6649.57 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_potency ASC LIMIT 784.81;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, ', ') AS all_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS distinct_targets, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flagged_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp < '-2' AND act.standard_value BETWEEN '0.1' AND '10000' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2001 AND tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 20 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '1000' ORDER BY distinct_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, MAX(cp.hba) AS max_hba, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, SUM(CASE WHEN at.assay_type = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS type_b_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '|') AS all_synonyms, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, STDDEV(cp.mw_freebase) AS stddev_mw, CORR(cp.alogp, a.standard_value) AS alogp_value_correlation FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assay2target a2t ON ass.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON td.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession AND a.standard_type = tp.standard_type WHERE cp.num_ro5_violations >= 3 AND a.standard_value BETWEEN 9468.68 AND 306564.39 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2022 AND a2t.confidence >= 5 AND cp.mw_freebase > 255.79 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < 821.4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 4 AND SUM(CASE WHEN at.assay_type = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 13 ORDER BY total_activities DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno LEFT JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND cp.hba >= 20 AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 4 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0' ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, CASE WHEN cp.num_ro5_violations = 0 AND cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' AND cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 'High' WHEN cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 AND cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS compound_quality, CASE WHEN cl.confidence = 9 THEN 'Definitive' WHEN cl.confidence = 8 THEN 'High' WHEN cl.confidence = 7 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS target_confidence FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0.1' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND td.tax_id = 9938 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 43 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno ) AS num_synonyms FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ay.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 392.24 AND 776.66 AND c.molweight BETWEEN 158.51 AND 715.32 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 0.29 AND 0.54 AND cp.hbd <= 9.85 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2.45 AND ay.assay_type = 'B' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 60.13 AND AVG(a.standard_value) BETWEEN 577.08 AND 387.29 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, num_activities DESC LIMIT 497.94;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE a.activity_id IN ( SELECT activity_id FROM activities WHERE assay_id IN ( SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE doc_id IN ( SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2009 ) ) ) AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '-5.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 5 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < '0.0' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.alogp, cp.psa, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 355.59 AND 988.04 AND a.assay_type LIKE 'A' AND td.organism LIKE 'A' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.alogp, cp.psa HAVING AVG(ac.standard_value) < 89258.28 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 66.93 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, assay_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity_value, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE c.molregno IN ( SELECT cr.molregno FROM compound_records cr JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.year::integer BETWEEN 2007 AND 2008 ) AND cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-2' AND '-2' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY avg_activity_value ASC LIMIT 36;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS target_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ass.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN activities a2 ON cp.molregno = a2.molregno AND a.activity_id != a2.activity_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 157.07 AND 666.05 AND cp.alogp >= -4.46 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2011 AND at.confidence >= 8 GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 40 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 6508.15 ORDER BY total_activities DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-2' AND '2' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 5 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY cp.molregno LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description AS assay_description, t.tid, t.pref_name AS target_pref_name, t.organism AS target_organism, t.target_type, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, d.year AS doc_year, d.journal AS doc_journal, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.molregno, t.tid) AS avg_activity_per_target, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tid ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS activity_rank_per_target FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '400' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2018 GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, t.target_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 1 ORDER BY cp.molregno, t.tid, act.standard_value DESC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a2t.assay_organism, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS unique_documents, MIN(CAST(d.year AS INTEGER)) AS earliest_year, MAX(CAST(d.year AS INTEGER)) AS latest_year, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms_list FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a_s.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 4402.9 AND a.standard_value < 616114256.5 AND cp.mw_freebase >= 498.72 AND cp.mw_freebase <= 1306.53 AND cp.alogp >= -3.6 AND cp.alogp <= 9.31 AND CAST(d.year AS INTEGER) >= 2014 AND CAST(d.year AS INTEGER) <= 2020 AND a2t.confidence >= 7 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a2t.assay_organism, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 88 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 2072.29 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cp.molregno) >= 48 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

WITH assay_stats AS ( SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.doc_id, d.year::INTEGER AS publication_year, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0' AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1932 AND 1955 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.doc_id, d.year::INTEGER ), target_info AS ( SELECT at.assay_id, at.tid, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2 FROM assay2target at JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE at.confidence >= 6 ) SELECT ti.target_name, ti.target_organism, ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2, ast.assay_type, ast.publication_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ast.assay_id) AS num_assays, SUM(ast.unique_compounds) AS total_unique_compounds, AVG(ast.avg_standard_value) AS overall_avg_value, MIN(ast.min_standard_value) AS overall_min_value, MAX(ast.max_standard_value) AS overall_max_value FROM target_info ti JOIN assay_stats ast ON ti.assay_id = ast.assay_id GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ti.target_name, ti.target_organism, ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2, ast.assay_type, ast.publication_year), (ti.target_name, ti.target_organism, ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2), (ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2, ast.assay_type), (ti.target_class_l1, ast.assay_type, ast.publication_year), () ) HAVING SUM(ast.unique_compounds) >= 37 ORDER BY total_unique_compounds DESC, overall_avg_value DESC;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.record_id) AS distinct_records, AVG(a.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_value <= 326.11 AND a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS potent_activities FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno LEFT JOIN activities a ON cr.record_id = a.record_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 952.01 AND 785.58 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 3.31 AND 0.23 AND (c.molweight IS NULL OR c.molweight BETWEEN 229.12 AND 996.41) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 8.21 ), target_class_aggregates AS ( SELECT tc.tid, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, MAX(tc.l5) AS max_l5, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.tc_id) AS class_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.target_classification, '; ' ORDER BY tc.target_classification) AS classifications FROM target_class tc WHERE tc.l1 IS NOT NULL AND tc.l2 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tc.tid, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4 ), assay_target_details AS ( SELECT a2t.assay_id, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence, a2t.relationship_type, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, td.protein_accession, td.gene_names, tca.l1, tca.l2, tca.classifications FROM assay2target a2t JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class_aggregates tca ON a2t.tid = tca.tid WHERE a2t.confidence >= 4.45 AND (td.organism IS NOT NULL OR td.target_type IS NOT NULL) ), nested_activity_analysis AS ( SELECT cas.molregno, cas.molweight, cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.hba, cas.hbd, cas.psa, cas.rtb, cas.num_ro5_violations, cas.ro3_pass, cas.med_chem_friendly, cas.distinct_assays, cas.distinct_records, cas.avg_standard_value, cas.min_standard_value, cas.max_standard_value, cas.potent_activities, atd.assay_id, atd.tid, atd.confidence, atd.relationship_type, atd.pref_name, atd.organism, atd.target_type, atd.protein_accession, atd.gene_names, atd.l1, atd.l2, atd.classifications, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cas.molregno ORDER BY atd.confidence DESC, atd.assay_id) AS target_rank FROM compound_activity_summary cas LEFT JOIN activities a ON cas.molregno = a.molregno LEFT JOIN assay_target_details atd ON a.assay_id = atd.assay_id WHERE cas.potent_activities >= 81.37 AND (a.standard_value IS NOT NULL OR atd.tid IS NOT NULL) ), final_aggregated AS ( SELECT naa.molregno, naa.molweight, naa.mw_freebase, naa.alogp, naa.hba, naa.hbd, naa.psa, naa.rtb, naa.num_ro5_violations, naa.ro3_pass, naa.med_chem_friendly, naa.distinct_assays, naa.distinct_records, naa.avg_standard_value, naa.min_standard_value, naa.max_standard_value, naa.potent_activities, COUNT(DISTINCT naa.tid) AS distinct_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT naa.assay_id) AS distinct_target_assays, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT naa.pref_name, '; ' ORDER BY naa.pref_name) AS target_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT naa.organism, '; ' ORDER BY naa.organism) AS target_organisms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT naa.target_type, '; ' ORDER BY naa.target_type) AS target_types, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT naa.l1, '; ' ORDER BY naa.l1) AS target_l1_classes, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT naa.l2, '; ' ORDER BY naa.l2) AS target_l2_classes, MAX(naa.confidence) AS max_confidence, AVG(naa.confidence) AS avg_confidence FROM nested_activity_analysis naa WHERE naa.target_rank <= 10.02 GROUP BY naa.molregno, naa.molweight, naa.mw_freebase, naa.alogp, naa.hba, naa.hbd, naa.psa, naa.rtb, naa.num_ro5_violations, naa.ro3_pass, naa.med_chem_friendly, naa.distinct_assays, naa.distinct_records, naa.avg_standard_value, naa.min_standard_value, naa.max_standard_value, naa.potent_activities HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT naa.tid) >= 4.96 AND AVG(naa.confidence) > 6.54 ) SELECT fa.*, cs.synonyms AS compound_synonym, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, cl.confidence_summary, cl.description AS confidence_description, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fa.potent_activities DESC, fa.distinct_targets DESC) AS activity_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fa.target_l1_classes, fa.target_l2_classes) AS class_rank FROM final_aggregated fa LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON fa.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN activities a ON fa.molregno = a.molregno LEFT JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id LEFT JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON fa.max_confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE fa.avg_standard_value BETWEEN 1445.17 AND 20416.15 AND (d.year IS NULL OR d.year::integer BETWEEN 2019.71 AND 2013.06) ORDER BY fa.potent_activities DESC, fa.distinct_targets DESC, fa.avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 292.85;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, act.published_value, act.published_activity_type, act.published_units, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY c.molregno ORDER BY act.standard_value ASC ) AS best_activity_rank, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.molregno, a.assay_type ) AS assays_per_type, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.molregno, act.standard_type ) AS avg_activity_by_type FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 764791.11 AND d.year::integer >= 2016 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 5.06 AND 6.04 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 413.79 AND 235.74 ) SELECT molregno, molweight, mw_freebase, alogp, hba, hbd, psa, rtb, num_ro5_violations, ro3_pass, med_chem_friendly, assay_type, standard_value, standard_type, standard_units, published_value, published_activity_type, published_units, doc_id, year, journal, best_activity_rank, assays_per_type, avg_activity_by_type, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, MIN(standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(standard_value) AS max_activity FROM compound_activity_summary WHERE best_activity_rank = 1 GROUP BY molregno, molweight, mw_freebase, alogp, hba, hbd, psa, rtb, num_ro5_violations, ro3_pass, med_chem_friendly, assay_type, standard_value, standard_type, standard_units, published_value, published_activity_type, published_units, doc_id, year, journal, best_activity_rank, assays_per_type, avg_activity_by_type HAVING COUNT(*) > 26 ORDER BY standard_value ASC, molweight DESC LIMIT 926;

td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays ass ON a2t.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN ') AS all_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.pref_name, '; ') AS target_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.l1 || ':' || ra.l2, '; ') AS target_classes FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.rn = 1 GROUP BY ra.molregno ), correlated_stats AS ( SELECT ac.molregno, ac.num_assays, ac.avg_activity, ac.min_activity, ac.max_activity, ac.ro3_pass_count, ac.med_chem_friendly_count, ac.all_synonyms, ac.target_names, ac.target_classes, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a2.assay_id) FROM activities a2 WHERE a2.molregno = ac.molregno AND a2.standard_value > (SELECT AVG(standard_value) FROM activities WHERE assay_id = a2.assay_id) ) AS assays_above_avg FROM aggregated_compounds ac ) SELECT cs.molregno, cs.num_assays, cs.avg_activity, cs.min_activity, cs.max_activity, cs.ro3_pass_count, cs.med_chem_friendly_count, cs.assays_above_avg, cs.all_synonyms, cs.target_names, cs.target_classes, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, c.molweight, c.molformula, c.canonical_smiles, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = cs.molregno AND cr.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1994 AND 2003) ) AS records_in_period FROM correlated_stats cs JOIN compound_properties cp ON cs.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON cs.molregno = c.molregno WHERE cs.num_assays >= 36 AND cs.avg_activity <= 4436.75 AND cs.assays_above_avg >= 1 ORDER BY cs.avg_activity ASC, cs.num_assays DESC LIMIT 280;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, doc.year, doc.journal, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY cp.molregno, a.assay_type ORDER BY doc.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_activity FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs doc ON a.doc_id = doc.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 737.0 AND 384.51 AND cp.alogp >= 4.36 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND doc.year::integer >= 2002 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, doc.year, doc.journal HAVING COUNT(act.activity_id) > 9 ORDER BY cp.molregno, doc.year;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.record_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 256.65 AND 312.15 AND cp.alogp >= 2.69 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2017 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 7 AND AVG(a.standard_value) <= 2501.65 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT td.pref_name, a.assay_type, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND td.tax_id = 10014 GROUP BY td.pref_name, a.assay_type, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 14 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, compound_count DESC LIMIT 100;

act.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON
