cp.molregno) AS avg_activity_per_target_compound, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS activity_rank_per_target FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase <= '50.0' AND cp.alogp NOT BETWEEN '-10.0' AND '5.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations > 3 AND d.year < '1990' AND a2t.confidence < 1 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, at.assay_type, cp.molregno, cs.synonyms, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.description, act.activity_id, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5 HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) <= '10000.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) < 27 ORDER BY tid, activity_rank_per_target;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a2t.confidence > 5 AND a2t.multi = 0 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200.0' AND '501.0' AND td.tax_id = 9996 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_units = 'nM' GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 17 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' UNION ALL SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) AS doc_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, AVG(cp.hba) AS avg_hba, MAX(cp.hbd) AS max_hbd, MIN(cp.psa) AS min_psa FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a2t.confidence <= 1 AND cp.num_ro5_violations = 0 AND cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Yes' AND td.in_drugstore = 1 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2008 AND 2015 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) >= 5 AND AVG(cp.hba) > 3 AND MAX(cp.hbd) < 3 ORDER BY tid, pref_name;

WITH compound_activity_stats AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(a.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_standard_activities FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 716780.58 AND CAST(d.year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2014 AND cp.hba >= 8 AND cp.hbd <= 0 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(a.activity_id) > 78 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 7156.02 ) SELECT cas.molregno, cas.molweight, cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.hba, cas.hbd, cas.num_assays, cas.num_activities, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency, cas.num_standard_activities, cs.synonyms AS primary_synonym FROM compound_activity_stats cas LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cas.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE cas.mw_freebase BETWEEN 407.45 AND 685.65 ORDER BY cas.avg_potency ASC, cas.num_activities DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 441127.77 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 168.3 AND 905.26 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations ), ranked_compounds AS ( SELECT cas.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations = 0 THEN 'No Violations' WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations = 1 THEN 'One Violation' ELSE 'Multiple Violations' END ORDER BY cas.avg_standard_value DESC, cas.num_activities DESC ) AS rank_within_group, AVG(cas.avg_standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations = 0 THEN 'No Violations' WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations = 1 THEN 'One Violation' ELSE 'Multiple Violations' END ) AS group_avg_standard_value, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations = 0 THEN 'No Violations' WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations = 1 THEN 'One Violation' ELSE 'Multiple Violations' END ) AS compounds_in_group FROM compound_activity_summary cas WHERE cas.num_activities >= 63 ) SELECT rc.molregno, rc.molweight, rc.mw_freebase, rc.alogp, rc.hba, rc.hbd, rc.psa, rc.rtb, rc.num_ro5_violations, rc.num_assays, rc.num_activities, rc.avg_standard_value, rc.min_standard_value, rc.max_standard_value, rc.rank_within_group, rc.group_avg_standard_value, rc.compounds_in_group, CASE WHEN rc.num_ro5_violations = 0 THEN 'No Violations' WHEN rc.num_ro5_violations = 1 THEN 'One Violation' ELSE 'Multiple Violations' END AS ro5_violation_group FROM ranked_compounds rc WHERE rc.rank_within_group <= 46 ORDER BY rc.num_ro5_violations, rc.rank_within_group;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.record_id) AS distinct_records, AVG(a.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_value <= 799.8 AND a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS potent_activities FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno LEFT JOIN activities a ON cr.record_id = a.record_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 962.9 AND 1013.92 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -2.42 AND -2.8 AND (c.molweight IS NULL OR c.molweight BETWEEN 126.93 AND 1422.35) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 1.59 ), target_class_aggregates AS ( SELECT tc.tid, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, MAX(tc.l5) AS max_l5, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.tc_id) AS class_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.target_classification, '; ' ORDER BY tc.target_classification) AS classifications FROM target_class tc WHERE tc.l1 IS NOT NULL AND tc.l2 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tc.tid, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4 ), assay_target_details AS ( SELECT a2t.assay_id, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence, a2t.relationship_type, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, td.protein_accession, td.gene_names, tca.l1, tca.l2, tca.classifications FROM assay2target a2t JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class_aggregates tca ON a2t.tid = tca.tid WHERE a2t.confidence >= 6.82 AND (td.organism IS NOT NULL OR td.target_type IS NOT NULL) ), nested_activity_analysis AS ( SELECT cas.molregno, cas.molweight, cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.hba, cas.hbd, cas.psa, cas.rtb, cas.num_ro5_violations, cas.ro3_pass, cas.med_chem_friendly, cas.distinct_assays, cas.distinct_records, cas.avg_standard_value, cas.min_standard_value, cas.max_standard_value, cas.potent_activities, atd.assay_id, atd.tid, atd.confidence, atd.relationship_type, atd.pref_name, atd.organism, atd.target_type, atd.protein_accession, atd.gene_names, atd.l1, atd.l2, atd.classifications, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cas.molregno ORDER BY atd.confidence DESC, atd.assay_id) AS target_rank FROM compound_activity_summary cas LEFT JOIN activities a ON cas.molregno = a.molregno LEFT JOIN assay_target_details atd ON a.assay_id = atd.assay_id WHERE cas.potent_activities >= 4.45 AND (a.standard_value IS NOT NULL OR atd.tid IS NOT NULL) ), final_aggregated AS ( SELECT naa.molregno, naa.molweight, naa.mw_freebase, naa.alogp, naa.hba, naa.hbd, naa.psa, naa.rtb, naa.num_ro5_violations, naa.ro3_pass, naa.med_chem_friendly, naa.distinct_assays, naa.distinct_records, naa.avg_standard_value, naa.min_standard_value, naa.max_standard_value, naa.potent_activities, COUNT(DISTINCT naa.tid) AS distinct_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT naa.assay_id) AS distinct_target_assays, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT naa.pref_name, '; ' ORDER BY naa.pref_name) AS target_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT naa.organism, '; ' ORDER BY naa.organism) AS target_organisms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT naa.target_type, '; ' ORDER BY naa.target_type) AS target_types, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT naa.l1, '; ' ORDER BY naa.l1) AS target_l1_classes, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT naa.l2, '; ' ORDER BY naa.l2) AS target_l2_classes, MAX(naa.confidence) AS max_confidence, AVG(naa.confidence) AS avg_confidence FROM nested_activity_analysis naa WHERE naa.target_rank <= 1.96 GROUP BY naa.molregno, naa.molweight, naa.mw_freebase, naa.alogp, naa.hba, naa.hbd, naa.psa, naa.rtb, naa.num_ro5_violations, naa.ro3_pass, naa.med_chem_friendly, naa.distinct_assays, naa.distinct_records, naa.avg_standard_value, naa.min_standard_value, naa.max_standard_value, naa.potent_activities HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT naa.tid) >= 5.5 AND AVG(naa.confidence) > 6.08 ) SELECT fa.*, cs.synonyms AS compound_synonym, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, cl.confidence_summary, cl.description AS confidence_description, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fa.potent_activities DESC, fa.distinct_targets DESC) AS activity_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fa.target_l1_classes, fa.target_l2_classes) AS class_rank FROM final_aggregated fa LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON fa.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN activities a ON fa.molregno = a.molregno LEFT JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id LEFT JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON fa.max_confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE fa.avg_standard_value BETWEEN 1901.89 AND 6245.52 AND (d.year IS NULL OR d.year::integer BETWEEN 2013.06 AND 2021.55) ORDER BY fa.potent_activities DESC, fa.distinct_targets DESC, fa.avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 462.95;

WITH high_activity_compounds AS ( SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS active_assays_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency FROM activities a WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value <= '0.1' AND a.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY a.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 42 ), ro5_compliant_compounds AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations FROM compound_properties cp WHERE cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '401' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-2' AND '2.1' ) SELECT hc.molregno, hc.active_assays_count, hc.avg_potency, hc.min_potency, rc.mw_freebase, rc.alogp, rc.hba, rc.hbd, rc.rtb, rc.num_ro5_violations FROM high_activity_compounds hc INNER JOIN ro5_compliant_compounds rc ON hc.molregno = rc.molregno ORDER BY hc.active_assays_count DESC, hc.avg_potency ASC LIMIT 100;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.published_activity_type, a.relation, a.activity_comment, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, c.molformula, cs.synonyms, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_desc, d.year, d.journal, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS rank_within_assay, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id) AS activity_count_per_assay FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '200' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2016 AND a.standard_units = 'nM' ), aggregated_compounds AS ( SELECT ra.molregno, ra.pref_name AS target_name, ra.organism, ra.target_type, ra.l1 AS target_class_l1, ra.l2 AS target_class_l2, ra.year, ra.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.standard_type = 'IC50' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ic50_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.standard_type = 'Ki' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ki_count, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_activity, STDDEV(ra.standard_value) AS stddev_activity, AVG(ra.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(ra.alogp) AS avg_alogp, SUM(ra.hba) AS total_hba, SUM(ra.hbd) AS total_hbd, AVG(ra.psa) AS avg_psa, SUM(ra.rtb) AS total_rtb, SUM(ra.num_ro5_violations) AS total_ro5_violations, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.confidence_summary, '; ') AS confidence_levels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.rank_within_assay = 1 AND ra.activity_count_per_assay >= 3 GROUP BY ra.molregno, ra.pref_name, ra.organism, ra.target_type, ra.l1, ra.l2, ra.year, ra.journal HAVING AVG(ra.standard_value) < '1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) > 5 AND SUM(ra.num_ro5_violations) <= 3 ) SELECT ac.*, cp2.ro3_pass, cp2.med_chem_friendly, td2.gene_names, td2.protein_accession, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ac.avg_activity ASC, ac.total_activities DESC) AS compound_rank FROM aggregated_compounds ac JOIN compound_properties cp2 ON ac.molregno = cp2.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON ac.molregno = cr.molregno LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td2 ON cr.doc_id = td2.tid WHERE cp2.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' AND (cp2.ro3_pass = 'Y' OR cp2.ro3_pass IS NULL) AND ac.total_ro5_violations <= 1 ORDER BY compound_rank, ac.avg_activity ASC LIMIT 113;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.relation, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, cl.confidence_summary, cl.description AS confidence_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.protein_accession, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.target_classification, a2t.confidence AS assay_target_confidence, a2t.relationship_type, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, cr.compound_name, cs.synonyms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ay.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON ay.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '500.0' AND cp.alogp >= '-5.0' AND a2t.confidence >= 8 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2009 ) SELECT ra.tid, ra.pref_name, ra.target_organism, ra.protein_accession, ra.l1, ra.l2, ra.l3, ra.target_classification, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) AS unique_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.pubmed_id) AS unique_publications, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.compound_name) AS unique_compound_names, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, AVG(ra.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw_freebase, AVG(ra.alogp) AS avg_alogp, AVG(ra.hba) AS avg_hba, AVG(ra.hbd) AS avg_hbd, AVG(ra.psa) AS avg_psa, AVG(ra.rtb) AS avg_rtb, AVG(ra.num_ro5_violations) AS avg_ro5_violations FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.activity_rank = 1 AND ra.standard_value <= '0.0' GROUP BY ra.tid, ra.pref_name, ra.target_organism, ra.protein_accession, ra.l1, ra.l2, ra.l3, ra.target_classification HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ra.molregno) >= 14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) >= 16 AND AVG(ra.standard_value) <= '0.0' ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 416;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.assay_id, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, ass.assay_type, ass.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, td.pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.target_classification, cl.confidence_summary, a2t.confidence, a2t.relationship_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.standard_type ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank, AVG(a.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.standard_type) AS avg_activity_by_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno) AS total_activities_per_compound FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 30212.65 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 744.6 AND 790.19 AND d.year::integer >= 2011 AND a2t.confidence >= 7 ) SELECT ra.molregno, ra.standard_type, ra.assay_type, ra.pref_name AS target_name, ra.target_organism, ra.l1 AS target_class_level1, ra.l2 AS target_class_level2, ra.l3 AS target_class_level3, ra.target_classification, ra.confidence_summary, ra.relationship_type, ra.year AS publication_year, ra.journal, ra.mw_freebase, ra.alogp, ra.hba, ra.hbd, ra.psa, ra.rtb, ra.num_ro5_violations, ra.ro3_pass, ra.med_chem_friendly, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, ra.avg_activity_by_type, ra.total_activities_per_compound, COUNT(*) AS num_activities, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.activity_rank = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_ranked_activities FROM ranked_activities ra GROUP BY ra.molregno, ra.standard_type, ra.assay_type, ra.pref_name, ra.target_organism, ra.l1, ra.l2, ra.l3, ra.target_classification, ra.confidence_summary, ra.relationship_type, ra.year, ra.journal, ra.mw_freebase, ra.alogp, ra.hba, ra.hbd, ra.psa, ra.rtb, ra.num_ro5_violations, ra.ro3_pass, ra.med_chem_friendly, ra.avg_activity_by_type, ra.total_activities_per_compound HAVING AVG(ra.standard_value) > 98269.67 AND COUNT(*) >= 77 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, num_activities DESC;

WITH ranked_compounds AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type, a.activity_comment, ass.assay_type, d.year, d.doc_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS rn FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities a ON cr.record_id = a.record_id JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2023 AND 2015 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 0.92 AND -1.7 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL ) SELECT rc.molregno, rc.molweight, rc.alogp, rc.hba, rc.hbd, rc.psa, rc.rtb, rc.num_ro5_violations, rc.ro3_pass, rc.med_chem_friendly, rc.standard_value, rc.standard_units, rc.standard_type, rc.activity_comment, rc.assay_type, rc.year, rc.doc_id FROM ranked_compounds rc WHERE rc.rn = 1 ORDER BY rc.standard_value DESC, rc.molregno;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, cp.molregno, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER(PARTITION BY act.molregno, a.assay_type) AS avg_standard_value_per_compound_assay_type, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY act.molregno) AS total_activities_per_compound, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC) AS mw_rank_in_assay_type, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY act.molregno, a.assay_id) AS flagged_activities_per_assay FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON cr.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.assay_type IN ('B', 'F', 'A') AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 9.92 AND -3.81 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 166.03 AND 967.57 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 3.4 AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 2007 AND 2014 AND a2t.confidence >= 1.67 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 324305.78 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, cp.molregno, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_flag, act.molregno, a.assay_id HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) > 771818.99 AND COUNT(*) > 57.71 ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC, avg_standard_value_per_compound_assay_type ASC;

SELECT a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON ac.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON cr.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE ac.standard_value > '0' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '100' GROUP BY a.assay_type, at.assay_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.molregno) > 53 ORDER BY num_assays DESC;

SELECT a.assay_type, aty.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.assay_id) AS unique_assays, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM activities ac JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type aty ON a.assay_type = aty.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN compounds c ON ac.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON ac.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_value > 92329.13 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 188.4 AND 737.03 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (a.assay_type, aty.assay_desc), (td.pref_name), (tc.l1, tc.l2), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ac.molregno) > 5 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.hba) AS max_hba_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value > '0.0' AND cp.mw_freebase < '100.0' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 10 ORDER BY assay_count DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(cp.hba) AS min_hba, MAX(cp.hbd) AS max_hbd FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON asy.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 706.14 AND 620.28 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND asy.assay_type = 'B' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < 2609.3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 24.69 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, SUM(a.standard_value) AS total_activity FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN docs d ON s.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value > 74555.02 AND d.year::integer >= 2009 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 8 AND AVG(cp.mw_freebase) <= 804.26 ORDER BY total_activity DESC;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a.assay_type, atype.assay_desc, cl.confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_ro3_pass, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_med_chem_friendly, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw_freebase, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp, AVG(cp.psa) AS avg_psa, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS num_documents, MIN(d.year::integer) AS min_year, MAX(d.year::integer) AS max_year FROM target_dictionary t JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type atype ON a.assay_type = atype.assay_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON act.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 73568.84 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 319.57 AND 649.1 AND d.year::integer >= 2007 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a.assay_type, atype.assay_desc, cl.confidence_summary HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 40 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 1034.95 ORDER BY num_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT td.pref_name AS target_name, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT c.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON ac.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 343.42 AND 676.46 AND (cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 OR cp.ro3_pass = 'Y') AND a.assay_type NOT IN ('{{p4}}', '{{p5}}') AND td.organism = '{{p6}}' GROUP BY td.pref_name, a.assay_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 4 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < 2326.26 ORDER BY avg_activity ASC, assay_count DESC;

SELECT td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, a2t.relationship_type, cl.confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '501.0' AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND d.year::integer >= 2009 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = cp.molregno AND cs.synonyms ILIKE '%''%' ) GROUP BY td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, a2t.relationship_type, cl.confidence_summary HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 32 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, compound_count DESC LIMIT 587;

SELECT td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(a.standard_value) DESC) AS potency_rank_in_class, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_logp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target at ON td.tid = at.tid JOIN assays a_s ON at.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a_s.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 9080.83 AND 5043.99 AND d.year >= '2000' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 455.01 AND 128.12 AND at.confidence >= 2.37 AND td.tax_id = 9639.93 GROUP BY td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) > 75.1 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 3214.42 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, unique_compounds DESC;

SELECT td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a.assay_type, cl.confidence_summary, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flagged_activities FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 7891.21 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 332.22 AND 553.39 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2006 AND a2t.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a.assay_type, cl.confidence_summary, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 78 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 4798.8 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) AS document_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_compliant_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.standard_value) AS median_potency, STDDEV(a.standard_value) AS potency_stddev FROM target_dictionary td INNER JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid INNER JOIN assays asy ON a2t.assay_id = asy.assay_id INNER JOIN activities a ON asy.assay_id = a.assay_id INNER JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno INNER JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON a.molregno = cr.molregno INNER JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id INNER JOIN assay_type at ON asy.assay_type = at.assay_type INNER JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid INNER JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 9263.87 AND 344095.93 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 352.97 AND 936.03 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -0.8 AND 4.94 AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 2004 AND 2018 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) >= 11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 44 AND AVG(a.standard_value) <= 533.35 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_potency ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.molregno) AS unique_compounds, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms_list, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assay_type at ON a_s.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a_s.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 8267.46 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2018 AND 2023 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 406.37 AND 581.14 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = a.molregno AND cr.doc_id = a.doc_id AND cr.compound_name IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 22 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 709.08 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 116;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT c.molregno) AS unique_compounds, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 53679.28 AND d.year::integer >= 2009 AND td.tax_id = 9702 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 127.72 AND 1184.88 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 72 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 4692.76 ORDER BY total_activities DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 866;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms_list FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value BETWEEN 779338.66 AND 871176.17 AND a2t.confidence >= 9.16 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 936.73 AND 845.94 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -2.61 AND -3.93 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = c.molregno AND cr.doc_id = a.doc_id AND cr.compound_name IS NOT NULL ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM docs d WHERE d.doc_id = a.doc_id AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1991.85 AND 1991.84 ) GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 20.77 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 772915.48 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 39.57 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.doc_id, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.target_classification, cl.confidence_summary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS rn FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND a.standard_value < '0.1' ), aggregated_targets AS ( SELECT r.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT r.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT r.tid) AS num_targets, AVG(r.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(r.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(r.standard_value) AS max_activity, SUM(CASE WHEN r.ro3_pass = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.med_chem_friendly = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT r.pref_name, '; ') AS target_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT r.target_classification, '; ') AS target_classes FROM ranked_activities r WHERE r.rn = 1 AND r.year::INTEGER >= 2023 AND r.confidence_summary = 'High' GROUP BY r.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.tid) >= 5 AND AVG(r.standard_value) < '0.1' ) SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cs.synonyms AS common_synonym, atg.num_assays, atg.num_targets, atg.avg_activity, atg.min_activity, atg.max_activity, atg.ro3_pass_count, atg.medchem_friendly_count, atg.target_names, atg.target_classes FROM compounds c JOIN aggregated_targets atg ON c.molregno = atg.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE c.molweight BETWEEN '100' AND '500' INTERSECT SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cs.synonyms AS common_synonym, atg.num_assays, atg.num_targets, atg.avg_activity, atg.min_activity, atg.max_activity, atg.ro3_pass_count, atg.medchem_friendly_count, atg.target_names, atg.target_classes FROM compounds c JOIN aggregated_targets atg ON c.molregno = atg.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.journal = 'Nature' AND atg.num_targets > 5 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC, num_targets DESC LIMIT 880;

WITH ranked_compounds AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, t.tid, t.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, a.assay_type ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS rn_per_compound_assay FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at2.tid = t.tid JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 979.84 AND 1381.65 AND cp.alogp > 4.01 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 29527.52 ), window_analysis AS ( SELECT rc.assay_type, rc.target_class_level1, rc.target_class_level2, rc.standard_value, AVG(rc.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY rc.target_class_level1, rc.target_class_level2 ORDER BY rc.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_standard_value, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY rc.target_class_level1, rc.target_class_level2 ORDER BY rc.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_count FROM ranked_compounds rc WHERE rc.rn_per_compound_assay = 1 ) SELECT wa.assay_type, wa.target_class_level1, wa.target_class_level2, COUNT(*) AS num_compounds, MIN(wa.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(wa.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, AVG(wa.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, AVG(wa.moving_avg_standard_value) AS avg_moving_avg, MAX(wa.cumulative_count) AS total_compounds_in_class FROM window_analysis wa GROUP BY wa.assay_type, wa.target_class_level1, wa.target_class_level2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 35 ORDER BY wa.target_class_level1, wa.target_class_level2, num_compounds DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS distinct_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT a.doc_id) AS distinct_documents, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_activity_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 492.31 AND 651.85 AND ac.standard_value >= 29.14 AND t.tax_id = 9907 AND tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) >= 1 ORDER BY distinct_assays DESC, avg_activity_value ASC LIMIT 48;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp < '-2' AND d.year >= '2010' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 5 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molformula, cp.alogp, cp.psa, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_in_class FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN -1.39 AND 6.16 AND cp.psa BETWEEN 44.04 AND 71.14 AND cp.num_ro5_violations >= 3.68 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1.4 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 651379.97 AND a2t.confidence >= 5.68 AND a.assay_type LIKE '%' AND td.pref_name LIKE '%' AND d.year >= '1900' AND d.year <= '1900' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molformula, cp.alogp, cp.psa, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 349.26 AND AVG(act.standard_value) BETWEEN 930665.77 AND 162809.27 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 604.33;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c LEFT JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno LEFT JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id LEFT JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 735535.59 AND d.year::integer >= 2009 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 4 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 87 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 9171633.55 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 423;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND d.year::integer >= 2021 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno ) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < '1' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a2t.tid, td.pref_name, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200.0' AND '300.0' AND td.tax_id = 10085 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.molregno IN ( SELECT DISTINCT cr.molregno FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.doc_id IN ( SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) >= 2017 ) ) GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a2t.tid, td.pref_name HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) <= '0.1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 4 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, at.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, a.assay_id, td.tid, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.published_value) AS min_published_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY act.standard_value) AS median_standard_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON td.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession WHERE (cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '500.0' OR cp.alogp >= '-2.0') AND (cp.hba <= 1 AND cp.hbd <= 6) AND (a2t.confidence >= 0 OR a2t.relationship_type = 'D') AND d.year >= '2000' AND (act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1) AND (tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' OR tc.l2 = 'Kinase') AND NOT (td.organism = 'Homo sapiens') AND (tp.standard_value IS NULL OR tp.standard_value > '0.0') GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, at.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, a.assay_id, td.tid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 13 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.0' AND SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 6 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 277;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.organism ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS potency_rank_by_organism, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l2) AS avg_potency_per_target_class, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.num_ro5_violations) AS compounds_per_ro5_violation FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at2.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value > 23977.65 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 0.21 AND -8.75 AND cp.hba >= 12 AND cp.hbd >= 11 AND d.year::integer >= 2020 AND at2.confidence >= 7 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 57 ORDER BY potency_rank_by_organism, avg_potency_per_target_class DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description AS assay_description, d.year, d.journal, td.pref_name AS target_pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, ac.standard_value, ac.standard_type, ac.standard_units, ac.published_value, ac.published_activity_type, ac.published_units, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_organism, at.relationship_type, cs.synonyms, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activities ac_sub WHERE ac_sub.molregno = cp.molregno AND ac_sub.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS total_activities_with_std_val FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cp.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '100' AND cp.alogp >= '-5' AND ac.standard_value <= '0.1' AND a.assay_type = 'B' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, d.year, d.journal, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, ac.standard_value, ac.standard_type, ac.standard_units, ac.published_value, ac.published_activity_type, ac.published_units, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_organism, at.relationship_type, cs.synonyms HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) >= 8 ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC, cp.alogp DESC, ac.standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw FROM target_dictionary t JOIN assay2target at ON t.tid = at.tid JOIN assays a ON at.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0.0' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-10.0' AND '0.0' AND at.confidence >= 7 GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 42 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '100.0' ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) DESC) AS rank_by_compounds FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '500.0' AND d.year >= '2000' AND a2t.confidence >= 8 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno AND cs.synonyms IS NOT NULL ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM target_protein tp WHERE tp.protein_accession = td.protein_accession AND tp.standard_value IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 47 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS num_documents, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MIN(v.creation_date)) AS earliest_version_year FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN version v ON v.creation_date IS NOT NULL JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value > 52026.91 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 385.57 AND 809.69 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2020 AND a2t.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 11 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 10047.99 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 31 ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(ac.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM assays a JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON ac.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id WHERE ac.standard_value BETWEEN 877.76 AND 4642.69 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 861.37 AND 865.27 AND at.confidence >= 2.82 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type HAVING COUNT(ac.activity_id) > 767.14 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_potency ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS avg_standard_value_by_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) DESC) AS compound_rank FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value > 66828.89 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, tc.l1, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 56 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value_by_type DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism, c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_id ORDER BY act.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_potency, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_id) AS total_compounds_in_assay, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_id ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC ) AS potency_rank FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 8965.1 AND 61871.99 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 523.48 AND 1141.78 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 2.33 AND 1.41 AND a.assay_type = 'B' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND act.standard_units = 'nM' GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, td.organism, c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 15.24 ORDER BY a.assay_id, potency_rank;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.assay_type IN (SELECT assay_type FROM assay_type WHERE assay_desc LIKE '%cell-based%') AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '500' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-2' AND '2' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0' AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2016 AND 2022 AND at.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 70 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '100' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 906;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.assay_type IN (SELECT assay_type FROM assay_type WHERE assay_desc LIKE '%cell-based%') AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '500' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-2' AND '2' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0' AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2018 AND 2022 AND at.confidence >= 8 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 37 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '100' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 611;

SELECT a1.assay_id AS assay_id_1, a2.assay_id AS assay_id_2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw FROM activities a JOIN assays a1 ON a.assay_id = a1.assay_id JOIN assays a2 ON a1.doc_id = a2.doc_id AND a1.assay_id < a2.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assay2target at ON a1.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN '0' AND '0' AND cp.mw_freebase > '100' AND td.tax_id = 10012 GROUP BY a1.assay_id, a2.assay_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) > 19 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '10' ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mol_weight, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.l1) AS distinct_target_classes FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 947.28 AND 3422.49 AND cp.alogp >= 5.0 AND act.standard_value <= 59781.87 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (SELECT creation_date FROM version LIMIT 1)) >= 2001.67 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < 41846.47 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 4.19 ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE c.molregno IN ( SELECT cr.molregno FROM compound_records cr JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.year::integer > 2003 ) AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '-5' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 1 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN '-10' AND '-10' AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 5 ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS num_targets, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l2, '; ') AS target_classes FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno LEFT JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id LEFT JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id LEFT JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type LEFT JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND cp.hba >= 1 AND cp.hbd <= 1 AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND a2t.confidence >= 5 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 4 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0' ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, num_activities DESC;

act.published_activity_type, act.relation, cl.confidence_summary, cl.description AS confidence_description, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence AS target_confidence, a2t.relationship_type, a2t.assay_organism, a2t.assay_strain, td.pref_name, td.gene_names, td.organism AS target_organism, td.protein_accession, td.target_type, tt.target_desc, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8,
