td.organism ORDER BY cp.alogp DESC) AS alogp_rank_per_organism FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON act.standard_flag = cl.confidence JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE act.standard_value > 567467.03 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 868.21 AND 3990.36 AND cp.alogp > 9.45 AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 2 AND d.year >= '2000' AND a2t.confidence >= 10 AND td.tax_id > 60879 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, at.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, act.activity_id, act.standard_value, act.published_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, act.published_activity_type, act.relation, cl.confidence_summary, cl.description, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence, a2t.relationship_type, a2t.assay_organism, a2t.assay_strain, td.pref_name, td.gene_names, td.organism, td.protein_accession, td.target_type, tt.target_desc, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification HAVING COUNT(act.activity_id) > 52 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 928325.6 ORDER BY cp.molregno, a.assay_type, act.published_value DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) DESC) AS rank_by_activity_count FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '500.0' AND cp.alogp > '0.0' AND cp.hba >= 2 AND d.year::integer >= 2004 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 GROUP BY cp.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, a.assay_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 21 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY num_activities DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp FROM target_dictionary t JOIN assay2target at ON t.tid = at.tid JOIN assays a ON at.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 766799.86 AND 409669.93 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 2.23 AND -4.94 AND a.assay_type = 'A' GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 66.13 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, compound_count DESC LIMIT 352.12;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a.assay_type, atype.assay_desc, cl.confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_ro3_pass, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_med_chem_friendly, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw_freebase, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp, AVG(cp.psa) AS avg_psa, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS num_documents, MIN(d.year::integer) AS min_year, MAX(d.year::integer) AS max_year FROM target_dictionary t JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type atype ON a.assay_type = atype.assay_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON act.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 6014.79 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 455.24 AND 932.14 AND d.year::integer >= 2000 AND a2t.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a.assay_type, atype.assay_desc, cl.confidence_summary HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 20 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 5339.16 ORDER BY num_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT tc.l1 AS class_level1, td.pref_name AS target_name, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT c.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_logp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_compliant_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.molregno) DESC) AS rank_in_class FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target at ON td.tid = at.tid JOIN assays a ON at.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 39395.64 AND 47760.99 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2009 AND 2002 AND cp.mw_freebase >= 608.69 AND cp.hba <= 1 AND a.assay_id IN ( SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE assay_type IN ('B', 'F') AND doc_id IN ( SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE pubmed_id IS NOT NULL ) ) GROUP BY tc.l1, td.pref_name, a.assay_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.molregno) > 93 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 35271.14 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_activity ASC;

SELECT td.pref_name AS target_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target at ON td.tid = at.tid JOIN assays asy ON at.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN activities a ON asy.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 79112.46 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 786.16 AND 438.3 AND td.tid IN ( SELECT tid FROM target_class WHERE l1 = 'Enzyme' ) GROUP BY td.pref_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) > 40 ORDER BY compound_count DESC, avg_activity ASC;

SELECT td.pref_name AS target_name, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mol_weight, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mol_weight FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value >= 6643.8 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 965.63 AND 679.13 AND a2t.confidence >= 5 AND td.tax_id = 9625 GROUP BY td.pref_name, a.assay_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 49 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 18885.43 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_potency ASC;

WITH assay_compounds AS ( SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description AS assay_desc, act.molregno, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, act.published_activity_type, cp.molweight, cp.molformula, cprop.mw_freebase, cprop.alogp, cprop.hba, cprop.hbd, cprop.psa, cprop.rtb, cprop.num_ro5_violations, cprop.ro3_pass, cprop.med_chem_friendly, at.assay_desc AS type_description, td.tid, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.target_type, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, tc.l3 AS target_class_l3, d.year AS publication_year, d.journal, csyn.synonyms AS compound_synonym, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_id, act.molregno ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS rn FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_properties cprop ON cp.molregno = cprop.molregno JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms csyn ON cp.molregno = csyn.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND cp.molweight BETWEEN '100.0' AND '500.0' AND d.year::integer >= 2008 AND cprop.mw_freebase > '200.0' ), ranked_activities AS ( SELECT assay_id, assay_type, assay_desc, tid, target_name, target_organism, target_type, confidence, confidence_summary, target_class_l1, target_class_l2, target_class_l3, publication_year, journal, molregno, compound_synonym, molweight, mw_freebase, alogp, hba, hbd, psa, rtb, num_ro5_violations, ro3_pass, med_chem_friendly, standard_value, standard_type, standard_units, published_activity_type, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY assay_id ORDER BY standard_value DESC) AS value_percentile, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY assay_id, tid) AS target_assay_count, AVG(standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY assay_id, tid) AS avg_target_value FROM assay_compounds WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT target_class_l1, target_class_l2, target_type, target_organism, assay_type, confidence_summary, publication_year, journal, COUNT(DISTINCT tid) AS unique_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT assay_id) AS unique_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(standard_value) AS avg_activity_value, MIN(standard_value) AS min_activity_value, MAX(standard_value) AS max_activity_value, STDDEV(standard_value) AS stddev_activity_value, AVG(molweight) AS avg_molweight, AVG(mw_freebase) AS avg_mw_freebase, AVG(alogp) AS avg_alogp, SUM(hba) AS total_hba, SUM(hbd) AS total_hbd, AVG(psa) AS avg_psa, SUM(rtb) AS total_rtb, SUM(num_ro5_violations) AS total_ro5_violations, COUNT(CASE WHEN ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS ro3_pass_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY standard_value) AS median_activity_value FROM ranked_activities WHERE value_percentile >= '0.0' AND target_assay_count > 59 AND avg_target_value < '10000.0' GROUP BY target_class_l1, target_class_l2, target_type, target_organism, assay_type, confidence_summary, publication_year, journal HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tid) >= 19 AND AVG(standard_value) BETWEEN '0.0' AND '1000.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT molregno) > 82 ORDER BY unique_targets DESC, avg_activity_value DESC, publication_year DESC LIMIT 736;

WITH assay_stats AS ( SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency, COUNT(*) AS total_measurements, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) DESC) AS assay_rank FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 205.95 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND td.tax_id = 9722 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence ), compound_activity AS ( SELECT c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT ast.assay_id) AS active_assays, AVG(ast.avg_potency) AS avg_potency_across_assays, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ast.assay_id) DESC, AVG(ast.avg_potency) DESC) AS compound_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assay_stats ast ON act.assay_id = ast.assay_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 245.63 AND 620.08 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 GROUP BY c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations ) SELECT ast.assay_type, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, cl.confidence_summary, ast.unique_compounds, ast.avg_potency, ast.min_potency, ast.max_potency, ast.total_measurements, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.molregno) AS ro5_compliant_compounds, AVG(ca.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(ca.alogp) AS avg_logp, ast.assay_rank FROM assay_stats ast JOIN target_dictionary td ON ast.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON ast.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN compound_activity ca ON ca.active_assays > 0 WHERE ast.assay_rank <= 6 AND ast.unique_compounds >= 25 GROUP BY ast.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, cl.confidence_summary, ast.unique_compounds, ast.avg_potency, ast.min_potency, ast.max_potency, ast.total_measurements, ast.assay_rank ORDER BY ast.assay_rank ASC, ast.unique_compounds DESC, ast.avg_potency ASC;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, COUNT(DISTINCT a.standard_type) AS distinct_activity_types FROM activities a WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value > 535546.6 GROUP BY a.molregno ), compound_property_rank AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, c.molweight, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC) AS mw_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cp.alogp DESC) AS alogp_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.num_ro5_violations ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC) AS mw_rank_by_violations, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cp.hba) AS hba_dense_rank FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 801.45 AND 267.79 AND cp.alogp > -9.25 ) SELECT cas.molregno, cas.num_assays, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency, cas.total_activities, cas.distinct_activity_types, cpr.mw_freebase, cpr.alogp, cpr.hba, cpr.hbd, cpr.psa, cpr.rtb, cpr.num_ro5_violations, cpr.molweight, cpr.mw_rank, cpr.alogp_rank, cpr.mw_rank_by_violations, cpr.hba_dense_rank, AVG(cas.avg_potency) OVER (PARTITION BY cpr.num_ro5_violations) AS avg_potency_by_violation_class, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cpr.num_ro5_violations ORDER BY cas.avg_potency DESC) AS potency_rank_in_class, LAG(cas.avg_potency, 1) OVER (ORDER BY cpr.mw_freebase) AS prev_compound_potency, LEAD(cas.avg_potency, 1) OVER (ORDER BY cpr.mw_freebase) AS next_compound_potency, SUM(cas.total_activities) OVER (ORDER BY cpr.mw_freebase ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_activities FROM compound_activity_summary cas JOIN compound_property_rank cpr ON cas.molregno = cpr.molregno WHERE cas.num_assays >= 67 AND cas.total_activities > 829 ORDER BY cas.avg_potency DESC, cpr.mw_freebase LIMIT 100;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT a.doc_id) AS document_count, COUNT(DISTINCT at2.tid) AS target_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON asy.assay_id = at2.assay_id WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 5864.97 AND 8386.23 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 9.96 AND 4.69 AND c.molweight BETWEEN 467.05 AND 683.51 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb ), ranked_compounds AS ( SELECT cas.*, cs.synonyms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cas.molregno ORDER BY cs.synonyms) AS synonym_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cas.assay_count DESC, cas.activity_count DESC) AS activity_rank, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY cas.avg_standard_value) AS potency_quartile, LAG(cas.molweight, 1) OVER (ORDER BY cas.molweight) AS prev_molweight, LEAD(cas.molweight, 1) OVER (ORDER BY cas.molweight) AS next_molweight, AVG(cas.avg_standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY cas.hba, cas.hbd) AS avg_potency_by_hbd_hba FROM compound_activity_summary cas LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cas.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE cas.activity_count >= 46.45 AND cas.target_count >= 5.88 ) SELECT rc.molregno, rc.molweight, rc.alogp, rc.hba, rc.hbd, rc.psa, rc.rtb, rc.assay_count, rc.activity_count, rc.avg_standard_value, rc.min_standard_value, rc.max_standard_value, rc.document_count, rc.target_count, rc.synonyms, rc.activity_rank, rc.potency_quartile, (rc.molweight - rc.prev_molweight) AS molweight_diff_prev, (rc.next_molweight - rc.molweight) AS molweight_diff_next, rc.avg_potency_by_hbd_hba, CASE WHEN rc.avg_standard_value < rc.avg_potency_by_hbd_hba THEN 'More potent than average' WHEN rc.avg_standard_value > rc.avg_potency_by_hbd_hba THEN 'Less potent than average' ELSE 'Average potency' END AS potency_comparison FROM ranked_compounds rc WHERE rc.synonym_rank = 1 AND rc.potency_quartile <= 3.71 ORDER BY rc.activity_rank, rc.avg_standard_value LIMIT 755.09;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.canonical_smiles, c.molformula, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.standard_value) AS median_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flagged_count, d.year AS latest_assay_year, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '200.0' AND cp.alogp >= '-5.0' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2010 GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.canonical_smiles, c.molformula, d.year, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc ), target_class_analysis AS ( SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.ec_number, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS total_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, STDDEV(a.standard_value) AS stddev_potency, COUNT(DISTINCT cl.confidence) AS confidence_levels, MAX(cl.confidence) AS max_confidence, MIN(a2t.confidence) AS min_assay_confidence FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays ass ON a2t.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE td.tax_id = 9914 AND a2t.confidence >= 5 AND a.standard_value <= '0.0' AND td.in_drugstore = 1 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, SELECT cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, td.organism, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) AS activity_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1, td.organism ORDER BY AVG(ac.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_avg_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cp.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '0.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 3 AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_flag = 1 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND d.year::integer >= 2017 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, td.organism, cl.confidence_summary, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) > 23 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < '0.0' ORDER BY tc.l1, td.organism, rank_by_avg_value, activity_count DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, td.organism, d.year, cl.confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY act.standard_value) AS median_standard_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS target_rank FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '100' AND cp.alogp >= '-5' AND cp.hba <= 5 AND cp.hbd <= 9 AND a2t.confidence >= 0 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2012 AND td.tax_id = 9704 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, td.organism, d.year, cl.confidence_summary, td.tid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 46 AND AVG(act.standard_value) <= '0' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.inchi_key, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY act.standard_value) AS median_standard_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_l1_avg_value FROM compound_properties cp INNER JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno INNER JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND cp.molregno = act.molregno INNER JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id INNER JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type INNER JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence INNER JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '200' AND cp.alogp >= '-5' AND cp.hba <= 20 AND cp.hbd <= 9 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.inchi_key, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 8 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 187;

SELECT t1.tid, t1.pref_name, t1.organism, t1.target_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a2.assay_id) AS total_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS total_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency FROM target_dictionary t1 JOIN assay2target a2t ON t1.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a2 ON a2t.assay_id = a2.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a2.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t2 ON t1.organism = t2.organism AND t1.tid <> t2.tid AND t1.target_type = t2.target_type WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 6484.77 AND 9422.99 AND a2.doc_id IN (27341) AND a2.assay_type = 'A' GROUP BY t1.tid, t1.pref_name, t1.organism, t1.target_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 787 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 2303.15 ORDER BY total_assays DESC, avg_potency ASC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a2t.confidence > 9 AND a2t.multi = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200.0' AND '501.0' AND td.tax_id = 9747 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_units = 'nM' GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 10 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 41 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' UNION ALL SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) AS doc_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, AVG(cp.hba) AS avg_hba, MAX(cp.hbd) AS max_hbd, MIN(cp.psa) AS min_psa FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a2t.confidence <= 4 AND cp.num_ro5_violations = 2 AND cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Yes' AND td.in_drugstore = 1 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2000 AND 2017 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) >= 4 AND AVG(cp.hba) > 3 AND MAX(cp.hbd) < 4 ORDER BY tid, pref_name;

WITH high_activity_compounds AS ( SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS active_assays_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency FROM activities a WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value <= '0.1' AND a.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY a.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 9 ), ro5_compliant_compounds AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations FROM compound_properties cp WHERE cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '401' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-2' AND '2.1' ) SELECT hc.molregno, hc.active_assays_count, hc.avg_potency, hc.min_potency, rc.mw_freebase, rc.alogp, rc.hba, rc.hbd, rc.rtb, rc.num_ro5_violations FROM high_activity_compounds hc INNER JOIN ro5_compliant_compounds rc ON hc.molregno = rc.molregno ORDER BY hc.active_assays_count DESC, hc.avg_potency ASC LIMIT 100;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.doc_id, d.year, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS rn FROM activities a JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 2005 AND 2000 ) SELECT ra.molregno, cp.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(ra.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(ra.alogp) AS max_alogp FROM ranked_activities ra JOIN compounds cp ON ra.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON ra.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ra.rn = 1 GROUP BY ra.molregno, cp.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms HAVING AVG(ra.standard_value) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) >= 4 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.assay_id, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, SELECT c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_id) AS avg_assay_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_avg_value, SUM(act.standard_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno) AS total_standard_flags, MIN(cp.psa) OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1) AS min_psa_per_class, MAX(cp.rtb) OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l2) AS max_rtb_per_subclass FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a2t.confidence >= 7 AND d.year::integer >= 2010 GROUP BY c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, act.standard_value, act.standard_flag, cp.psa, cp.rtb HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) > 2 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY rank_by_avg_value, total_standard_flags DESC;

SELECT cp.mol_id, c.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(a.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_class FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON s.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON s.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > '0' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '500' AND d.year >= '1990' AND a.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY cp.mol_id, c.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) > '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 23 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.mol_id, c.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(a.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_class FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON s.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON s.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > '0' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '500' AND d.year >= '1990' AND a.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY cp.mol_id, c.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) > '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 37 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description AS assay_desc, at.assay_desc AS assay_type_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tt.target_desc, cl.confidence_summary, cl.description AS confidence_desc, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) AS record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS assay_target_count, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS target_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ac.published_activity_type, '; ') AS published_activity_types, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ac.standard_type, '; ') AS standard_types FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cr.record_id = ac.record_id AND cp.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '100' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND cp.hba >= 5 AND cp.hbd <= 8 AND cp.psa >= '0' AND cp.rtb <= 4 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_value > '0' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2013 AND a2t.confidence >= 5 AND td.in_drugstore = 0 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, at.assay_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tt.target_desc, cl.confidence_summary, cl.description, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) >= 74 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < '100' AND COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) > 15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) <= 33 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, activity_count DESC, cp.mw_freebase DESC LIMIT 776;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molformula, a.assay_type, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ac.standard_value) DESC) AS activity_rank FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cp.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-2' AND '3' AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molformula, a.assay_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) >= 1 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) > '0' ORDER BY activity_rank, cp.molregno;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS target_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_type, '; ') AS assay_types FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno LEFT JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id LEFT JOIN assay_type at ON asy.assay_type = at.assay_type LEFT JOIN assay2target a2t ON asy.assay_id = a2t.assay_id LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON asy.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '100.0' AND (cp.alogp > '-5.0' OR cp.hba < 2) AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 AND (a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > '0.0') AND (d.year::INTEGER >= 2001 OR d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (cp.ro3_pass = 'N' AND cp.med_chem_friendly = 'N') AND (a2t.confidence >= 7 OR a2t.confidence IS NULL) GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 27 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '0.0' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.molregno, a.assay_type) AS avg_activity_by_type, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank_per_target FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '100.0' AND cp.alogp >= '-5.0' AND cp.hba <= 8 AND cp.hbd <= 10 AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 0 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0.0' AND a2t.confidence >= 2 AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 2015 AND 2016 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) > 27 ORDER BY avg_activity_by_type DESC, activity_rank_per_target LIMIT 1000;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS target_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS document_count, MIN(CAST(d.year AS INTEGER)) AS earliest_year, MAX(CAST(d.year AS INTEGER)) AS latest_year FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ay.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 776750.85 AND 666434.57 AND CAST(d.year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1946 AND 1955 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 1296.06 AND 989.0 GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 35 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 157986.85 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT cp.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cp.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_value > 73.14 AND ac.standard_value < 670245.17 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2007 AND d.year::INTEGER <= 2007 AND cp.mw_freebase >= 446.82 AND cp.mw_freebase <= 618.64 AND at.confidence >= 1 GROUP BY cp.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 39 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) > 996.44 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, num_assays DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM target_dictionary t JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE d.year::integer BETWEEN 2012 AND 2020 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_units = 'nM' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '200' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 26 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_potency ASC LIMIT 67;

SELECT t1.tid, t1.pref_name, t1.organism, COUNT(DISTINCT a2.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_activity FROM target_dictionary t1 JOIN target_dictionary t2 ON t1.organism = t2.organism JOIN assay2target a2 ON t1.tid = a2.tid JOIN assays a ON a2.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id WHERE t1.in_drugstore = 1 AND t2.in_drugstore = 0 AND ac.standard_value BETWEEN 95293.21 AND 374043.34 AND a.assay_type = 'B' GROUP BY t1.tid, t1.pref_name, t1.organism HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a2.assay_id) > 15.68 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_activity ASC;

SELECT td.pref_name AS target_name, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mol_weight, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mol_weight FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value >= 30979.56 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 235.11 AND 877.16 AND a2t.confidence >= 5 AND td.tax_id = 9681 GROUP BY td.pref_name, a.assay_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 46 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 34836.37 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_potency ASC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 10859.56 AND 45835.46 AND cp.mw_freebase > 878.46 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -0.89 AND -4.62 AND a_s.assay_type IN (SELECT assay_type FROM assay_type WHERE assay_desc LIKE '%''%') AND td.tid IN (SELECT tid FROM target_class WHERE l1 = '''' AND l2 IN ('''', '''')) GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 145.15 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 14450.26 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 1000;

WITH assay_compounds AS ( SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.doc_id, act.molregno, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, c.molweight, c.inchi_key, cs.synonyms, cl.confidence_summary, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, at2.tid, at2.relationship_type, at2.confidence AS target_confidence, td.pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, tp.assay_organism AS activity_organism FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON act.standard_flag = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON td.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '500.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2004 AND at2.confidence >= 6 ), aggregated_data AS ( SELECT ac.assay_type, ac.standard_type, ac.target_organism, ac.activity_organism, ac.target_class_l1, ac.target_class_l2, ac.year, ac.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.assay_id) AS unique_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.tid) AS unique_targets, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_activity, AVG(ac.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(ac.alogp) AS avg_logp, SUM(ac.hba) AS total_hba, SUM(ac.hbd) AS total_hbd, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ac.standard_value) AS median_activity FROM assay_compounds ac GROUP BY ac.assay_type, ac.standard_type, ac.target_organism, ac.activity_organism, ac.target_class_l1, ac.target_class_l2, ac.year, ac.journal ) SELECT ad.assay_type, ad.standard_type, ad.target_organism, ad.activity_organism, ad.target_class_l1, ad.target_class_l2, ad.year, ad.journal, ad.unique_compounds, ad.unique_assays, ad.unique_targets, ad.avg_activity, ad.min_activity, ad.max_activity, ad.avg_molecular_weight, ad.avg_logp, ad.total_hba, ad.total_hbd, ad.median_activity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ad.assay_type, ad.standard_type ORDER BY ad.avg_activity DESC) AS activity_rank FROM aggregated_data ad WHERE ad.unique_compounds >= 69 AND ad.avg_molecular_weight BETWEEN '200.0' AND '400.0' ORDER BY ad.avg_activity DESC, ad.unique_compounds DESC LIMIT 949;

WITH assay_stats AS ( SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.doc_id, d.year::INTEGER AS publication_year, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0' AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1971 AND 1998 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.doc_id, d.year::INTEGER ), target_info AS ( SELECT at.assay_id, at.tid, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2 FROM assay2target at JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE at.confidence >= 0 ) SELECT ti.target_name, ti.target_organism, ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2, ast.assay_type, ast.publication_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ast.assay_id) AS num_assays, SUM(ast.unique_compounds) AS total_unique_compounds, AVG(ast.avg_standard_value) AS overall_avg_value, MIN(ast.min_standard_value) AS overall_min_value, MAX(ast.max_standard_value) AS overall_max_value FROM target_info ti JOIN assay_stats ast ON ti.assay_id = ast.assay_id GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ti.target_name, ti.target_organism, ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2, ast.assay_type, ast.publication_year), (ti.target_name, ti.target_organism, ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2), (ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2, ast.assay_type), (ti.target_class_l1, ast.assay_type, ast.publication_year), () ) HAVING SUM(ast.unique_compounds) >= 932 ORDER BY total_unique_compounds DESC, overall_avg_value DESC;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, COUNT(DISTINCT a.standard_type) AS distinct_activity_types FROM activities a WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value > 718746.62 GROUP BY a.molregno ), compound_property_rank AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, c.molweight, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC) AS mw_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cp.alogp DESC) AS alogp_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.num_ro5_violations ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC) AS mw_rank_by_violations, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cp.hba) AS hba_dense_rank FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 462.65 AND 1170.65 AND cp.alogp > 7.36 ) SELECT cas.molregno, cas.num_assays, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency, cas.total_activities, cas.distinct_activity_types, cpr.mw_freebase, cpr.alogp, cpr.hba, cpr.hbd, cpr.psa, cpr.rtb, cpr.num_ro5_violations, cpr.molweight, cpr.mw_rank, cpr.alogp_rank, cpr.mw_rank_by_violations, cpr.hba_dense_rank, AVG(cas.avg_potency) OVER (PARTITION BY cpr.num_ro5_violations) AS avg_potency_by_violation_class, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cpr.num_ro5_violations ORDER BY cas.avg_potency DESC) AS potency_rank_in_class, LAG(cas.avg_potency, 1) OVER (ORDER BY cpr.mw_freebase) AS prev_compound_potency, LEAD(cas.avg_potency, 1) OVER (ORDER BY cpr.mw_freebase) AS next_compound_potency, SUM(cas.total_activities) OVER (ORDER BY cpr.mw_freebase ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_activities FROM compound_activity_summary cas JOIN compound_property_rank cpr ON cas.molregno = cpr.molregno WHERE cas.num_assays >= 26 AND cas.total_activities > 741 ORDER BY cas.avg_potency DESC, cpr.mw_freebase LIMIT 100;

SELECT CAST(tc.l1 AS VARCHAR(50)) AS target_class_l1, CAST(tc.l2 AS VARCHAR(50)) AS target_class_l2, CAST(tc.l3 AS VARCHAR(50)) AS target_class_l3, td.organism, a2t.relationship_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS num_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM target_class tc JOIN target_dictionary td ON tc.tid = td.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 769139.22 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 335.81 AND 900.5 AND a2t.confidence >= 4 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, td.organism, a2t.relationship_type), (tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, td.organism), (tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3), (tc.l1, tc.l2), (tc.l1), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 24 ORDER BY tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, td.organism, a2t.relationship_type;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, td.organism, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type) AS avg_assay_type_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) DESC) AS rank_by_compounds FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value > 42642.99 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 128.66 AND 843.46 AND td.tax_id = 9786 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, td.organism, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 47 ORDER BY num_compounds DESC, a.assay_id;

SELECT a.assay_id, td.pref_name, cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_id, cp.molregno) AS avg_activity_per_assay_compound, COUNT(act.activity_id) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_id) AS activity_count_per_assay, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cp.alogp DESC) AS alogp_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.target_type ORDER BY cp.hba DESC) AS hba_rank_per_target_type FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -4.51 AND 0.61 AND cp.hba >= 3 AND d.year::integer >= 2023 AND a2t.confidence = 3 GROUP BY a.assay_id, td.pref_name, td.target_type, cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, act.standard_value, act.activity_id HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) > 49293.67 ORDER BY avg_activity_per_assay_compound DESC, alogp_rank LIMIT 100;

SELECT a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON ac.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON cr.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE ac.standard_value > '0' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '100' GROUP BY a.assay_type, at.assay_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.molregno) > 86 ORDER BY num_assays DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.hba) AS min_hba, MAX(cp.hbd) AS max_hbd, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE cp.alogp >= 3.57 AND cp.mw_freebase <= 485.77 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND s.assay_type = '{{p3}}' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 35 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, doc.year, doc.journal, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY cp.molregno, a.assay_type ORDER BY doc.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_activity FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs doc ON a.doc_id = doc.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 889.24 AND 103.0 AND cp.alogp >= -0.86 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND doc.year::integer >= 2014 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, doc.year, doc.journal HAVING COUNT(act.activity_id) > 8 ORDER BY cp.molregno, doc.year;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.year AS publication_year, d.journal, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, act.published_value, act.published_units, act.published_activity_type, cl.confidence_summary, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY cp.molregno, a.assay_type ORDER BY d.year::INTEGER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_standard_value, COUNT(act.activity_id) OVER ( PARTITION BY cp.molregno, td.tid ) AS target_activity_count, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC ) AS potency_rank_per_assay FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 434.6 AND 726.01 AND cp.alogp > 4.1 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2016 AND a2t.confidence >= 5 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.year, d.journal, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, act.published_value, act.published_units, act.published_activity_type, cl.confidence_summary, act.activity_id, td.tid HAVING COUNT(act.activity_id) > 7 ORDER BY cp.molregno, moving_avg_standard_value DESC;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, a.assay_type, at.assay_organism, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flagged_count FROM target_dictionary t JOIN assay2target at ON t.tid = at.tid JOIN assays a ON at.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 184893.46 AND act.standard_value < 80239161.93 AND cp.mw_freebase > 515.84 AND cp.mw_freebase < 250.85 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tid, t.pref_name, a.assay_type, at.assay_organism), (t.tid, t.pref_name, a.assay_type), (t.tid, t.pref_name), (t.tid), () ) ORDER BY t.tid, t.pref_name, a.assay_type, at.assay_organism;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms_list FROM target_dictionary t JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON act.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value > 97864.91 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 419.31 AND 723.8 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2011 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 10 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 87632.5 ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 463;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, a.assay_type, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS distinct_compounds, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flagged_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_avg_value FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 19819.41 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 5.86 AND -1.99 AND d.year::integer >= 2015 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, a.assay_type, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) > 19382.31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 57 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, distinct_compounds DESC LIMIT 299;

ranked_compounds AS ( SELECT cas.*, cs.synonyms, cr.compound_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cas.target_class_l1 ORDER BY cas.standard_value DESC) AS target_class_activity_rank, WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS num_targets, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM compound_properties cp INNER JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno INNER JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno INNER JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id INNER JOIN assay2target at ON asy.assay_id = at.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = cp.molregno AND cs.synonyms ILIKE '%' || '' || '%' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM target_class tc WHERE tc.tid = t.tid AND tc.l1 = '' ) AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 258.63 AND 257.05 AND a.standard_value BETWEEN 3318.91 AND 9013.15 GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 28.13 ) SELECT cas.*, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, at2.relationship_type, cl.confidence_summary FROM compound_activity_summary cas INNER JOIN activities a2 ON cas.molregno = a2.molregno INNER JOIN assays asy2 ON a2.assay_id = asy2.assay_id INNER JOIN assay2target at2 ON asy2.assay_id = at2.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid INNER JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at2.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a2.standard_value <= cas.min_potency * 1.1 AND td.organism = '' AND at2.confidence >= 9.4 ORDER BY cas.avg_potency ASC, cas.num_assays DESC LIMIT 115.22;

WITH filtered_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.doc_id, a.record_id FROM activities a WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 4192.33 AND 8139.14 AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.doc_id >= 7246.12 ), compound_metrics AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, c.molweight, c.molformula FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 743.82 AND 870.12 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -0.58 AND -1.16 ) SELECT cm.molregno, cm.molformula, cm.mw_freebase, cm.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT fa.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT fa.record_id) AS num_activities, AVG(fa.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(fa.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(fa.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM compound_metrics cm JOIN filtered_activities fa ON cm.molregno = fa.molregno GROUP BY cm.molregno, cm.molformula, cm.mw_freebase, cm.alogp HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fa.assay_id) >= 46.0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT fa.record_id) >= 10.97 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_assays DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS rn FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 31262.13 AND a2t.confidence >= 7 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 241.31 AND 362.23 ) SELECT molregno, pref_name, organism, l1, l2, COUNT(*) AS activity_count, AVG(standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(standard_value) AS max_standard_value, CASE WHEN ro3_pass = 'Y' AND med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 'High Quality' WHEN ro3_pass = 'Y' OR med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 'Medium Quality' ELSE 'Low Quality' END AS compound_quality, CASE WHEN mw_freebase < 300 THEN 'Small' WHEN mw_freebase BETWEEN 300 AND 500 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS molecular_size_category FROM ranked_activities WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY molregno, pref_name, organism, l1, l2, ro3_pass, med_chem_friendly, mw_freebase HAVING COUNT(*) > 39 AND AVG(standard_value) < 73026.26 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, aty.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism ORDER BY act.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_activity, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY cp.molregno, a.assay_type ) AS assays_per_compound_type, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC ) AS activity_rank_per_target FROM assays a JOIN assay_type aty ON a.assay_type = aty.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value > 821097.98 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 312.95 AND 126.91 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 3 AND d.year::integer >= 2001 AND a2t.confidence >= 0 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, aty.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 24 ORDER BY activity_rank_per_target, moving_avg_activity DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, at.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_in_class FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '0.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2016 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND (act.standard_units = 'nM' OR act.standard_units IS NULL) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, at.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 92 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.0' ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 251;

SELECT c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_flag = 1) AS standard_activity_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS activity_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '500' AND cp.alogp > '1.0' AND (cp.hba >= 3 OR cp.hbd >= 1) AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_units = 'nM' AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2014 AND 2017 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND (tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' OR tc.l1 = 'Membrane receptor') AND NOT (cp.num_ro5_violations > 0 AND cp.ro3_pass = 'N') GROUP BY c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, td.tid HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < '100' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 10 ORDER BY avg_activity ASC, synonym_count DESC LIMIT 683;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 114.24 AND cp.molregno IN ( SELECT DISTINCT cr.molregno FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.doc_id = 1850 ) GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 17 ORDER BY activity_count DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS distinct_targets, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1) AS target_classes, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ass.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 122.5 AND 948.76 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 1.91 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2002 AND at.confidence >= 7 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 7 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 134.6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) >= 2 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 28;
