SELECT cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, td.organism, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) AS activity_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1, td.organism ORDER BY AVG(ac.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_avg_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cp.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '0.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 5 AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_flag = 1 AND a2t.confidence >= 2 AND d.year::integer >= 2004 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, td.organism, cl.confidence_summary, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) > 95 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < '0.0' ORDER BY tc.l1, td.organism, rank_by_avg_value, activity_count DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-2' AND '2' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 10 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY cp.molregno LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) FROM activities a WHERE a.molregno = cp.molregno AND a.standard_value < 83.22) AS high_potency_activities, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = cp.molregno AND cr.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2018 AND 2019)) AS recent_records FROM compound_properties cp WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 637.3 AND 676.71 AND cp.alogp > 4.77 AND cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC, cp.alogp ASC;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count FROM target_dictionary t INNER JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid INNER JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid INNER JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id INNER JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id INNER JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno INNER JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno INNER JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase > '100.0' AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2001 AND 2011 AND a2t.confidence >= 1 GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 33 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' AND MIN(cp.mw_freebase) >= '100.0' ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS unique_assays, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase) AS median_mw, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cp.alogp) AS median_alogp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN assay_type at ON a_s.assay_type = at.assay_type WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 1.25 AND a.standard_value < 909160.62 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 178.82 AND 624.28 AND d.year::integer >= 2023 AND a2t.confidence >= 7 AND td.tax_id = 9978 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno AND cs.synonyms ILIKE '%inhibitor%' ) AND td.tid IN ( SELECT tid FROM target_class WHERE l1 IN ( SELECT DISTINCT l1 FROM target_class WHERE l2 = 'Enzyme' ) ) GROUP BY td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) > 11 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 439.56 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, unique_compounds DESC LIMIT 16;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms_list FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value BETWEEN 410802.77 AND 209911.63 AND a2t.confidence >= 4.48 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 357.81 AND 1869.51 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -4.04 AND 3.66 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = c.molregno AND cr.doc_id = a.doc_id AND cr.compound_name IS NOT NULL ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM docs d WHERE d.doc_id = a.doc_id AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1970.56 AND 1950.92 ) GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 30.94 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 933221.6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 32.0 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 8866.34 AND 6980.82 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 966.94 AND 267.81 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations ), ranked_compounds AS ( SELECT cas.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations <= 1 THEN 'Low_Violation' ELSE 'High_Violation' END ORDER BY cas.avg_standard_value DESC ) AS potency_rank, CASE WHEN cas.num_ro5_violations <= 1 THEN 'Low_Violation' ELSE 'High_Violation' END AS violation_category FROM compound_activity_summary cas WHERE cas.activity_count >= 55.08 ) SELECT rc.molregno, rc.molweight, rc.mw_freebase, rc.alogp, rc.hba, rc.hbd, rc.psa, rc.rtb, rc.num_ro5_violations, rc.activity_count, rc.avg_standard_value, rc.min_standard_value, rc.max_standard_value, rc.potency_rank, rc.violation_category FROM ranked_compounds rc WHERE rc.potency_rank <= 10.73 ORDER BY rc.violation_category, rc.potency_rank;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.doc_id, d.year, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS rn FROM activities a JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 2010 AND 2023 ) SELECT ra.molregno, cp.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(ra.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(ra.alogp) AS max_alogp FROM ranked_activities ra JOIN compounds cp ON ra.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON ra.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ra.rn = 1 GROUP BY ra.molregno, cp.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms HAVING AVG(ra.standard_value) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) >= 10 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.ro3_pass, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, td.organism, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS rn FROM activities a JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ay.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 63611.85 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 624.92 AND 167.21 ) SELECT ra.assay_type, ra.assay_desc, ra.pref_name AS target_name, ra.organism AS target_organism, ra.confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_potency, AVG(ra.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(ra.alogp) AS avg_logp, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_compliant_count FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.rn = 1 GROUP BY ra.assay_type, ra.assay_desc, ra.pref_name, ra.organism, ra.confidence_summary HAVING AVG(ra.standard_value) < 67878.31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ra.molregno) >= 97 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, unique_compounds DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value > 135156.32 AND act.standard_value < 967693.27 GROUP BY a.assay_id ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(act.activity_id) AS total_activities FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN '0.0' AND '1000.0' AND cp.mw_freebase > '200.0' AND cp.alogp < '-2.0' GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc HAVING COUNT(act.activity_id) > 907 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '500.0' ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.record_id) AS total_activities, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_flag = 1 AND ac.standard_value > 70288.15 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2022 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ac.molregno) > 74 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < 98290.44 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT act.record_id) AS total_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 29497.02 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 40.23 AND 405.99 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 8.0 AND 13.76 AND act.doc_id IN ( SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2017 AND 2009 ) GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 49 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 1700.08 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, unique_compounds DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a2t.confidence >= 3 AND cp.mw_freebase > '100' AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 2 AND act.standard_units = 'nM' AND act.standard_type = 'IC50' GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < '0' AND COUNT(act.activity_id) >= 48 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_names FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 962.4 AND 1009.63 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 2.5 AND 2.14 AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 5.78 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 4998.1 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_potency ASC LIMIT 947.7;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS unique_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS unique_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS unique_targets, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_activity_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '100.0' AND cp.alogp < '-5.0' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 8 ORDER BY unique_assays DESC, avg_molecular_weight ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE a.standard_value > 78269.73 AND a.standard_value < 964759452.71 AND a.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(a.activity_id) > 9 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

act.standard_value, act.published_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.protein_accession, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.target_classification, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_organism, at.relationship_type, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, cr.compound_name, cs.synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, td.tid) AS avg_potency_per_target, MIN(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno) AS min_potency_all_targets, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) DESC) AS target_polypharmacology_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, a.assay_type) AS valid_measurements_per_type FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ( (act.standard_value BETWEEN 8951.75 AND 8038.44 AND act.standard_units = 'nM') OR (act.published_value BETWEEN 2969.11 AND 7811.61 AND act.published_units = 'nM') OR (act.standard_type IN ('IC50', 'Ki', 'Kd') AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) ) AND ( (cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 324.59 AND 320.03) AND (cp.alogp BETWEEN -4.6 AND -0.02) AND (cp.hba >= 18.81 AND cp.hba <= 3.43) AND (cp.hbd >= 5.62 AND cp.hbd <= 7.1) AND (cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0.11) ) AND ( (td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' OR td.organism LIKE '%human%') OR (at.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' OR at.assay_organism LIKE '%human%') ) AND ( (a.assay_type IN ('B', 'F', 'A')) OR (at.relationship_type IN ('D', 'H')) OR (cl.confidence >= 8.13) ) AND NOT ( (act.activity_comment LIKE '%inconclusive%' OR act.activity_comment LIKE '%ambiguous%') OR (cp.ro3_pass = 'N' AND cp.med_chem_friendly = 'N') OR (td.in_drugstore = 0 AND td.in_starlite = 0) ) AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 2015.85 AND 2002.32 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.canonical_smiles, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, act.standard_value, act.published_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.protein_accession, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.target_classification, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_organism, at.relationship_type, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, cr.compound_name, cs.synonyms, act.standard_flag HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 3.25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) >= 11.51 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 7541.47 ORDER BY target_polypharmacology_rank, min_potency_all_targets, activity_count DESC LIMIT 6856.21;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno) AS synonym_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE c.molweight BETWEEN '100.0' AND '300.0' AND d.year >= '2010' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY activity_count DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS dense_rank_by_class FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE act.standard_value >= 652332.75 AND act.standard_value <= 296268.42 AND cp.alogp >= 9.99 AND cp.alogp <= -4.55 AND cp.hba >= 18.16 AND cp.hba <= 5.42 AND d.year >= '1900' AND d.year <= '1900' AND a2t.confidence >= 7.42 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 238.81 AND AVG(act.standard_value) <= 918844.35 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activities a2 WHERE a2.molregno = c.molregno AND a2.standard_value > 1493.54) AS high_activity_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN docs d ON asy.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.num_ro5_violations < 0 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 0 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2005 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < 677.71 ORDER BY assay_count DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS max_standard_value, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT td.pref_name, '; ') AS target_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes_l1, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno) AS ro3_pass_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno LEFT JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id LEFT JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '200' AND cp.alogp >= '-5' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = c.molregno AND cr.doc_id = a.doc_id ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM confidence_lookup cl WHERE cl.confidence = at.confidence AND cl.confidence_summary = 'High' ) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.ro3_pass HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 45 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0' ORDER BY activity_rank, avg_standard_value DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, at.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.record_id) AS activity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_activities, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(ac.standard_value) DESC) AS activity_rank_in_class FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cr.record_id = ac.record_id JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '300.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::integer >= 2016 AND a2t.confidence >= 3 GROUP BY c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, at.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING AVG(ac.standard_value) > '1.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ac.record_id) >= 8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) > 1 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC, activity_count DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.year, d.journal, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tt.target_desc, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, cl.confidence_summary, COUNT(act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS compound_activity_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '500.0' AND cp.alogp >= '-5.0' AND cp.hba <= 8 AND cp.hbd <= 5 AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 2 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2015 AND a2t.confidence >= 0 GROUP BY c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.year, d.journal, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tt.target_desc, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, cl.confidence_summary HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) > '0.0' AND COUNT(act.activity_id) >= 3 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 750;

SELECT c.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l2 AS target_class, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_logp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_compliant_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 5869.55 AND 8131.15 AND cp.mw_freebase >= 971.03 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2004 AND 2014 AND tc.l2 = 'Enzyme' GROUP BY c.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l2, a.assay_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 15 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 30.99 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_potency ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 44725.95 AND 95889.77 AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 1994 AND 2011 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) > 335.19 ORDER BY assay_count DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS unique_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS unique_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS unique_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.l1) AS unique_l1_classes, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_value IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_activities, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp, MAX(cp.num_ro5_violations) AS max_ro5_violations, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities a ON cr.record_id = a.record_id AND cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON ass.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type LEFT JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type LEFT JOIN relationship_type rt ON a2t.relationship_type = rt.relationship_type WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '501.0' AND cp.alogp >= '-5.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 3 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2020 AND a2t.confidence >= 2 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) >= 5 AND AVG(cp.mw_freebase) < '800.0' ORDER BY unique_assays DESC, unique_targets DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.molregno, a.assay_type) AS avg_activity_by_type, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank_per_target FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '100.0' AND cp.alogp >= '-5.0' AND cp.hba <= 17 AND cp.hbd <= 8 AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 5 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0.0' AND a2t.confidence >= 4 AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 2005 AND 2021 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) > 23 ORDER BY avg_activity_by_type DESC, activity_rank_per_target LIMIT 1000;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT at2.tid) AS target_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) AS record_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON asy.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 539.33 AND 577.49 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -0.89 AND 0.27 AND (cp.hba >= 4.65 OR cp.hbd >= 4.33) AND NOT (cp.num_ro5_violations > 2.53) AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND asy.assay_type = 'B' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 9.2 AND AVG(a.standard_value) BETWEEN 96.72 AND 445.87 ORDER BY cp.molregno;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) FILTER (WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS active_assays, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_activity_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_activity_value FROM compound_properties cp LEFT JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno WHERE cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '0.0' AND '100.0' GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) FILTER (WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL) > 13 ORDER BY cp.alogp DESC, min_activity_value ASC;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw FROM target_dictionary t JOIN assay2target at ON t.tid = at.tid JOIN assays a ON at.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0.0' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-10.0' AND '0.0' AND at.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 40 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '100.0' ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.molregno) AS compound_count, COUNT(*) AS activity_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp FROM target_dictionary t JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON ac.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE ac.standard_value BETWEEN 42495.18 AND 65270.23 AND d.year >= '2000' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 326.55 AND 941.98 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 8.11 AND 0.1 AND a2t.confidence >= 9.8 AND t.tax_id = 9854.18 GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 28.75 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.molregno) >= 38.33 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) BETWEEN 33218.84 AND 45203.51 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, compound_count DESC;

SELECT td.pref_name, td.organism, a.assay_type, cl.l1, cl.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN target_class cl ON td.tid = cl.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.year::integer BETWEEN 1996 AND 2016 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY td.pref_name, td.organism, a.assay_type, cl.l1, cl.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 45 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS distinct_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT act.record_id) AS distinct_records, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 861.18 AND 979.68 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 28 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 90421.79 ORDER BY distinct_compounds DESC, avg_activity ASC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal, a2t.relationship_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY d.year ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, STDDEV(cp.alogp) AS stddev_alogp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 208.26 AND 731.21 AND cp.alogp > 0.68 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2004 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal, a2t.relationship_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(act.activity_id) > 5 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 6788.99 ORDER BY moving_avg_standard_value DESC, unique_compounds DESC LIMIT 505;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, at.assay_type, cp.molregno, cs.synonyms, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.description, act.activity_id, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) AS record_count, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid, cp.molregno) AS avg_activity_per_target_compound, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS activity_rank_per_target act.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase > '100.0' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '0.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 AND d.year >= '2000' AND a2t.confidence >= 9 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, at.assay_type, cp.molregno, cs.synonyms, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.description, act.activity_id, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5 HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) >= 1 UNION ALL SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, at.assay_type, cp.molregno, cs.synonyms, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.description, act.activity_id, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) AS record_count, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid, cp.molregno) AS avg_activity_per_target_compound, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS activity_rank_per_target FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase <= '50.0' AND cp.alogp NOT BETWEEN '-10.0' AND '5.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations > 3 AND d.year < '1990' AND a2t.confidence < 2 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, at.assay_type, cp.molregno, cs.synonyms, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.description, act.activity_id, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5 HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) <= '10000.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) < 95 ORDER BY tid, activity_rank_per_target;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.doc_id) AS document_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp, AVG(cp.psa) AS avg_psa, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT atype.assay_type, '; ') AS assay_types, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ttype.target_desc, '; ') AS target_descriptions, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MAX(v.creation_date)) AS latest_version_year FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON act.molregno = cr.molregno AND act.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN docs d ON act.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay_type atype ON a.assay_type = atype.assay_type JOIN target_type ttype ON td.target_type = ttype.target_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN version v ON v.creation_date >= '2000-01-01' WHERE a2t.confidence >= 6 AND act.standard_value BETWEEN '0.1' AND '0.1' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v.creation_date) >= 2010 AND td.in_drugstore = 0 AND td.in_starlite = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase >= '100.0' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '-5.0' AND a2t.multi = 1 AND a2t.complex = 1 AND act.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 13 AND AVG(act.standard_value) <= '0.1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 13 ORDER BY compound_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 510;

WITH assay_compounds AS ( SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description AS assay_desc, act.molregno, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, act.published_activity_type, cp.molweight, cp.molformula, cprop.mw_freebase, cprop.alogp, cprop.hba, cprop.hbd, cprop.psa, cprop.rtb, cprop.num_ro5_violations, cprop.ro3_pass, cprop.med_chem_friendly, at.assay_desc AS type_description, td.tid, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.target_type, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, tc.l3 AS target_class_l3, d.year AS publication_year, d.journal, csyn.synonyms AS compound_synonym, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_id, act.molregno ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS rn FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_properties cprop ON cp.molregno = cprop.molregno JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms csyn ON cp.molregno = csyn.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a2t.confidence >= 8 AND cp.molweight BETWEEN '100.0' AND '500.0' AND d.year::integer >= 2010 AND cprop.mw_freebase > '200.0' ), ranked_activities AS ( SELECT assay_id, assay_type, assay_desc, tid, target_name, target_organism, target_type, confidence, confidence_summary, target_class_l1, target_class_l2, target_class_l3, publication_year, journal, molregno, compound_synonym, molweight, mw_freebase, alogp, hba, hbd, psa, rtb, num_ro5_violations, ro3_pass, med_chem_friendly, standard_value, standard_type, standard_units, published_activity_type, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY assay_id ORDER BY standard_value DESC) AS value_percentile, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY assay_id, tid) AS target_assay_count, AVG(standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY assay_id, tid) AS avg_target_value FROM assay_compounds WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT target_class_l1, target_class_l2, target_type, target_organism, assay_type, confidence_summary, publication_year, journal, COUNT(DISTINCT tid) AS unique_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT assay_id) AS unique_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(standard_value) AS avg_activity_value, MIN(standard_value) AS min_activity_value, MAX(standard_value) AS max_activity_value, STDDEV(standard_value) AS stddev_activity_value, AVG(molweight) AS avg_molweight, AVG(mw_freebase) AS avg_mw_freebase, AVG(alogp) AS avg_alogp, SUM(hba) AS total_hba, SUM(hbd) AS total_hbd, AVG(psa) AS avg_psa, SUM(rtb) AS total_rtb, SUM(num_ro5_violations) AS total_ro5_violations, COUNT(CASE WHEN ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS ro3_pass_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN med_chem_friendly OVER (ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC) AS mw_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY td.target_type ORDER BY cp.alogp DESC) AS alogp_rank_per_target_type FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON SELECT c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '200' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 AND at.confidence >= 4 GROUP BY c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 10 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC, assay_count DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_activity, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_activity_count, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay_type aty ON ay.assay_type = aty.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON ay.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN '0' AND '0' AND cp.mw_freebase > '100' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '-5' AND a.standard_flag = 0 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 4 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '0' ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_activity ASC;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, td.organism, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) AS activity_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1, td.organism ORDER BY AVG(ac.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_avg_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cp.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '0.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_flag = 1 AND a2t.confidence >= 3 AND d.year::integer >= 2015 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, td.organism, cl.confidence_summary, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) > 31 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < '0.0' ORDER BY tc.l1, td.organism, rank_by_avg_value, activity_count DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, td.organism, d.year, cl.confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY act.standard_value) AS median_standard_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS target_rank FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '100' AND cp.alogp >= '-5' AND cp.hba <= 10 AND cp.hbd <= 1 AND a2t.confidence >= 5 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2009 AND td.tax_id = 9693 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, td.organism, d.year, cl.confidence_summary, td.tid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 41 AND AVG(act.standard_value) <= '0' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) AS num_documents, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno LEFT JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno WHERE cp.molregno IN ( SELECT DISTINCT molregno FROM compound_properties WHERE mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '100' AND alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '-5' AND num_ro5_violations <= 1 ) GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 50 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) >= 19 AND AVG(a.standard_value) BETWEEN '0.1' AND '0.1' ORDER BY cp.num_ro5_violations ASC, avg_standard_value DESC LIMIT 128;

a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON td.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession AND a.assay_type = tp.assay_type AND act.standard_type = tp.standard_type WHERE
