AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.0' ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, total_activities DESC LIMIT 779;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-2' AND '2' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 2 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY cp.molregno LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS target_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS document_count, MIN(CAST(d.year AS INTEGER)) AS earliest_year, MAX(CAST(d.year AS INTEGER)) AS latest_year FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ay.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 549230.99 AND 199957.69 AND CAST(d.year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1934 AND 1999 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 1405.08 AND 1238.39 GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 3 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 720072.48 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count FROM target_dictionary t INNER JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid INNER JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid INNER JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id INNER JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id INNER JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno INNER JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno INNER JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase > '100.0' AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2000 AND 2002 AND a2t.confidence >= 3 GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 11 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' AND MIN(cp.mw_freebase) >= '100.0' ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descs, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms_list FROM target_dictionary td LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid LEFT JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id LEFT JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type LEFT JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id LEFT JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 7913.38 AND 74433.06 AND cp.mw_freebase >= 805.78 AND a2t.confidence >= 2.26 AND td.tax_id = 6751.87 GROUP BY td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 57.34 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 72147.22 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 236.2 ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_activity ASC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target at ON td.tid = at.tid JOIN assays a ON at.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2015 AND td.tid IN ( SELECT at2.tid FROM assay2target at2 JOIN assays a2 ON at2.assay_id = a2.assay_id JOIN activities act2 ON a2.assay_id = act2.assay_id WHERE act2.standard_value < '1' AND at2.confidence >= 8 ) GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 5 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '50' ORDER BY assay_count DESC, compound_count DESC;

WITH assay_stats AS ( SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.doc_id, d.year::INTEGER AS publication_year, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0' AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1966 AND 1995 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.doc_id, d.year::INTEGER ), target_info AS ( SELECT at.assay_id, at.tid, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2 FROM assay2target at JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE at.confidence >= 4 ) SELECT ti.target_name, ti.target_organism, ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2, ast.assay_type, ast.publication_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ast.assay_id) AS num_assays, SUM(ast.unique_compounds) AS total_unique_compounds, AVG(ast.avg_standard_value) AS overall_avg_value, MIN(ast.min_standard_value) AS overall_min_value, MAX(ast.max_standard_value) AS overall_max_value FROM target_info ti JOIN assay_stats ast ON ti.assay_id = ast.assay_id GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ti.target_name, ti.target_organism, ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2, ast.assay_type, ast.publication_year), (ti.target_name, ti.target_organism, ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2), (ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2, ast.assay_type), (ti.target_class_l1, ast.assay_type, ast.publication_year), () ) HAVING SUM(ast.unique_compounds) >= 222 ORDER BY total_unique_compounds DESC, overall_avg_value DESC;

WITH filtered_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.doc_id FROM activities a WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 36605.36 AND 77234.32 AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' ) SELECT c.molregno, a.assay_id, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(*) AS activity_count, d.year, d.journal, ass.description AS assay_description FROM filtered_activities a JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 978.09 AND 1327.64 AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY c.molregno, a.assay_id, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, d.year, d.journal, ass.description HAVING COUNT(*) > 26.54 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 148.75;

WITH high_activity_compounds AS ( SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS active_assays_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency FROM activities a WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value <= '0.1' AND a.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY a.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 22 ), ro5_compliant_compounds AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations FROM compound_properties cp WHERE cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '401' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-2' AND '2.1' ) SELECT hc.molregno, hc.active_assays_count, hc.avg_potency, hc.min_potency, rc.mw_freebase, rc.alogp, rc.hba, rc.hbd, rc.rtb, rc.num_ro5_violations FROM high_activity_compounds hc INNER JOIN ro5_compliant_compounds rc ON hc.molregno = rc.molregno ORDER BY hc.active_assays_count DESC, hc.avg_potency ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE a.standard_value > 72766.78 AND a.standard_value < 418590035.33 AND a.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(a.activity_id) > 12 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE c.molregno IN ( SELECT cr.molregno FROM compound_records cr JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.year::integer > 2003 ) AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '-5' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 5 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) AS num_documents, MAX(d.year::INTEGER) AS latest_year FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value <= 5710.91 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 7.71 AND -3.95 AND cp.hba >= 13 AND cp.hbd <= 3 AND td.tid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT tid FROM target_class WHERE l1 = 'None' AND l2 = 'None' ) AND a.assay_id IN ( SELECT assay_id FROM assay2target WHERE confidence >= 2 ) AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2001 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 1 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 2703.75 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_assays DESC;

SELECT cp.mol_id, c.molregno, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_in_class FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND act.standard_value > '0.1' AND d.year >= '1990' AND a2t.confidence = 5 GROUP BY cp.mol_id, c.molregno, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 3 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '100' ORDER BY rank_in_class, avg_activity DESC LIMIT 124;

SELECT cp.mol_id, c.molregno, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_in_class FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND act.standard_value > '0.1' AND d.year >= '1990' AND a2t.confidence = 8 GROUP BY cp.mol_id, c.molregno, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 46 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '100' ORDER BY rank_in_class, avg_activity DESC LIMIT 800;

SELECT cp.molregno, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id WHERE cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = cp.molregno AND cr.doc_id = 88564 ) GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 7 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.record_id) AS distinct_records, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS distinct_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.tc_id) AS distinct_target_classes, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flagged_activities, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON asy.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON asy.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 79121.31 AND 16603.95 AND cp.mw_freebase >= 417.33 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.year::date) >= 2021 AND at.confidence >= 4 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) >= 19 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 255.67 ORDER BY distinct_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(*) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS num_targets, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT td.pref_name, '; ') AS target_names FROM activities a JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON asy.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 668.79 AND 6656.24 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 763.21 AND 792.48 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 2.54 AND -0.88 AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND asy.assay_type = 'B' AND a2t.confidence >= 7 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 14.71 AND COUNT(*) > 15.93 AND AVG(a.standard_value) <= 111.09 ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_potency ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type, cp.molregno) AS avg_activity_per_assay_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type) AS compounds_per_assay_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY c.molweight DESC) AS weight_rank_in_assay FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 396.94 AND 389.57 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 3.64 AND d.year::integer >= 2020 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(act.activity_id) > 8 ORDER BY cp.molregno, a.assay_type, avg_activity_per_assay_type DESC;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.molregno) AS compound_count, COUNT(*) AS activity_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp FROM target_dictionary t JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON ac.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE ac.standard_value BETWEEN 54859.83 AND 96856.36 AND d.year >= '2000' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 195.72 AND 640.82 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 3.3 AND 3.75 AND a2t.confidence >= 3.47 AND t.tax_id = 9784.12 GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 22.35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.molregno) >= 20.25 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) BETWEEN 27450.26 AND 77625.26 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, compound_count DESC;

SELECT td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.molregno) AS unique_compounds, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays ass ON a2t.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 645.05 AND a.standard_value < 650990.62 AND cp.mw_freebase > 387.86 AND cp.mw_freebase < 720.23 AND a2t.confidence >= 5 AND d.year::integer >= 2019 AND d.year::integer <= 2024 AND td.tax_id = 9679 GROUP BY td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 67 AND AVG(cp.mw_freebase) > 553.67 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_mw DESC LIMIT 57;

WITH compound_activity_stats AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, a.assay_type) AS assays_per_type, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, td.organism) AS avg_activity_per_organism, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 396388.93 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 766.26 AND 982.34 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -2.69 AND 6.67 AND cp.hba <= 17.77 AND cp.hbd <= 6.94 AND td.tax_id = 9883.14 ) SELECT molregno, assay_type, target_name, target_organism, target_class_l1, target_class_l2, COUNT(DISTINCT assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(standard_value) AS max_activity, AVG(mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(alogp) AS avg_logp, SUM(hba) AS total_hba, SUM(hbd) AS total_hbd, MAX(assays_per_type) AS max_assays_per_type, AVG(avg_activity_per_organism) AS overall_organism_avg FROM compound_activity_stats WHERE activity_rank <= 16.07 GROUP BY molregno, assay_type, target_name, target_organism, target_class_l1, target_class_l2 HAVING AVG(standard_value) BETWEEN 930.21 AND 6058.38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT assay_id) >= 9.23 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC, num_assays DESC LIMIT 764.91;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(a.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM compounds c INNER JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno INNER JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno INNER JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id INNER JOIN assay2target at2 ON ay.assay_id = at2.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 700.25 AND 759.37 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 3.05 AND -1.4 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ay.assay_type = 'B' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(a.activity_id) >= 7.59 AND AVG(a.standard_value) <= 3895.98 ) SELECT cas.molregno, cas.molformula, cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.num_ro5_violations, cas.num_assays, cas.num_activities, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS num_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ' ORDER BY cs.synonyms) AS all_synonyms FROM compound_activity_summary cas LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cas.molregno = cs.molregno GROUP BY cas.molregno, cas.molformula, cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.num_ro5_violations, cas.num_assays, cas.num_activities, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency ORDER BY cas.avg_potency ASC, cas.num_activities DESC LIMIT 513.45;

SELECT a.assay_id, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS active_compounds FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value <= '0.1' AND a.doc_id IN ( SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) >= 2018 ) AND act.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY a.assay_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 87 ORDER BY active_compounds DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, td.organism, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type) AS avg_assay_type_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) DESC) AS rank_by_compounds FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value > 82622.58 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 437.19 AND 692.32 AND td.tax_id = 9894 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, td.organism, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 8 ORDER BY num_compounds DESC, a.assay_id;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS synonyms_list, AVG(act.published_value) AS avg_published_value, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS target_count, MAX(tc.l3) AS top_target_class, AVG(a2t.confidence) AS avg_confidence, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS doc_count, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MAX(v.creation_date)) AS latest_version_year FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN version v ON v.creation_date > '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type LEFT JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2022 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 1 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 46 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 587;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(c.molweight) AS min_molweight, MAX(c.molweight) AS max_molweight FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 379.69 AND 329.17 AND cp.alogp >= 9.72 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2022 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 3 AND AVG(a.standard_value) BETWEEN 637.63 AND 94.03 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, SUM(cp.mw_freebase) AS total_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT td.pref_name, '; ') AS target_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l2, '; ') AS target_classes, COUNT(DISTINCT at2.tid) AS distinct_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS distinct_docs, MAX(d.year::INTEGER) AS latest_year, MIN(d.year::INTEGER) AS earliest_year FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities a ON cr.record_id = a.record_id AND cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target at2 ON ass.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at2.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id AND a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value >= '0.0' AND cp.mw_freebase <= '100.0' AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1949 AND 1994 AND cp.num_ro5_violations >= 0 AND at2.confidence >= 7 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 36 AND AVG(a.standard_value) BETWEEN '0.0' AND '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT at2.tid) >= 47 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 988;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_activities, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT td.pref_name) AS target_names, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.tc_id) AS target_classes_count FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON asy.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN docs d ON asy.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 9 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT tc.tc_id) >= 8 ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 75;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description AS assay_description, t.tid, t.pref_name AS target_pref_name, t.organism AS target_organism, t.target_type, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, d.year AS doc_year, d.journal AS doc_journal, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.molregno, t.tid) AS avg_activity_per_target, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tid ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS activity_rank_per_target FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '400' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2019 GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, t.target_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 2 ORDER BY cp.molregno, t.tid, act.standard_value DESC;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS total_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_activities, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_logp FROM target_dictionary t JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '500' AND d.year::integer >= 2005 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 7 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '100' UNION ALL SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS total_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_activities, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_logp FROM target_dictionary t JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value <= '0' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND d.year::integer < 2001 AND a2t.confidence < 1 GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) <= 0 AND AVG(act.standard_value) >= '1000' ORDER BY total_assays DESC, avg_potency ASC;

SELECT td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays ass ON a2t.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 576033.8 AND 731593.17 AND td.tax_id = 655336.88 AND a2t.confidence >= 9.12 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 445.94 AND 1958.64 AND ass.assay_type IN (SELECT at.assay_type FROM assay_type at WHERE at.assay_desc LIKE '%''%') AND td.tid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT a2t_inner.tid FROM assay2target a2t_inner WHERE a2t_inner.relationship_type = '''' AND a2t_inner.multi = 0 AND a2t_inner.tid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT tc_inner.tid FROM target_class tc_inner WHERE tc_inner.l1 LIKE '%''%' AND tc_inner.l2 IS NOT NULL ) ) GROUP BY td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) > 831.19 AND AVG(cp.mw_freebase) BETWEEN 488.28 AND 1757.77 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_mw ASC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mol_weight, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mol_weight, SUM(cp.num_ro5_violations) AS total_ro5_violations, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1, tc.l2 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) DESC) AS assay_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) DESC) AS compound_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) DESC) AS prev_assay_count FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value > '0.0' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '1000.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations >= 4 AND d.year >= '1990' AND a2t.confidence >= 2 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a.assay_type HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < '1000.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 65 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, compound_count DESC;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_units, a.standard_flag, a.published_activity_type, a.activity_comment, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, c.molformula, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, td.protein_accession, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC ) AS activity_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value ) AS potency_percentile, AVG(a.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_id ) AS assay_avg_potency, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.molregno ) AS compound_activity_count FROM activities a JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assays a_s ON a.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a_s.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value BETWEEN 88134.38 AND 84916.07 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 322.26 AND 328.71 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 2.39 AND 1.94 AND d.year::integer >= 2004 ) SELECT ra.molregno, ra.pref_name AS target_name, ra.assay_type, ra.standard_type, ra.standard_value, ra.potency_percentile, ra.assay_avg_potency, ra.compound_activity_count, ra.mw_freebase, ra.alogp, ra.hba, ra.hbd, ra.psa, ra.rtb, ra.num_ro5_violations, ra.ro3_pass, ra.med_chem_friendly, ra.l1 AS target_class_l1, ra.l2 AS target_class_l2, ra.confidence_summary, ra.year, ra.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_potency_per_target FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.activity_rank = 1 AND ra.potency_percentile >= 0.27 GROUP BY ra.molregno, ra.pref_name, ra.assay_type, ra.standard_type, ra.standard_value, ra.potency_percentile, ra.assay_avg_potency, ra.compound_activity_count, ra.mw_freebase, ra.alogp, ra.hba, ra.hbd, ra.psa, ra.rtb, ra.num_ro5_violations, ra.ro3_pass, ra.med_chem_friendly, ra.l1, ra.l2, ra.confidence_summary, ra.year, ra.journal HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) >= 6 ORDER BY ra.potency_percentile DESC, avg_potency_per_target ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_activity FROM assays a JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id WHERE ac.standard_value > 93096.27 AND ac.standard_flag = 0 GROUP BY a.assay_id ORDER BY avg_activity DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS synonyms_list, AVG(act.published_value) AS avg_published_value, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS target_count, MAX(tc.l3) AS top_target_class, AVG(a2t.confidence) AS avg_confidence, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS doc_count, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MAX(v.creation_date)) AS latest_version_year FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN version v ON v.creation_date > '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type LEFT JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2020 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 10 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 95 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 280;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_activity, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, ', ') AS all_synonyms FROM compounds c JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 976.27 AND 814.24 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -3.02 AND 1.93 AND (cs.synonyms LIKE '%Drug%' OR c.molformula LIKE 'C%') GROUP BY c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 4.33 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) BETWEEN 8075.08 AND 2847.72 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC, num_assays DESC LIMIT 100;

act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '-5.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 4 AND cp.hba >= 6 AND cp.hbd <= 5 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_units = 'nM' AND a2t.confidence >= 7 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 1996 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '100.0' AND cp.rtb >= 5 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_units = 'nM' AND a2t.relationship_type = 'D' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND d.year::INTEGER <= 1990 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism) AS avg_activity_per_assay_organism, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism) AS count_activities_per_assay_organism, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id AND act.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value > '0.0' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '0.0' AND '0.0' AND cp.alogp >= '-10.0' AND d.year::integer >= 1967 AND a2t.confidence >= 0 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 3 AND act.standard_flag = 0 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal, td.organism HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) > 43 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.0' ORDER BY activity_rank, avg_activity_per_assay_organism DESC;

WITH ranked_compounds AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, d.year, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism ORDER BY act.standard_value ASC ) AS potency_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY c.molregno ORDER BY act.standard_value ASC ) AS best_assay_per_compound FROM compounds c INNER JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno INNER JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno INNER JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id INNER JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid INNER JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid INNER JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id AND a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_flag = 1 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 548.03 AND 431.08 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -0.13 AND 2.12 AND a2t.confidence >= 6.35 AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 2005.42 AND 2020.46 AND act.standard_value BETWEEN 7197.13 AND 97802.83 ) SELECT rc.molregno, rc.molweight, rc.mw_freebase, rc.alogp, rc.hba, rc.hbd, rc.assay_type, rc.standard_value, rc.standard_type, rc.standard_units, rc.pref_name, rc.organism, rc.l1, rc.l2, rc.l3, rc.year, rc.potency_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT rc.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(rc.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY rc.l1, rc.organism) AS avg_potency_by_class_organism FROM ranked_compounds rc WHERE rc.best_assay_per_compound = 1 AND rc.potency_rank <= 84.13 GROUP BY rc.molregno, rc.molweight, rc.mw_freebase, rc.alogp, rc.hba, rc.hbd, rc.assay_type, rc.standard_value, rc.standard_type, rc.standard_units, rc.pref_name, rc.organism, rc.l1, rc.l2, rc.l3, rc.year, rc.potency_rank HAVING AVG(rc.standard_value) < 1817.68 ORDER BY rc.potency_rank, rc.standard_value;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description AS assay_description, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism ORDER BY c.molweight ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_activity, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism ORDER BY c.molweight ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_compound_count FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 565919.11 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 1.02 AND -4.97 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a.assay_type = 'B' GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, td.pref_name, td.organism, c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type ORDER BY a.assay_id, c.molweight;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, d.year, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw FROM assays a JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE d.year::integer >= 2006 AND d.year::integer <= 2006 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase > 819.57 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 26 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN docs d ON s.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value >= 814519.57 AND d.year >= '1900' AND cp.mw_freebase <= 43.31 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 27.97 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 560075.49 ORDER BY assay_count DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.record_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno) AS num_synonyms FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN -4.8 AND 4.23 AND cp.hba BETWEEN 8.7 AND 6.62 AND cp.hbd BETWEEN 1.84 AND 2.99 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 5744.98 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 2.85 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 6933.07 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_activities DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, c.molregno ) AS synonym_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activities act2 WHERE act2.molregno = c.molregno AND act2.standard_value IS NOT NULL ) AS total_activities, ( SELECT AVG(act3.standard_value) FROM cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, d.journal, d.year, act.standard_value, cl.confidence_summary, cl.description HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 8 ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC, act.standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

cl.confidence_summary, cl.description, a2t.confidence, a2t.relationship_type, rl.relationship_desc, tt.target_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 7 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.0' ORDER SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno AND cs.synonyms IS NOT NULL) AS synonym_count, (SELECT MIN(d.year) FROM docs d WHERE d.doc_id IN (SELECT cr.doc_id FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = c.molregno)) AS earliest_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_class FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value > 58202.76 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1957 AND 1947 AND cl.confidence >= 7 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 12 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 91692.14 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC, rank_by_class LIMIT 58;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS max_standard_value, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT td.pref_name, '; ') AS target_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes_l1, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno) AS ro3_pass_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno LEFT JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id LEFT JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '200' AND cp.alogp >= '-5' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = c.molregno AND cr.doc_id = a.doc_id ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM confidence_lookup cl WHERE cl.confidence = at.confidence AND cl.confidence_summary = 'High' ) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.ro3_pass HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 28 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0' ORDER BY activity_rank, avg_standard_value DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) AS activity_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ac.standard_value) DESC) AS standard_value_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 974.58 AND 947.47 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -0.2 AND -0.05 AND ac.standard_value > 17103.03 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) >= 16.41 ORDER BY standard_value_rank LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.tid) AS target_count, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, cl.confidence_summary, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms, d.year AS publication_year, d.journal AS publication_journal FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id AND a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 369.89 AND 483.13 AND cp.alogp >= 2.12 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 61.34 AND d.year >= '2010' AND cl.confidence >= 7 AND a2t.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, td.organism, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 25 AND AVG(act.standard_value) <= 823.4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.tid) >= 9 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC, target_count DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) AS record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT at.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS target_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT td.pref_name, '; ') AS target_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT at.assay_id) DESC) AS assay_rank FROM compounds c LEFT JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno LEFT JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno LEFT JOIN assays at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id LEFT JOIN assay2target a2t ON at.assay_id = a2t.assay_id LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN docs d ON at.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE c.molweight BETWEEN 432.63 AND 373.49 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 8.43 AND 9.56 AND cp.hba BETWEEN 8.76 AND 13.05 AND cp.hbd BETWEEN 8.02 AND 9.91 AND a.standard_value BETWEEN 467011.78 AND 277625.35 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.year::timestamp) BETWEEN 2005.77 AND 2021.05 AND a2t.confidence >= 8.8 AND (td.in_drugstore = 1 OR td.in_starlite = 1) AND a.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 87.64 AND COUNT(DISTINCT at.assay_id) >= 43.01 AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) >= 2.3 AND AVG(a.standard_value) BETWEEN 18.39 AND 3854.63 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 184.59;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT at2.tid) AS target_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON asy.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 9086.1 AND 1444.44 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 246.91 AND 315.76 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 8.89 AND 1.59 AND asy.assay_type = 'A' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 19.42 AND AVG(a.standard_value) BETWEEN 282.67 AND 4256.0 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 129.97;
