a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '500.0' AND cp.alogp >= '-5.0' AND cp.hba <= 19 AND cp.hbd <= 2 AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 2 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 0 AND d.year::integer >= 2019 AND a2t.confidence >= 3 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, c.molformula, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, cr.record_id, cr.compound_name, act.activity_id, act.standard_value, act.standard_flag, act.published_value, act.published_activity_type, act.relation, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, cl.description, at.assay_desc, tt.target_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.gene_names, td.organism, td.protein_accession, a2t.assay_organism, a2t.assay_strain, a2t.confidence, a2t.relationship_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 98 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.0' AND MAX(act.published_value) >= '0.0' ORDER BY cp.molregno, act.standard_value DESC, a.assay_id, d.year::integer DESC;

WITH assay_based_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM activities a JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 289.56 AND s.assay_type = '' GROUP BY a.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 47.52 ), target_based_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT at.tid) AS num_targets, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM activities a JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value <= 892.44 AND td.organism = '' GROUP BY a.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT at.tid) >= 10.91 ) SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, ab.num_assays, tb.num_targets, ab.avg_potency AS assay_avg_potency, tb.avg_potency AS target_avg_potency FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assay_based_activities ab ON c.molregno = ab.molregno JOIN target_based_activities tb ON c.molregno = tb.molregno WHERE c.molweight BETWEEN 324.77 AND 325.5 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 6.69 AND -1.38 ORDER BY c.molregno LIMIT 1000;

WITH assay_stats AS ( SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency, COUNT(*) AS total_measurements, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) DESC) AS assay_rank FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 410.1 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND td.tax_id = 9761 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence ), compound_activity AS ( SELECT c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT ast.assay_id) AS active_assays, AVG(ast.avg_potency) AS avg_potency_across_assays, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ast.assay_id) DESC, AVG(ast.avg_potency) DESC) AS compound_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assay_stats ast ON act.assay_id = ast.assay_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 213.53 AND 538.65 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 GROUP BY c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations ) SELECT ast.assay_type, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, cl.confidence_summary, ast.unique_compounds, ast.avg_potency, ast.min_potency, ast.max_potency, ast.total_measurements, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.molregno) AS ro5_compliant_compounds, AVG(ca.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(ca.alogp) AS avg_logp, ast.assay_rank FROM assay_stats ast JOIN target_dictionary td ON ast.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON ast.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN compound_activity ca ON ca.active_assays > 0 WHERE ast.assay_rank <= 4 AND ast.unique_compounds >= 78 GROUP BY ast.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, cl.confidence_summary, ast.unique_compounds, ast.avg_potency, ast.min_potency, ast.max_potency, ast.total_measurements, ast.assay_rank ORDER BY ast.assay_rank ASC, ast.unique_compounds DESC, ast.avg_potency ASC;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.doc_id) AS num_publications, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, COUNT(*) AS total_measurements, COUNT(DISTINCT at2.tid) AS num_targets, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes FROM activities a JOIN assays asay ON a.assay_id = asay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 0 AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND at2.confidence >= 9 GROUP BY a.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 5 ), compound_property_ranges AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = cp.molregno) AS num_synonyms, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = cp.molregno) AS num_record_docs FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '1000.0' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '0.0' ) SELECT cpr.molregno, cpr.mw_freebase, cpr.alogp, cpr.hba, cpr.hbd, cpr.psa, cpr.rtb, cpr.num_ro5_violations, cpr.ro3_pass, cpr.med_chem_friendly, cpr.molweight, cpr.num_synonyms, cpr.num_record_docs, cas.num_assays, cas.num_publications, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency, cas.total_measurements, cas.num_targets, cas.target_classes, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a2.assay_id) FROM activities a2 JOIN assays asay2 ON a2.assay_id = asay2.assay_id WHERE a2.molregno = cpr.molregno AND a2.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND asay2.assay_type = 'B' AND a2.standard_type = 'IC50') AS ic50_bioassay_count, (SELECT AVG(a3.standard_value) FROM activities a3 JOIN assays asay3 ON a3.assay_id = asay3.assay_id JOIN assay2target at3 ON a3.assay_id = at3.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td3 ON at3.tid = td3.tid WHERE a3.molregno = cpr.molregno AND a3.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a3.standard_value > 0 AND td3.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a3.standard_type IN ('IC50', 'Ki', 'Kd')) AS human_target_avg_potency, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cas.num_targets DESC, cas.num_assays DESC) AS target_diversity_rank, CASE WHEN cpr.num_ro5_violations <= 1 AND cpr.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 'High' WHEN cpr.num_ro5_violations <= 2 AND cpr.ro3_pass IN ('Y', 'N') THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS druglikeliness_score FROM compound_property_ranges cpr JOIN compound_activity_summary cas ON cpr.molregno = cas.molregno WHERE cas.avg_potency <= '0.1' AND cas.num_targets >= 10 AND cpr.hba BETWEEN 0 AND 9 ORDER BY cas.num_targets DESC, cas.avg_potency ASC, druglikeliness_score DESC LIMIT 636;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.doc_id) AS num_documents, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, MAX(d.year::integer) AS latest_year, MIN(d.year::integer) AS earliest_year FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN docs d ON s.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' AND d.year::integer >= 2014 AND d.year::integer <= 2019 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '100.0' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '-5.0' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 21 ) SELECT cas.molregno, cas.molweight, cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.hba, cas.hbd, cas.num_assays, cas.num_documents, cas.num_activities, cas.avg_standard_value, cas.min_standard_value, cas.max_standard_value, cas.latest_year, cas.earliest_year, cs.synonyms AS primary_synonym, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cas.num_activities DESC) AS activity_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cas.num_assays DESC) AS assay_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY cas.avg_standard_value DESC) AS potency_rank_by_class FROM compound_activity_summary cas LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cas.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN activities a2 ON cas.molregno = a2.molregno LEFT JOIN assays s2 ON a2.assay_id = s2.assay_id LEFT JOIN assay2target at2 ON s2.assay_id = at2.assay_id LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE a2.standard_flag = 1 AND at2.confidence >= 0 AND tc.l1 IS NOT NULL AND cs.synonyms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cas.molregno, cas.molweight, cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.hba, cas.hbd, cas.num_assays, cas.num_documents, cas.num_activities, cas.avg_standard_value, cas.min_standard_value, cas.max_standard_value, cas.latest_year, cas.earliest_year, cs.synonyms, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 ORDER BY cas.num_activities DESC, cas.avg_standard_value DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.published_activity_type, a.relation, a.activity_comment, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, c.molformula, cs.synonyms, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_desc, d.year, d.journal, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS rank_within_assay, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id) AS activity_count_per_assay FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '200' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2003 AND a.standard_units = 'nM' ), aggregated_compounds AS ( SELECT ra.molregno, ra.pref_name AS target_name, ra.organism, ra.target_type, ra.l1 AS target_class_l1, ra.l2 AS target_class_l2, ra.year, ra.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.standard_type = 'IC50' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ic50_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.standard_type = 'Ki' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ki_count, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_activity, STDDEV(ra.standard_value) AS stddev_activity, AVG(ra.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(ra.alogp) AS avg_alogp, SUM(ra.hba) AS total_hba, SUM(ra.hbd) AS total_hbd, AVG(ra.psa) AS avg_psa, SUM(ra.rtb) AS total_rtb, SUM(ra.num_ro5_violations) AS total_ro5_violations, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.confidence_summary, '; ') AS confidence_levels, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.rank_within_assay = 1 AND ra.activity_count_per_assay >= 1 GROUP BY ra.molregno, ra.pref_name, ra.organism, ra.target_type, ra.l1, ra.l2, ra.year, ra.journal HAVING AVG(ra.standard_value) < '1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) > 2 AND SUM(ra.num_ro5_violations) <= 3 ) SELECT ac.*, cp2.ro3_pass, cp2.med_chem_friendly, td2.gene_names, td2.protein_accession, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ac.avg_activity ASC, ac.total_activities DESC) AS compound_rank FROM aggregated_compounds ac JOIN compound_properties cp2 ON ac.molregno = cp2.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON ac.molregno = cr.molregno LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td2 ON cr.doc_id = td2.tid WHERE cp2.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' AND (cp2.ro3_pass = 'Y' OR cp2.ro3_pass IS NULL) AND ac.total_ro5_violations <= 0 ORDER BY compound_rank, ac.avg_activity ASC LIMIT 944;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS rank_by_value FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 48535.6 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 424.31 AND 238.54 ) SELECT ra.molregno, ra.assay_id, ra.standard_value, ra.standard_type, ra.mw_freebase, ra.alogp, ra.hba, ra.hbd, ra.psa, ra.rtb, ra.num_ro5_violations, ra.ro3_pass, ra.med_chem_friendly, ra.rank_by_value, AVG(ra.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY ra.molregno) AS avg_activity_per_compound, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ra.molregno) AS total_activities_per_compound FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.rank_by_value <= 5 ORDER BY ra.molregno, ra.rank_by_value;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(act.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, cl.confidence_summary FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at2.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_flag = 1 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND (act.standard_value > '100.0' OR act.standard_value < '0.0') AND a.assay_type IN ('A', 'A') AND d.year >= '1990' AND at2.confidence >= 2 AND NOT (td.organism = 'Escherichia coli' AND tc.l1 = 'Enzyme') GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, cl.confidence_summary HAVING COUNT(act.activity_id) > 94 AND AVG(act.standard_value) BETWEEN '1.0' AND '10.0' ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 48;

SELECT a.assay_type, a.assay_id, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_logp FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE a.assay_id IN ( SELECT a2.assay_id FROM assays a2 JOIN docs d ON a2.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2014 AND 2004 ) AND cp.mw_freebase > '200.0' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-2.0' AND '-2.0' AND a2t.confidence >= 9 GROUP BY a.assay_type, a.assay_id, td.pref_name, tc.l2, cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 30 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE a.standard_value > 60383.44 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 594.85 AND 523.79 AND a.assay_id IN ( SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE doc_id = 1862 ) GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 9 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno) AS synonym_count FROM compounds c JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 3854.38 AND 880.16 AND a.assay_type = 'A' AND cp.mw_freebase >= 694.03 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -4.95 AND -1.05 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 5.58 AND AVG(act.standard_value) <= 5088.43 ORDER BY avg_activity ASC, assay_count DESC LIMIT 29.54;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity_value, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 29582.49 AND a.standard_value < 25763114.85 AND ass.doc_id IN ( SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2022 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno AND LENGTH(cs.synonyms) > 7 ) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) > 7378.66 ORDER BY avg_activity_value DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno LEFT JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND cp.hba >= 9 AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 9 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0' ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description AS assay_description, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, at.assay_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, act.standard_value, act.published_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, act.published_activity_type, cl.confidence_summary, a2t.confidence, a2t.relationship_type, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) AS record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, STDDEV(act.standard_value) AS std_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id AND act.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id ') AS compound_synonyms_list, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS num_publications, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.tid) AS num_targets_per_assay FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno AND cp.mw_freebase > '200' JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND act.standard_value BETWEEN '0.1' AND '10000' JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id AND a2t.confidence >= 9 JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid AND tc.l1 IS NOT NULL JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND d.year::integer >= 2006 LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON td.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession WHERE cp.alogp <= '-5' AND cp.hba >= 5 AND cp.hbd <= 3 AND cp.psa BETWEEN '0' AND '50' AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 0 AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND act.standard_units = 'nM' AND act.standard_type IN ('IC50', 'Ki', 'Kd') AND a.assay_type IN ('B', 'F') AND a2t.relationship_type IN ('D', 'H') AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND tc.l2 LIKE '%enzyme%' GROUP BY c.molregno, cp.mol_id, a.assay_id, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, cl.confidence_summary HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 8 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '100' AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) >= 5 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_activities DESC LIMIT 61;

SELECT c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, COUNT(DISTINCT a.record_id) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities a ON cr.record_id = a.record_id JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ay.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200.0' AND '300.0' AND cp.alogp >= '-2.0' AND cp.hba <= 3 AND cp.hbd <= 1 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND ay.assay_type = 'B' AND at.confidence >= 6 AND tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' AND d.year::integer >= 2015 GROUP BY c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 2 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, total_activities DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.record_id) AS distinct_records, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS distinct_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.tc_id) AS distinct_target_classes, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flagged_activities, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON asy.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON asy.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 65974.06 AND 46327.79 AND cp.mw_freebase >= 684.88 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.year::date) >= 2007 AND at.confidence >= 7 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 28 AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) >= 18 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 8668.59 ORDER BY distinct_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.year AS publication_year, d.journal, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, act.published_value, act.published_units, act.published_activity_type, cl.confidence_summary, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY cp.molregno, a.assay_type ORDER BY d.year::INTEGER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_standard_value, COUNT(act.activity_id) OVER ( PARTITION BY cp.molregno, td.tid ) AS target_activity_count, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC ) AS potency_rank_per_assay FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 273.77 AND 749.73 AND cp.alogp > 1.9 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2019 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.year, d.journal, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, act.published_value, act.published_units, act.published_activity_type, cl.confidence_summary, act.activity_id, td.tid HAVING COUNT(act.activity_id) > 1 ORDER BY cp.molregno, moving_avg_standard_value DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_type, a.description AS assay_description, cl.confidence_summary, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, tc.l3 AS target_class_l3, td.organism AS target_organism, td.pref_name AS target_pref_name, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS aggregated_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT td.gene_names, '; ') AS aggregated_gene_names FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 679.0 AND 973.85 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (cp.molregno, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_type, a.description, cl.confidence_summary, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, td.organism, td.pref_name), (cp.molregno, cp.alogp, cp.mw_freebase, a.assay_type, cl.confidence_summary), (a.assay_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3), (td.organism, td.pref_name), () ) HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < 1182.61 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 70 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH assay_aggregates AS ( SELECT a.assay_id, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) a2t.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 0 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 GROUP BY a.assay_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 78 ), compound_property_analysis AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, c.molweight, COUNT(DISTINCT act.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, act.molregno JOIN assay_aggregates aa ON act.assay_id = aa.assay_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '1000.0' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '0.0' AND (cp.hba <= 5 OR cp.hbd <= 0) AND target_classification_analysis AS ( SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_activities FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_property_analysis cpa ON act.molregno = cpa.molregno WHERE td.tax_id IS NOT NULL AND td.organism NOT IN ('Unknown', 'N/A') AND tc.l1 IS NOT NULL AND (a2t.confidence >= 3 OR a2t.relationship_type = 'D') AND act.standard_value BETWEEN '0.1' AND '1000.0' GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 21 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ), document_analysis AS ( SELECT d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.molregno) AS compound_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency FROM docs d JOIN assays a ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id AND cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN compound_property_analysis cpa ON cr.molregno = cpa.molregno JOIN target_classification_analysis tca ON a.assay_id IN ( SELECT a2t.assay_id FROM assay2target a2t WHERE a2t.tid = tca.tid ) WHERE d.year >= '2000' AND d.journal IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 0 AND cpa.assay_count >= 20 GROUP BY d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 1 AND AVG(act.standard_value) BETWEEN '0.1' AND '1000.0' ) SELECT tca.tid, tca.pref_name AS target_name, tca.organism AS target_organism, tca.l1 AS target_class_level1, tca.l2 AS target_class_level2, COUNT(DISTINCT cpa.molregno) AS total_compounds, AVG(cpa.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(cpa.alogp) AS avg_logp, SUM(cpa.num_ro5_violations) AS total_ro5_violations, AVG(cpa.avg_activity) AS avg_compound_potency, MIN(cpa.median_activity) AS min_median_potency, MAX(cpa.assay_count) AS max_assays_per_compound, COUNT(DISTINCT da.doc_id) AS document_count, AVG(da.avg_potency) AS avg_document_potency, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT da.journal, '; ' ORDER BY da.journal) AS journals, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cpa.avg_activity) AS q1_potency, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cpa.avg_activity) AS q3_potency, STDDEV(cpa.avg_activity) AS stddev_potency FROM target_classification_analysis tca JOIN assay2target a2t ON tca.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_property_analysis cpa ON act.molregno = cpa.molregno JOIN document_analysis da ON a.doc_id = da.doc_id WHERE tca.assay_count >= 4 AND tca.compound_count >= 36 AND cpa.assay_count >= 8 AND da.assay_count >= 1 AND (tca.avg_potency < '0.1' OR cpa.avg_activity < '0.1') AND NOT (tca.l1 = 'Enzyme' AND tca.l2 = 'Oxidoreductase') GROUP BY tca.tid, tca.pref_name, tca.organism, tca.l1, tca.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cpa.molregno) >= 38 AND AVG(cpa.avg_activity) BETWEEN '0.1' AND '1000.0' WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_units, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, at.assay_desc, cl.confidence_summary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC ) as activity_rank, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ) as total_measurements FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON asy.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 728.12 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 693.81 AND 427.75 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -1.77 AND -0.92 AND a2t.confidence >= 0.08 ) SELECT ra.molregno, ra.assay_id, ra.standard_type, ra.standard_units, ra.assay_desc, ra.confidence_summary, AVG(ra.standard_value) as avg_potency, MIN(ra.standard_value) as min_potency, MAX(ra.standard_value) as max_potency, COUNT(*) as valid_measurements, ra.mw_freebase, ra.alogp, ra.hba, ra.hbd, ra.psa, ra.rtb, ra.num_ro5_violations FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.activity_rank = 1 AND ra.total_measurements >= 8.81 GROUP BY ra.molregno, ra.assay_id, ra.standard_type, ra.standard_units, ra.assay_desc, ra.confidence_summary, ra.mw_freebase, ra.alogp, ra.hba, ra.hbd, ra.psa, ra.rtb, ra.num_ro5_violations HAVING AVG(ra.standard_value) > 510.02 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, ra.molregno, ra.assay_id;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.doc_id) AS document_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp, AVG(cp.psa) AS avg_psa, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT atype.assay_type, '; ') AS assay_types, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ttype.target_desc, '; ') AS target_descriptions, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MAX(v.creation_date)) AS latest_version_year FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON act.molregno = cr.molregno AND act.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN docs d ON act.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay_type atype ON a.assay_type = atype.assay_type JOIN target_type ttype ON td.target_type = ttype.target_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN version v ON v.creation_date >= '2000-01-01' WHERE a2t.confidence >= 2 AND act.standard_value BETWEEN '0.1' AND '0.1' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v.creation_date) >= 2017 AND td.in_drugstore = 0 AND td.in_starlite = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase >= '100.0' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '-5.0' AND a2t.multi = 1 AND a2t.complex = 1 AND act.standard_flag = 0 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 59 AND AVG(act.standard_value) <= '0.1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 30 ORDER BY compound_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 140;

WITH assay_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_units, a.relation, a.published_activity_type, a.doc_id, a.record_id, ass.assay_type, ass.description AS assay_description, cl.confidence_summary, cl.description AS confidence_description, att.tid, att.relationship_type AS assay_relationship_type, att.confidence AS target_confidence, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.protein_accession, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, tc.l3 AS target_class_l3, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay2target att ON a.assay_id = att.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON att.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON att.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND att.confidence >= 9 AND d.year::integer >= 2020 ), compound_metrics AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cs.synonyms AS compound_synonym, cr.compound_name, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(aa.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE aa.standard_type = 'IC50') AS avg_ic50, MIN(aa.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE aa.standard_type = 'IC50') AS min_ic50, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.tid) AS num_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.target_class_l1) AS num_target_classes, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT aa.target_name, '; ') AS target_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT aa.assay_type, '; ') AS assay_types FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN assay_activities aa ON c.molregno = aa.molregno WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND cp.hba <= 12 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cs.synonyms, cr.compound_name ), target_activity_summary AS ( SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.molregno) AS num_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(aa.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(aa.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(aa.standard_value) AS max_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.year) AS num_years, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT aa.journal, '; ') AS journals, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT aa.molregno) DESC) AS rank_in_class FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay_activities aa ON td.tid = aa.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 ) SELECT cm.molregno, cm.compound_name, cm.compound_synonym, cm.mw_freebase, cm.alogp, cm.hba, cm.hbd, cm.num_ro5_violations, cm.ro3_pass, cm.med_chem_friendly, cm.num_assays, cm.num_targets, cm.num_target_classes, cm.avg_ic50, cm.min_ic50, tas.pref_name AS primary_target, tas.organism AS target_organism, tas.target_type, tas.l1 AS target_class_l1, tas.l2 AS target_class_l2, tas.l3 AS target_class_l3, tas.num_compounds AS target_total_compounds, tas.avg_activity AS target_avg_activity, tas.rank_in_class, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.pubmed_id) AS num_publications, MIN(aa.year::integer) AS first_year, MAX(aa.year::integer) AS last_year, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY aa.standard_value) AS median_activity, STDDEV(aa.standard_value) AS activity_stddev FROM compound_metrics cm JOIN assay_activities aa ON cm.molregno = aa.molregno JOIN target_activity_summary tas ON aa.tid = tas.tid WHERE cm.num_assays >= 5 AND cm.num_targets >= 13 AND cm.avg_ic50 <= '0.1' AND tas.num_compounds >= 243 AND tas.rank_in_class <= 20 GROUP BY cm.molregno, cm.compound_name, cm.compound_synonym, cm.mw_freebase, cm.alogp, cm.hba, cm.hbd, cm.num_ro5_violations, cm.ro3_pass, cm.med_chem_friendly, cm.num_assays, cm.num_targets, cm.num_target_classes, cm.avg_ic50, cm.min_ic50, tas.pref_name, tas.organism, tas.target_type, tas.l1, tas.l2, tas.l3, tas.num_compounds, tas.avg_activity, tas.rank_in_class HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT aa.assay_id) >= 21 AND AVG(aa.standard_value) <= '0.1' ORDER BY cm.min_ic50 ASC, cm.num_targets DESC, tas.rank_in_class ASC LIMIT 395;

SELECT a.assay_id, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT act.record_id) AS unique_records, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.tid) AS unique_targets, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid WHERE act.standard_value > '0' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '200' AND td.tax_id = 9673 GROUP BY a.assay_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 100 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC;

WITH assay_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_units, a.relation, a.published_activity_type, a.doc_id, a.record_id, ass.assay_type, ass.description AS assay_description, cl.confidence_summary, cl.description AS confidence_description, att.tid, att.relationship_type AS assay_relationship_type, att.confidence AS target_confidence, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.protein_accession, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, tc.l3 AS target_class_l3, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay2target att ON a.assay_id = att.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON att.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON att.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND att.confidence >= 9 AND d.year::integer >= 1991 ), compound_metrics AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cs.synonyms AS compound_synonym, cr.compound_name, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(aa.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE aa.standard_type = 'IC50') AS avg_ic50, MIN(aa.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE aa.standard_type = 'IC50') AS min_ic50, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.tid) AS num_targets, COUNT(DISTINCT aa.target_class_l1) AS num_target_classes, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT aa.target_name, '; WITH assay_stats AS ( SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.doc_id, d.year::INTEGER AS publication_year, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0' AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1942 AND 1938 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.doc_id, d.year::INTEGER ), target_info AS ( SELECT at.assay_id, at.tid, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2 FROM assay2target at JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE at.confidence >= 2 ) SELECT ti.target_name, ti.target_organism, ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2, ast.assay_type, ast.publication_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ast.assay_id) AS num_assays, SUM(ast.unique_compounds) AS total_unique_compounds, AVG(ast.avg_standard_value) AS overall_avg_value, MIN(ast.min_standard_value) AS overall_min_value, MAX(ast.max_standard_value) AS overall_max_value FROM target_info ti JOIN assay_stats ast ON ti.assay_id = ast.assay_id GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ti.target_name, ti.target_organism, ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2, ast.assay_type, ast.publication_year), (ti.target_name, ti.target_organism, ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2), (ti.target_class_l1, ti.target_class_l2, ast.assay_type), (ti.target_class_l1, ast.assay_type, ast.publication_year), () ) HAVING SUM(ast.unique_compounds) >= 393 ORDER BY total_unique_compounds DESC, overall_avg_value DESC;

SELECT cp.mol_id, c.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(a.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_class FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON s.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON s.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > '0' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '500' AND d.year >= '1990' AND a.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY cp.mol_id, c.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) > '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 20 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 100;

'200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-2' AND '3' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value < '0.1' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2015 AND at2t.confidence >= 7 GROUP BY NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase IS NOT NULL AND cp.alogp IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 923035.17 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 948.22 AND 398.97 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -2.98 AND -0.82 AND a.doc_id IN ra.med_chem_friendly, ', ') AS med_chem_status FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.activity_rank = 1 AND ra.moving_avg_standard > 69997.78 AND ra.moving_avg_mw_by_class BETWEEN 584.85 AND 391.47 GROUP SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, d.year, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid WHERE d.year::INTEGER >= 2020 AND d.year::INTEGER <= 1999 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, d.year HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 25 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw_freebase, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN docs d ON s.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::integer >= 1996 AND d.year::integer <= 2018 AND cp.mw_freebase > '200' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 41 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '10' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_activity_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_activity_value, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno LEFT JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = c.molregno AND cr.doc_id IS NOT NULL ) AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 569.62 AND 668.63 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 7.98 AND -1.56 AND (act.standard_value IS NULL OR act.standard_value > 992415.15) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 17.73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) >= 12.71 ORDER BY c.molweight DESC, avg_activity_value DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '200' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 3 AND at.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 4 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC, assay_count DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp FROM compound_properties cp INNER JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno INNER JOIN activities ac ON cp.molregno = ac.molregno INNER JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > 757.32 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -4.93 AND 9.55 AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING AVG(ac.standard_value) < 7160.85 ORDER BY assay_count DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ac.standard_value) DESC) AS value_rank FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cr.record_id = ac.record_id JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > 653.97 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -1.66 AND 2.43 AND d.year::integer >= 2006 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 3 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value DESC;

SELECT td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) DESC) AS rank_by_compounds FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '500.0' AND d.year >= '2000' AND a2t.confidence >= 7 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno AND cs.synonyms IS NOT NULL ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM target_protein tp WHERE tp.protein_accession = td.protein_accession AND tp.standard_value IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 48 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS num_targets, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_compliant_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, MAX(act.doc_id) AS latest_doc_id, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.l1) AS target_classes_l1, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value <= 57.49) AS high_potency_activities, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase) AS median_mw, AVG(CASE WHEN at.assay_type = 'B' THEN act.standard_value ELSE NULL END) AS avg_binding_potency FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON a2t.tid = t.tid JOIN target_type tt ON t.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON act.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN relationship_type rt ON a2t.relationship_type = rt.relationship_type LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON t.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession AND a.assay_type = tp.assay_type WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 152.1 AND 683.55 AND d.year::integer >= 2014 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND (act.relation IS NULL OR act.relation IN ('=', '~')) GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 4 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 6957.13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) > 7 AND SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase) BETWEEN 352.56 AND 576.59 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_assays DESC LIMIT 231;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, aty.assay_desc, d.year, d.journal, td.pref_name, td.target_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, a2t.relationship_type, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) AS record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS doc_count, COUNT(DISTINCT td.tid) AS target_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type aty ON a.assay_type = aty.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id AND act.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN '-10' AND '-10' AND cp.hba >= 2 AND cp.hbd <= 5 AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 0 AND d.year::integer >= 2003 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, aty.assay_desc, d.year, d.journal, td.pref_name, td.target_type, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, a2t.relationship_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 28 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) >= 4 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.tid) AS target_count, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, cl.confidence_summary, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms, d.year AS publication_year, d.journal AS publication_journal FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id AND a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 354.92 AND 592.91 AND cp.alogp >= 2.96 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 54.71 AND d.year >= '2010' AND cl.confidence >= 9 AND a2t.confidence >= 5 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, td.organism, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 29 AND AVG(act.standard_value) <= 403.38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.tid) >= 9 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC, target_count DESC LIMIT 1000;

c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td td.in_drugstore = 0 AND td.in_starlite = 0 AND (tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' OR tc.l2 = 'Protease' OR tc.l3 = 'Serine protease') GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, td.tissue, td.strain, td.cell_line, td.protein_accession, td.gene_names, td.ec_number, td.keywords, td.synonyms, td.description, tt.target_type, tt.target_desc, tc.tc_id, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, a.description AS assay_description, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, tc.l3 AS target_class_l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, act.published_activity_type, act.published_value, cl.confidence_summary, at2.relationship_type, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at2.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 327.41 AND 695.38 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 1.83 AND 1.52 AND cp.hba >= 13.82 AND cp.hbd <= 9.6 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL AND td.organism IS NOT NULL AND (at2.relationship_type = 'D' OR at2.relationship_type = 'H') AND d.year >= '2000' AND act.standard_value <= 491.39 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, a.description, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, td.pref_name, td.organism, act.activity_id) >= 25.7 AND AVG(act.standard_value) <= 397.32 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.target_type, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight FROM target_dictionary t JOIN assay2target at ON t.tid = at.tid JOIN assays a ON at.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 746340.7 AND 371185.1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 964.72 AND 410.52 AND a.assay_type IN ('B', 'B') GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tid, t.pref_name, t.target_type, a.assay_type), (t.tid, t.pref_name, t.target_type), (t.tid, t.pref_name), (t.tid), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 65.47 ORDER BY t.tid, assay_count DESC;

SELECT td.pref_name AS target_name, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mol_weight, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mol_weight FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value >= 7039.24 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 282.49 AND 1051.91 AND a2t.confidence >= 6 AND td.tax_id = 9955 GROUP BY td.pref_name, a.assay_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 39 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 26751.49 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_potency ASC;

WITH compound_activity_stats AS ( SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM activities a WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value > 89572.74 GROUP BY a.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 1 ) SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cas.num_assays, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency, cs.synonyms, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cas.avg_potency ASC) AS potency_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_activity_stats cas ON c.molregno = cas.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE c.molweight BETWEEN 519.26 AND 1032.08 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 0.37 AND 5.89 ORDER BY cas.avg_potency ASC, c.molregno LIMIT 222;

WITH high_activity_compounds AS ( SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS active_assays_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency FROM activities a WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value <= '0.1' AND a.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY a.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 22 ), ro5_compliant_compounds AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations FROM compound_properties cp WHERE cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '401' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-2' AND '2.1' ) SELECT hc.molregno, hc.active_assays_count, hc.avg_potency, hc.min_potency, rc.mw_freebase, rc.alogp, rc.hba, rc.hbd, rc.rtb, rc.num_ro5_violations FROM high_activity_compounds hc INNER JOIN ro5_compliant_compounds rc ON hc.molregno = rc.molregno ORDER BY hc.active_assays_count DESC, hc.avg_potency ASC LIMIT 100;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_units, a.doc_id, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, td.protein_accession, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.target_classification, cl.confidence_summary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, td.tid ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) as activity_rank, AVG(a.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, td.target_type) as avg_by_target_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, td.organism) as activity_count_per_organism, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cp.num_ro5_violations DESC, cp.alogp DESC) as compound_rank FROM activities a JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 946226.91 AND 62473.8 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 625.47 AND 707.98 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 5.2 AND -0.71 AND d.pubmed_id > 2299071.22 AND a2t.confidence >= 4.35 AND td.tax_id > 78852.48 AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' AND td.in_drugstore = 1 AND td.in_starlite = 1 ), aggregated_results AS ( SELECT ra.molregno, ra.tid, ra.pref_name, ra.organism, ra.target_type, ra.l1, ra.l2, ra.l3, ra.target_classification, ra.confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id)
