SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, at.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_in_class FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '0.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2002 AND a2t.confidence >= 6 AND (act.standard_units = 'nM' OR act.standard_units IS NULL) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, at.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 53 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.0' ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 123;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, CASE WHEN act.standard_type = 'IC50' THEN act.standard_value ELSE NULL END AS ic50_value, CASE WHEN cp.num_ro5_violations > 0 THEN 'Violation' ELSE 'No Violation' END AS ro5_status, CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 'Friendly' ELSE 'Not Friendly' END AS medchem_friendliness, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno) AS avg_activity_per_compound, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cp.alogp DESC) AS alogp_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 85198.38 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -8.24 AND 0.49 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) >= 38 ORDER BY cp.alogp DESC, avg_activity_per_compound ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, td.tid) AS avg_activity_per_target, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS activity_rank_per_target FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 170.25 AND CAST(d.year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2003 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 853.66 AND 756.45 AND cp.alogp >= 3.45 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 27 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 9093.1 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_activity_per_target ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.molregno) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.molregno) AS max_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.molregno) AS min_standard_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities ac ON ac.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assays a ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN docs d ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '1000.0' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '0.0' AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 2012 AND 2025 AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, ac.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 9 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

WITH assay_aggregates AS ( SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, t.target_type, at.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY act.standard_value) AS median_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS confirmed_activities, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS publication_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l2, '; ' ORDER BY tc.l2) AS target_classes FROM target_dictionary t JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 8570.81 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 101.88 AND 816.04 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 AND a2t.confidence >= 6 AND d.year::integer >= 2010 GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, t.target_type, at.assay_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 100 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 572.62 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 37 ), compound_analysis AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, COUNT(DISTINCT act.assay_id) AS target_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS overall_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS best_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS worst_potency, STDDEV(act.standard_value) AS potency_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS unique_targets, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.pref_name, '; ' ORDER BY t.pref_name) AS target_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.target_type, '; ' ORDER BY t.target_type) AS target_types, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS supporting_publications, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY act.standard_value) AS q1_potency, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY act.standard_value) AS q3_potency FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON a2t.tid = t.tid JOIN docs d ON act.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 233.2 AND 415.56 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -1.5 AND 5.67 AND cp.hba <= 10 AND cp.hbd <= 1 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 2014 AND 2023 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 124 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 356.35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) >= 15 ) SELECT tid, pref_name, organism, target_type, assay_type, assay_count, unique_compounds, avg_potency, median_potency, confirmed_activities, publication_count, target_classes FROM assay_aggregates WHERE assay_count > 52 AND unique_compounds >= 8 AND publication_count > 9 INTERSECT SELECT NULL::integer AS tid, NULL::character varying AS pref_name, NULL::character varying AS organism, target_types AS target_type, NULL::character varying AS assay_type, target_count AS assay_count, activity_count AS unique_compounds, overall_potency AS avg_potency, q1_potency AS median_potency, activity_count AS confirmed_activities, supporting_publications AS publication_count, target_names AS target_classes FROM compound_analysis WHERE target_count > 21 AND activity_count >= 38 AND supporting_publications > 18 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, assay_count DESC LIMIT 329;

WITH filtered_compounds AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 968.97 AND 870.55 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -4.9 AND 2.07 AND a.standard_value > 331951.29 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 11 ), activity_summary AS ( SELECT fc.molregno, fc.molweight, fc.mw_freebase, fc.alogp, fc.hba, fc.hbd, fc.assay_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS unique_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.doc_id) AS unique_docs FROM filtered_compounds fc JOIN activities a ON fc.molregno = a.molregno WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' GROUP BY fc.molregno, fc.molweight, fc.mw_freebase, fc.alogp, fc.hba, fc.hbd, fc.assay_count ) SELECT asum.molregno, asum.molweight, asum.mw_freebase, asum.alogp, asum.hba, asum.hbd, asum.assay_count, asum.avg_activity, asum.min_activity, asum.max_activity, asum.unique_assays, asum.unique_docs, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms FROM activity_summary asum LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON asum.molregno = cs.molregno GROUP BY asum.molregno, asum.molweight, asum.mw_freebase, asum.alogp, asum.hba, asum.hbd, asum.assay_count, asum.avg_activity, asum.min_activity, asum.max_activity, asum.unique_assays, asum.unique_docs ORDER BY asum.avg_activity DESC LIMIT 92;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.published_value, a.standard_type, a.relation, a.doc_id, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, c.molformula, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.protein_accession, tt.target_desc, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, a2t.confidence, a2t.relationship_type, a2t.assay_organism, cl.confidence_summary, at.assay_desc, d.year, d.journal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank, AVG(a.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno ORDER BY a.assay_id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_standard, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY cp.alogp ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_mw_by_class, SUM(a.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY a.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_standard_by_target FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase IS NOT NULL AND cp.alogp IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 55277.89 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 553.48 AND 347.41 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -3.37 AND -2.8 AND a.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE CAST(year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2023 AND 2011) AND td.tid IN (SELECT tid FROM target_class WHERE l1 = 'Enzyme') ) SELECT ra.molregno, ra.tid, ra.pref_name AS target_name, ra.target_organism, ra.protein_accession, ra.target_desc, ra.l1 AS target_class_l1, ra.l2 AS target_class_l2, ra.l3 AS target_class_l3, ra.confidence_summary, ra.assay_desc, ra.year, ra.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, AVG(ra.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, AVG(ra.alogp) AS avg_logp, SUM(ra.hba) AS total_hba, SUM(ra.hbd) AS total_hbd, AVG(ra.psa) AS avg_psa, SUM(ra.rtb) AS total_rotatable_bonds, SUM(ra.num_ro5_violations) AS total_ro5_violations, ra.moving_avg_standard, ra.moving_avg_mw_by_class, ra.cumulative_standard_by_target, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.ro3_pass, ', ') AS ro3_pass_status, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.med_chem_friendly, ', ') AS med_chem_status FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.activity_rank = 1 AND ra.moving_avg_standard > 39958.59 AND ra.moving_avg_mw_by_class BETWEEN 565.34 AND 427.01 GROUP BY ra.molregno, ra.tid, ra.pref_name, ra.target_organism, ra.protein_accession, ra.target_desc, ra.l1, ra.l2, ra.l3, ra.confidence_summary, ra.assay_desc, ra.year, ra.journal, ra.moving_avg_standard, ra.moving_avg_mw_by_class, ra.cumulative_standard_by_target HAVING AVG(ra.standard_value) > 39526.63 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) >= 3 AND SUM(ra.num_ro5_violations) <= 0 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, num_assays DESC, ra.cumulative_standard_by_target DESC LIMIT 590;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) AS num_documents, MAX(d.year::INTEGER) AS latest_year FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value <= 4863.77 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -3.12 AND 3.83 AND cp.hba >= 8 AND cp.hbd <= 6 AND td.tid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT tid FROM target_class WHERE l1 = 'None' AND l2 = 'None' ) AND a.assay_id IN ( SELECT assay_id FROM assay2target WHERE confidence >= 5 ) AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2009 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 16 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 193.55 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_assays DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE c.molregno IN ( SELECT cr.molregno FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.doc_id = 5959 ) AND cp.hba >= 4 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS avg_value_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY td.organism ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) DESC) AS org_assay_rank FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0.0' AND d.year >= '1990' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '500.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 1 AND a2t.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, a2t.confidence, cl.confidence_summary HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 40 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '10000.0' ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, assay_count DESC;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_units, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, c.molformula, cs.synonyms, d.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, ass.assay_type, ass.description AS assay_description, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence, a2t.relationship_type, td.pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.ec_number, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS rn FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 577.96 AND 432.32 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2000 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 ), aggregated_compounds AS ( SELECT ra.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_activity, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.pref_name, '; ') AS target_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ra.l1 || ':' || ra.l2, '; ') AS target_classes FROM ranked_activities ra WHERE ra.rn = 1 GROUP BY ra.molregno ), correlated_stats AS ( SELECT ac.molregno, ac.num_assays, ac.avg_activity, ac.min_activity, ac.max_activity, ac.ro3_pass_count, ac.med_chem_friendly_count, ac.all_synonyms, ac.target_names, ac.target_classes, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a2.assay_id) FROM activities a2 WHERE a2.molregno = ac.molregno AND a2.standard_value > (SELECT AVG(standard_value) FROM activities WHERE assay_id = a2.assay_id) ) AS assays_above_avg FROM aggregated_compounds ac ) SELECT cs.molregno, cs.num_assays, cs.avg_activity, cs.min_activity, cs.max_activity, cs.ro3_pass_count, cs.med_chem_friendly_count, cs.assays_above_avg, cs.all_synonyms, cs.target_names, cs.target_classes, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, c.molweight, c.molformula, c.canonical_smiles, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = cs.molregno AND cr.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1990 AND 2011) ) AS records_in_period FROM correlated_stats cs JOIN compound_properties cp ON cs.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON cs.molregno = c.molregno WHERE cs.num_assays >= 36 AND cs.avg_activity <= 1018.72 AND cs.assays_above_avg >= 12 ORDER BY cs.avg_activity ASC, cs.num_assays DESC LIMIT 24;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE a.standard_value > 14815.8 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 253.42 AND 982.51 AND a.assay_id IN ( SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE doc_id = 61941 ) GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 8 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, cp.mol_id, a.assay_id, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, cl.confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_compliant_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms_list, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS num_publications, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.tid) AS num_targets_per_assay FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno AND cp.mw_freebase > '200' JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND act.standard_value BETWEEN '0.1' AND '10000' JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id AND a2t.confidence >= 9 JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid AND tc.l1 IS NOT NULL JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND d.year::integer >= 2021 LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON td.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession WHERE cp.alogp <= '-5' AND cp.hba >= 7 AND cp.hbd <= 3 AND cp.psa BETWEEN '0' AND '50' AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 0 AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND act.standard_units = 'nM' AND act.standard_type IN ('IC50', 'Ki', 'Kd') AND a.assay_type IN ('B', 'F') AND a2t.relationship_type IN ('D', 'H') AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND tc.l2 LIKE '%enzyme%' GROUP BY c.molregno, cp.mol_id, a.assay_id, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, cl.confidence_summary HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 4 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '100' AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) >= 4 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_activities DESC LIMIT 23;

') AS published_activity_types, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ac.standard_type, '; ') AS standard_types FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cr.record_id = ac.record_id AND cp.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '100' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND cp.hba >= 4 AND cp.hbd <= 9 AND cp.psa >= '0' AND cp.rtb <= 1 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_value > '0' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2002 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND td.in_drugstore = 1 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.canonical_smiles, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, at.assay_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tt.target_desc, cl.confidence_summary, cl.description, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) >= 49 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < '100' AND COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) <= 42 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, activity_count DESC, cp.mw_freebase DESC LIMIT 444;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, c.inchi_key, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY cp.molregno ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC ) AS potency_rank, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.molregno) AS total_assays FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 461.85 AND 302.71 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 4.21 AND 3.74 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL ), target_class_summary AS ( SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, a2t.assay_id, a2t.confidence FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid WHERE a2t.confidence >= 1.88 ) SELECT cas.molregno, cas.inchi_key, cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.hba, cas.hbd, cas.num_ro5_violations, tcs.pref_name AS target_name, tcs.l1 AS target_class_level1, tcs.l2 AS target_class_level2, cas.assay_type, cas.standard_value, cas.standard_units, cas.standard_type, cas.potency_rank, cas.total_assays, tcs.confidence AS target_confidence FROM compound_activity_summary cas JOIN target_class_summary tcs ON cas.assay_id = tcs.assay_id WHERE cas.potency_rank <= 6.86 AND cas.total_assays >= 93.01 ORDER BY cas.standard_value DESC, cas.molregno, cas.potency_rank LIMIT 268.08;

SELECT cp.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cp.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_value > 98.44 AND ac.standard_value < 807405.25 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2018 AND d.year::INTEGER <= 2018 AND cp.mw_freebase >= 300.34 AND cp.mw_freebase <= 920.44 AND at.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY cp.molregno, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 15 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) > 356.09 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, num_assays DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT td.pref_name, tc.l2, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_molecular_weight, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_compliant_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY act.standard_value) AS median_potency, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l2 ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS potency_rank FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a2t.confidence >= 3 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '500.0' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::integer >= 2004 AND td.tax_id = 9854 AND a.assay_type IN ('B', 'F') GROUP BY td.pref_name, tc.l2, a.assay_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 82 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '10000.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT cp.molregno) >= 46 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_potency ASC;

WITH assay_based_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM activities a JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 820.9 AND s.assay_type = '' GROUP BY a.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 46.57 ), target_based_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT at.tid) AS num_targets, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM activities a JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value <= 203.26 AND td.organism = '' GROUP BY a.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT at.tid) >= 2.45 ) SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, ab.num_assays, tb.num_targets, ab.avg_potency AS assay_avg_potency, tb.avg_potency AS target_avg_potency FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assay_based_activities ab ON c.molregno = ab.molregno JOIN target_based_activities tb ON c.molregno = tb.molregno WHERE c.molweight BETWEEN 603.01 AND 324.14 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -2.41 AND -1.93 ORDER BY c.molregno LIMIT 1000;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ay.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '200' AND cp.alogp >= '-5' AND a.standard_value <= '0.1' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly ) SELECT cas.molregno, cas.molweight, cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.hba, cas.hbd, cas.psa, cas.rtb, cas.num_ro5_violations, cas.ro3_pass, cas.med_chem_friendly, cas.assay_count, cas.activity_count, cas.avg_standard_value, cas.min_standard_value, cas.max_standard_value, cas.standard_flag_count, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, ay.assay_type, ay.description AS assay_description, d.year AS publication_year, d.journal AS publication_journal FROM compound_activity_summary cas JOIN activities a ON cas.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ay.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cas.assay_count >= 14 AND cas.activity_count > 134 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2022 ORDER BY cas.avg_standard_value ASC, cas.assay_count DESC LIMIT 924;

WITH ranked_compounds AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, t.tid, t.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, a.assay_type ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS rn_per_compound_assay FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at2.tid = t.tid JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 604.96 AND 1273.47 AND cp.alogp > 2.64 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 89410.74 ), window_analysis AS ( SELECT rc.assay_type, rc.target_class_level1, rc.target_class_level2, rc.standard_value, AVG(rc.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY rc.target_class_level1, rc.target_class_level2 ORDER BY rc.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_standard_value, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY rc.target_class_level1, rc.target_class_level2 ORDER BY rc.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_count FROM ranked_compounds rc WHERE rc.rn_per_compound_assay = 1 ) SELECT wa.assay_type, wa.target_class_level1, wa.target_class_level2, COUNT(*) AS num_compounds, MIN(wa.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(wa.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, AVG(wa.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, AVG(wa.moving_avg_standard_value) AS avg_moving_avg, MAX(wa.cumulative_count) AS total_compounds_in_class FROM window_analysis wa GROUP BY wa.assay_type, wa.target_class_level1, wa.target_class_level2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 25 ORDER BY wa.target_class_level1, wa.target_class_level2, num_compounds DESC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description AS assay_description, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism ORDER BY c.molweight ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_activity, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type, td.organism ORDER BY c.molweight ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_compound_count FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 804633.58 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 3.45 AND 0.9 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a.assay_type = 'B' GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, td.pref_name, td.organism, c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type ORDER BY a.assay_id, c.molweight;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS avg_standard_value_by_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) DESC) AS compound_rank FROM assays a JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value > 58042.14 AND a2t.confidence >= 2 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, tc.l1, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 59 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_standard_value_by_type DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE cp.mw_freebase > 669.99 AND ac.standard_value BETWEEN 6.88 AND 44.6 AND c.molweight < 668.83 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 1 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < 47.49 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY c.molregno ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC ) AS activity_rank_per_compound, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.molregno ) AS avg_activity_per_compound, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.molregno ) AS activity_count_per_compound FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 9210.38 AND 6279.5 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 0.22 AND -9.33 AND c.molweight BETWEEN 658.25 AND 362.89 AND act.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.assay_id) >= 15.71 ORDER BY c.molregno, activity_rank_per_compound;

SELECT c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, at.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.record_id) AS activity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_activities, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(ac.standard_value) DESC) AS activity_rank_in_class FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cr.record_id = ac.record_id JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '300.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::integer >= 2006 AND a2t.confidence >= 7 GROUP BY c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, at.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING AVG(ac.standard_value) > '1.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ac.record_id) >= 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) > 2 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC, activity_count DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp FROM compound_properties cp JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN docs d ON asy.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 99972.63 AND 31935.69 AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 2 ORDER BY activity_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, c.molweight, c.molformula, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, a.assay_type, ast.assay_desc, c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM target_dictionary td INNER JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid INNER JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid INNER JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id INNER JOIN assay_type ast ON a.assay_type = ast.assay_type INNER JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id INNER JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno INNER JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno INNER JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 532838.87 AND 620340.68 AND cp.mw_freebase >= 459.69 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 1.73 AND -9.18 AND d.year >= '1900' AND a2t.confidence >= 7.28 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, a.assay_type, ast.assay_desc, c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp), (td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, a.assay_type, ast.assay_desc), (td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2), (td.tid, td.pref_name), (tc.l1, tc.l2, a.assay_type, ast.assay_desc), (tc.l1, tc.l2), (a.assay_type, ast.assay_desc), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 73.01 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 445960.71 ORDER BY td.tid, c.molregno, avg_standard_value DESC;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, c.compound_name, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class, a.assay_id, a.record_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.assay_id ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC ) AS activity_rank FROM activities a JOIN compound_records c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 628641.98 AND td.tax_id = 9975.69 AND tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' ) SELECT molregno, compound_name, target_name, target_class, COUNT(DISTINCT assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(standard_value) AS max_activity FROM ranked_activities WHERE activity_rank = 1 GROUP BY molregno, compound_name, target_name, target_class HAVING AVG(standard_value) > 2685.18 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.assay_type IN (SELECT assay_type FROM assay_type WHERE assay_desc LIKE '%cell-based%') AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '500' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-2' AND '2' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0' AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2015 AND 2023 AND at.confidence >= 8 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 60 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '100' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 265;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp < '-2' AND d.year >= '2010' GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 10 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_flag = 1) AS standard_activity_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS activity_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '500' AND cp.alogp > '1.0' AND (cp.hba >= 3 OR cp.hbd >= 4) AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_units = 'nM' AND a2t.confidence >= 5 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2016 AND 2021 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND (tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' OR tc.l1 = 'Membrane receptor') AND NOT (cp.num_ro5_violations > 0 AND cp.ro3_pass = 'N') GROUP BY c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, td.tid HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < '100' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 9 ORDER BY avg_activity ASC, synonym_count DESC LIMIT 147;

SELECT td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS num_publications, MIN(d.year::INTEGER) AS earliest_year, MAX(d.year::INTEGER) AS latest_year, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a2t.relationship_type = 'D' THEN a2t.tid END) AS direct_target_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a2t.relationship_type = 'H' THEN a2t.tid END) AS homologous_target_count FROM target_dictionary td LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid LEFT JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id LEFT JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id LEFT JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno LEFT JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type LEFT JOIN relationship_type rt ON a2t.relationship_type::VARCHAR = rt.relationship_type WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 92948.01 AND 42714.7 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 981.08 AND 107.8 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 3.34 AND 2.55 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2016.0 AND 2009.93 AND a2t.confidence >= 1.94 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2.27 AND (cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' OR cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y') GROUP BY td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 26.0 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 1718.45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 4.25 ORDER BY num_activities DESC, avg_standard_value ASC, num_assays DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT a.assay_id, t.tid, c.molregno, at.assay_type, ty.target_type, cl.l1, cl.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS assay_rank FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at2.tid = t.tid JOIN target_type ty ON t.target_type = ty.target_type JOIN target_class cl ON t.tid = cl.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 943.35 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 904.34 AND 1236.09 AND d.year >= '2000' AND at2.confidence >= 7 GROUP BY a.assay_id, t.tid, c.molregno, at.assay_type, ty.target_type, cl.l1, cl.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 47 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 1287.24 AND MIN(cp.mw_freebase) > 405.22 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 371;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_type, a.description AS assay_desc, at.assay_desc AS assay_type_desc, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, tc.l3 AS target_class_l3, cl.confidence_summary, d.year AS publication_year, d.journal, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) AS record_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND cp.hba >= 0 AND cp.hbd <= 2 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 AND act.standard_value < '0.1' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2005 AND a2t.confidence >= 3 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_type, a.description, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, d.journal HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 46 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '1' AND COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) >= 5 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 442;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, aty.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_avg_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type aty ON a.assay_type = aty.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 837.98 AND 258.04 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2021 AND a2t.confidence >= 9 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 3 AND td.tid IN ( SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND target_type IN ( SELECT target_type FROM target_type WHERE target_desc LIKE '%enzyme%' ) ) GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, aty.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, td.tid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 42 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 149.07 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 506.47 AND 508.51 AND cp.alogp >= -0.68 AND a.assay_type = 'A' GROUP BY c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 47.94 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 23653.43 AND 90160.66 AND d.year::integer BETWEEN 2012 AND 1994 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) > 964.16 ORDER BY assay_count DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, aty.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.tid ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_avg_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type aty ON a.assay_type = aty.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 841.49 AND 277.65 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2020 AND a2t.confidence >= 1 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND td.tid IN ( SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND target_type IN ( SELECT target_type FROM target_type WHERE target_desc LIKE '%enzyme%' ) ) GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, aty.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, td.tid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 22 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 9072.72 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS document_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.tid) AS target_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.assay_organism) AS organism_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank_by_class FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND cp.hba >= 0 AND cp.hbd <= 5 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.assay_type IN ( SELECT assay_type FROM assays WHERE doc_id IN ( SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE year::integer >= 2008 ) ) AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a2t.confidence >= 8 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 2 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

SELECT td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS num_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_alogp, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descs, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS compound_synonyms_list FROM target_dictionary td LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid LEFT JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id LEFT JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type LEFT JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id LEFT JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 16522.57 AND 19682.73 AND cp.mw_freebase >= 606.37 AND a2t.confidence >= 2.01 AND td.tax_id = 65.09 GROUP BY td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 46.17 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 61657.06 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 159.16 ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_activity ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS num_targets, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_compliant_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms, MAX(act.doc_id) AS latest_doc_id, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.l1) AS target_classes_l1, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value <= 83.41) AS high_potency_activities, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase) AS median_mw, AVG(CASE WHEN at.assay_type = 'B' THEN act.standard_value ELSE NULL END) AS avg_binding_potency FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON a2t.tid = t.tid JOIN target_type tt ON t.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON act.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN relationship_type rt ON a2t.relationship_type = rt.relationship_type LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON t.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession AND a.assay_type = tp.assay_type WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 118.24 AND 711.06 AND d.year::integer >= 2021 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 AND act.standard_flag = 1 AND (act.relation IS NULL OR act.relation IN ('=', '~')) GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 18 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 7275.68 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) > 2 AND SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase) BETWEEN 322.11 AND 522.49 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_assays DESC LIMIT 336;

SELECT cp.molregno, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN docs d ON asy.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN '0.0' AND '1.0' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > '0.0' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2016 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 10 ORDER BY avg_potency DESC LIMIT 60;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS num_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, AVG(ac.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS min_standard_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.med_chem_friendly ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) DESC, AVG(ac.standard_value) ASC NULLS LAST) AS rank_within_medchem FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities ac ON cr.record_id = ac.record_id JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '1000' AND cp.alogp > '-5' AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND ac.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 3 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < '0' ORDER BY num_assays DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.assay_id, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, ass.assay_type, ass.doc_id, d.year, d.journal, td.pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.target_classification, cl.confidence_summary, a2t.confidence, a2t.relationship_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.standard_type ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS activity_rank, AVG(a.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno, a.standard_type) AS avg_activity_by_type, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno) AS total_activities_per_compound FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 79926.48 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 120.21 AND 666.06 AND d.year::integer >= 2011 AND a2t.confidence >= 5 ) SELECT ra.molregno, ra.standard_type, ra.assay_type, ra.pref_name AS target_name, ra.target_organism, ra.l1 AS target_class_level1, ra.l2 AS target_class_level2, ra.l3 AS target_class_level3, ra.target_classification, ra.confidence_summary, ra.relationship_type, ra.year AS publication_year, ra.journal, ra.mw_freebase, ra.alogp, ra.hba, ra.hbd, ra.psa, ra.rtb, ra.num_ro5_violations, ra.ro3_pass, ra.med_chem_friendly, MAX(ra.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, MIN(ra.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, AVG(ra.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, ra.avg_activity_by_type, ra.total_activities_per_compound, COUNT(*) AS num_activities, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.activity_rank = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_ranked_activities FROM ranked_activities ra GROUP BY ra.molregno, ra.standard_type, ra.assay_type, ra.pref_name, ra.target_organism, ra.l1, ra.l2, ra.l3, ra.target_classification, ra.confidence_summary, ra.relationship_type, ra.year, ra.journal, ra.mw_freebase, ra.alogp, ra.hba, ra.hbd, ra.psa, ra.rtb, ra.num_ro5_violations, ra.ro3_pass, ra.med_chem_friendly, ra.avg_activity_by_type, ra.total_activities_per_compound HAVING AVG(ra.standard_value) > 28579.72 AND COUNT(*) >= 14 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, num_activities DESC;

WITH ranked_compounds AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, t.tid, t.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, a.assay_type ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS rn_per_compound_assay FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at2.tid = t.tid JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 731.16 AND 276.74 AND cp.alogp > 1.32 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 65988.11 ), window_analysis AS ( SELECT rc.assay_type, rc.target_class_level1, rc.target_class_level2, rc.standard_value, AVG(rc.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY rc.target_class_level1, rc.target_class_level2 ORDER BY rc.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_standard_value, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY rc.target_class_level1, rc.target_class_level2 ORDER BY rc.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_count FROM ranked_compounds rc WHERE rc.rn_per_compound_assay = 1 ) SELECT wa.assay_type, wa.target_class_level1, wa.target_class_level2, COUNT(*) AS num_compounds, MIN(wa.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(wa.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, AVG(wa.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, AVG(wa.moving_avg_standard_value) AS avg_moving_avg, MAX(wa.cumulative_count) AS total_compounds_in_class FROM window_analysis wa GROUP BY wa.assay_type, wa.target_class_level1, wa.target_class_level2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 67 ORDER BY wa.target_class_level1, wa.target_class_level2, num_compounds DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT at2.tid) AS target_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON asy.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 6633.15 AND 9223.75 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 241.13 AND 615.8 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 4.43 AND 1.81 AND asy.assay_type = 'A' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 147.46 AND AVG(a.standard_value) BETWEEN 7618.83 AND 3703.38 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 373.73;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, a.assay_type, at.assay_organism, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flagged_count FROM target_dictionary t JOIN assay2target at ON t.tid = at.tid JOIN assays a ON at.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 855115.73 AND act.standard_value < 83626094.58 AND cp.mw_freebase > 544.27 AND cp.mw_freebase < 1216.67 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 3 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.tid, t.pref_name, a.assay_type, at.assay_organism), (t.tid, t.pref_name, a.assay_type), (t.tid, t.pref_name), (t.tid), () ) ORDER BY t.tid, t.pref_name, a.assay_type, at.assay_organism;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.organism ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC) AS potency_rank_by_organism, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l2) AS avg_potency_per_target_class, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.num_ro5_violations) AS compounds_per_ro5_violation FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities act ON cp.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at2.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value > 72508.82 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 5.77 AND -8.36 AND cp.hba >= 17 AND cp.hbd >= 5 AND d.year::integer >= 2013 AND at2.confidence >= 7 GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, cl.confidence_summary, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 98 ORDER BY potency_rank_by_organism, avg_potency_per_target_class DESC;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a2t.confidence > 5 AND a2t.multi = 0 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200.0' AND '501.0' AND td.tax_id = 9782 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_units = 'nM' GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 10 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) >= 47 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' UNION ALL SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) AS doc_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, AVG(cp.hba) AS avg_hba, MAX(cp.hbd) AS max_hbd, MIN(cp.psa) AS min_psa FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN compounds c ON cr.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a2t.confidence <= 3 AND cp.num_ro5_violations = 2 AND cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Yes' AND td.in_drugstore = 1 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2008 AND 2015 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) >= 19 AND AVG(cp.hba) > 3 AND MAX(cp.hbd) < 1 ORDER BY tid, pref_name;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno) AS synonym_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = c.molregno) AS record_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 354.1 AND 300.1 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -1.68 AND 8.69 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 0 AND a.standard_value >= 7701.77 AND CAST(d.year AS INTEGER) >= 2016 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 15 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, assay_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_units, a.activity_comment, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activities a2 WHERE a2.molregno = cp.molregno AND a2.standard_flag = 1) AS total_standard_activities FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON ass.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 986849.46 AND 996363.74 AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2022 AND 2004 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 896.32 AND 981.72 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -2.45 AND 3.19 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 3 AND a.standard_units = 'nM' GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.standard_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_units, a.activity_comment, at.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, cl.confidence_summary, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 20 ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC, cp.mw_freebase ASC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.record_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno) AS num_synonyms FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN 1.1 AND 3.63 AND cp.hba BETWEEN 4.9 AND 3.43 AND cp.hbd BETWEEN 1.24 AND 2.73 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 6176.02 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 7.08 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 7780.16 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, num_activities DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description AS cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target at2 ON a.assay_id = at2.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON td.protein_accession = NULL AND cp.mw_freebase > 502.18 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -4.76 AND 4.61 AND d.year::integer >= 2015 AND at2.confidence >= 1 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type,
