WITH compound_activity_stats AS ( SELECT a.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN a.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_standard_activities FROM activities a WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 47489.45 AND a.standard_units = 'nM' GROUP BY a.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 34 ), compound_props_filtered AS ( SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly FROM compound_properties cp WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 433.22 AND 512.79 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 2.66 AND 8.65 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 3 ) SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cas.num_assays, cas.total_activities, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency, cas.num_standard_activities, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS num_synonyms, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) AS num_documents FROM compounds c JOIN compound_props_filtered cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_activity_stats cas ON c.molregno = cas.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno WHERE c.molweight IS NOT NULL AND c.molweight BETWEEN 281.11 AND 556.47 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, c.molformula, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cas.num_assays, cas.total_activities, cas.avg_potency, cas.min_potency, cas.max_potency, cas.num_standard_activities HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) >= 7 ORDER BY cas.avg_potency ASC, c.molweight DESC LIMIT 515;

SELECT c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100' AND '200' AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 AND at.confidence >= 4 GROUP BY c.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 7 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase DESC, assay_count DESC;

SELECT td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_potency, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS unique_assays, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cp.mw_freebase) AS median_mw, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cp.alogp) AS median_alogp FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN assay_type at ON a_s.assay_type = at.assay_type WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 0.35 AND a.standard_value < 592047.35 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 441.32 AND 527.51 AND d.year::integer >= 2013 AND a2t.confidence >= 8 AND td.tax_id = 9910 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno AND cs.synonyms ILIKE '%inhibitor%' ) AND td.tid IN ( SELECT tid FROM target_class WHERE l1 IN ( SELECT DISTINCT l1 FROM target_class WHERE l2 = 'Enzyme' ) ) GROUP BY td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) > 15 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 403.5 ORDER BY avg_potency ASC, unique_compounds DESC LIMIT 43;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, at.assay_type, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS unique_assays, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY at.assay_type ORDER BY AVG(a.standard_value) DESC) AS avg_rank_by_type FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a_s.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE a.standard_value > 642986.98 AND a2t.confidence > 4 AND cp.hba > 2 AND cp.hbd > 3 AND d.year::integer > 2022 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, at.assay_type HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) < 54732.04 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) > 70 UNION ALL SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, at.assay_type, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS unique_assays, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY at.assay_type ORDER BY AVG(a.standard_value) DESC) AS avg_rank_by_type FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a_s.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN target_protein tp ON td.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession WHERE a.standard_value < 31.83 AND a2t.confidence > 6 AND cp.alogp > '-5' AND cp.psa < '0' AND d.year::integer < 1998 GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, at.assay_type HAVING AVG(a.standard_value) > 1161.66 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) > 50 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC;

SELECT td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_chem_friendly_count FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays ass ON a2t.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE a.standard_value BETWEEN 3719.21 AND 222648.05 AND td.tax_id = 651999.73 AND a2t.confidence >= 3.06 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 460.75 AND 1076.77 AND ass.assay_type IN (SELECT at.assay_type FROM assay_type at WHERE at.assay_desc LIKE '%''%') AND td.tid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT a2t_inner.tid FROM assay2target a2t_inner WHERE a2t_inner.relationship_type = '''' AND a2t_inner.multi = 0 AND a2t_inner.tid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT tc_inner.tid FROM target_class tc_inner WHERE tc_inner.l1 LIKE '%''%' AND tc_inner.l2 IS NOT NULL ) ) GROUP BY td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) > 775.09 AND AVG(cp.mw_freebase) BETWEEN 1207.37 AND 1543.92 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_mw ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(ac.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(ac.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE ac.standard_flag = 1 AND ac.standard_value BETWEEN 175085.76 AND 124883.3 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 1913 AND 1989 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ac.molregno) > 36 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_activity ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY act.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 3 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_molecular_weight, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_logp FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE act.standard_value > 567760.93 AND cp.mw_freebase < 582.35 AND cp.hba >= 9 GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, act.standard_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 20 ORDER BY a.assay_type, moving_avg_activity DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ay.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > '200' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND d.year >= '1990' AND a.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 8 ORDER BY activity_count DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, AS target_protein_relation, tp.standard_units AS target_protein_standard_units, tp.standard_type AS target_protein_standard_type, tp.assay_type AS target_protein_assay_type, tp.relationship_type AS target_protein_relationship_type, tp.assay_organism AS target_protein_assay_organism, tp.organism AS target_protein_organism, tp.canonical_smiles AS target_protein_canonical_smiles, tp.protein_accession AS target_protein_protein_accession, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(ac.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS min_standard_value, MAX(ac.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS max_standard_value, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.tid) AS distinct_target_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS distinct_document_count FROM compound_properties cp INNER JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno INNER JOIN activities ac ON cr.record_id = ac.record_id AND cp.molregno = ac.molregno INNER JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id INNER JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type INNER JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id AND ac.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON ac.standard_flag = cl.confidence INNER JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid INNER JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON td.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession AND a.assay_type = tp.assay_type AND ac.relation = tp.relation AND ac.standard_units = tp.standard_units AND ac.standard_type = tp.standard_type WHERE ac.standard_value > 19172.35 AND ac.published_value < 36307.38 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 744.29 AND 1896.41 AND cp.alogp >= 2.54 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 AND a2t.confidence >= 6 AND d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY cp.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, cs.synonyms, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, at.assay_desc, ac.activity_id, ac.standard_value, ac.published_value, ac.published_activity_type, ac.relation, ac.standard_units, ac.standard_type, ac.activity_comment, d.doc_id, d.pubmed_id, d.year, d.journal, cr.record_id, cr.compound_key, cr.compound_name, cl.confidence, cl.confidence_summary, cl.description, a2t.tid, a2t.confidence, a2t.relationship_type, a2t.assay_organism, a2t.assay_strain, td.pref_name, td.gene_names, td.organism, td.tissue, td.strain, td.cell_line, td.protein_accession, td.target_type, tt.target_desc, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, tp.standard_value, tp.relation, tp.standard_units, tp.standard_type, tp.assay_type, tp.relationship_type, tp.assay_organism, tp.organism, tp.canonical_smiles, tp.protein_accession HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ac.activity_id) > 38 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL) < 700.87 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.tid) >= 20 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 73;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.doc_id) AS num_documents, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, MAX(d.year::integer) AS latest_year, MIN(d.year::integer) AS earliest_year FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN docs d ON s.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_flag = 1 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' AND d.year::integer >= 2017 AND d.year::integer <= 1996 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '100.0' AND '100.0' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '-5.0' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 35 ) SELECT cas.molregno, cas.molweight, cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.hba, cas.hbd, cas.num_assays, cas.num_documents, cas.num_activities, cas.avg_standard_value, cas.min_standard_value, cas.max_standard_value, cas.latest_year, cas.earliest_year, cs.synonyms AS primary_synonym, td.pref_name AS target_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_level1, tc.l2 AS target_class_level2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cas.num_activities DESC) AS activity_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cas.num_assays DESC) AS assay_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY cas.avg_standard_value DESC) AS potency_rank_by_class FROM compound_activity_summary cas LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cas.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN activities a2 ON cas.molregno = a2.molregno LEFT JOIN assays s2 ON a2.assay_id = s2.assay_id LEFT JOIN assay2target at2 ON s2.assay_id = at2.assay_id LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON at2.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE a2.standard_flag = 1 AND at2.confidence >= 7 AND tc.l1 IS NOT NULL AND cs.synonyms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cas.molregno, cas.molweight, cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.hba, cas.hbd, cas.num_assays, cas.num_documents, cas.num_activities, cas.avg_standard_value, cas.min_standard_value, cas.max_standard_value, cas.latest_year, cas.earliest_year, cs.synonyms, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 ORDER BY cas.num_activities DESC, cas.avg_standard_value DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, d.year, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, a.assay_type) AS avg_activity_by_type, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.molweight DESC) AS molweight_rank FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5.0' AND '0.0' AND cp.hba >= 7 AND cp.hbd <= 1 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.assay_type LIKE 'B%' AND td.pref_name LIKE '%kinase%' AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2009 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, act.standard_value, act.standard_type, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, d.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 7 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < '0.1' ORDER BY molweight_rank, avg_activity_by_type DESC LIMIT 616;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description AS assay_desc, at.assay_desc AS assay_type_desc, td.tid, td.pref_name, td.organism, td.target_type, tt.target_desc, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, tc.l4, tc.l5, tc.l6, tc.l7, tc.l8, tc.target_classification, cl.confidence_summary, act.standard_units, act.published_activity_type, act.published_units, act.relation, act.activity_comment, a2t.confidence AS assay_confidence, a2t.relationship_type, rt.relationship_desc, a2t.assay_organism, a2t.assay_strain, a2t.assay_tax_id, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, td.tid) AS avg_standard_value_per_target, MIN(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, a.assay_type) AS min_standard_value_per_assay_type, MAX(act.standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno, td.organism) AS max_standard_value_per_organism, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY c.molregno) AS total_standard_flags, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.molweight DESC) AS molweight_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.target_type ORDER BY cp.alogp DESC) AS alogp_rank_per_target_type FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN relationship_type rt ON a2t.relationship_type = rt.relationship_type JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase > '100' AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND cp.hba >= 5 AND cp.hbd >= 10 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 4 AND a.assay_type IN (SELECT assay_type FROM assay_type WHERE assay_desc LIKE '%Binding%') AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND d.year >= '2000' AND a2t.confidence >= 8 AND act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM activities act2 WHERE act2.molregno = c.molregno AND act2.standard_value < '0.1' AND act2.standard_flag = 1 ) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, a.description, at.assay_desc, td.tid, SELECT cp.molregno, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_molecular_weight, SUM(a.standard_value) AS total_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays_count, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_logp, MAX(cp.hba) AS max_hba FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase > 932.71 AND d.year >= '2000' GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING AVG(cp.mw_freebase) > 714.31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 2 ORDER BY total_standard_value DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS target_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON ass.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN activities a2 ON cp.molregno = a2.molregno AND a.activity_id != a2.activity_id WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 448.79 AND 761.65 AND cp.alogp >= 2.43 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2023 AND at.confidence >= 8 GROUP BY cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 26 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 4718.15 ORDER BY total_activities DESC, avg_standard_value ASC;

WITH compound_activity_stats AS ( SELECT a.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, AVG(a.standard_value) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.molregno ORDER BY a.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_activity, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.molregno ORDER BY a.standard_value ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_activity_count, a.standard_value, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 FROM activities a JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assays asy ON a.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON asy.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON asy.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 428.1 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 381.12 AND 593.94 AND a.assay_id IN ('1') ) SELECT l1, l2, pref_name, assay_desc, confidence_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(moving_avg_activity) AS avg_moving_activity, AVG(alogp) AS avg_alogp, AVG(psa) AS avg_psa, SUM(num_ro5_violations) AS total_ro5_violations, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY standard_value) AS median_activity FROM compound_activity_stats WHERE cumulative_activity_count >= 34 GROUP BY l1, l2, pref_name, assay_desc, confidence_summary HAVING AVG(moving_avg_activity) < 906.47 AND COUNT(DISTINCT molregno) > 31 ORDER BY avg_moving_activity ASC, unique_compounds DESC LIMIT 499;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molformula, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS num_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS num_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) AS num_targets, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l2, '; ') AS target_classes, MAX(cl.confidence) AS max_confidence, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT at.assay_desc, '; ') AS assay_descriptions, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.doc_id) AS num_documents, MAX(d.year::INTEGER) AS latest_year FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON s.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON s.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON a2t.tid = t.tid JOIN target_class tc ON t.tid = tc.tid JOIN target_type tt ON t.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN relationship_type rt ON a2t.relationship_type = rt.relationship_type WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value BETWEEN 386.82 AND 48418.85 AND cp.alogp >= 2.08 AND cp.hba <= 10 AND cp.hbd <= 5 AND (a.standard_flag = 1 OR a.standard_flag IS NULL) AND a2t.confidence >= 6 AND d.year::INTEGER >= 2000 AND (tt.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' OR tt.target_type IS NULL) GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molformula, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 22 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 196.78 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tid) >= 3 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, num_activities DESC, max_confidence DESC LIMIT 576;

SELECT cp.molregno, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS distinct_assays FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id WHERE cp.num_ro5_violations <= 3 AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = cp.molregno AND cr.doc_id = 19520 ) GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 2 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw, AVG(cp.alogp) AS avg_logp, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_potency, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.ro3_pass = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ro3_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cp.med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medchem_friendly_count, AVG(CASE WHEN a.standard_units = 'nM' THEN a.standard_value ELSE NULL END) AS avg_nm_potency, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays ass ON a2t.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 8129.73 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 886.39 AND 1436.12 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -0.28 AND 6.46 AND a2t.confidence >= 1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(d.year, 'YYYY')) BETWEEN 2001 AND 2017 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND ass.assay_type = 'B' GROUP BY td.tid, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, tc.l3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 20 AND AVG(cp.mw_freebase) < 848.12 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cp.molregno) >= 11 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_nm_potency ASC LIMIT 75;

SELECT a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS compound_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON act.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE act.standard_value BETWEEN 89.96 AND 93919.54 AND cp.mw_freebase >= 568.58 AND cp.alogp >= 8.52 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (a.assay_type, at.assay_desc), (td.pref_name), (tc.l1, tc.l2), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 89 ORDER BY assay_count DESC, compound_count DESC LIMIT 242;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC ) AS potency_rank_by_assay_type FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 302.51 AND 416.18 AND cp.alogp >= 0.78 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a2t.confidence >= 8 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_id, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, td.organism, a.assay_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 5 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 7809.64 ORDER BY potency_rank_by_assay_type, avg_potency DESC;

a2t.confidence = cl.confidence JOIN relationship_type rt ON a2t.relationship_type = rt.relationship_type WHERE act.standard_value > '0.0' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '0.0' AND '100.0' AND cp.alogp > '-10.0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 3 AND d.year >= '1900' AND a2t.confidence >= 6 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND tt.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND rt.relationship_type = 'D' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 23 AND AVG(act.standard_value) > '0.0' ORDER BY c.molregno, a.assay_id, act.standard_value DESC;

SELECT cp.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS total_activities, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.mw_freebase) AS min_mw, MAX(cp.alogp) AS max_alogp, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS synonyms_list, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT td.pref_name, '; ') AS target_names, SUM(CASE WHEN at.assay_type = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS type_b_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.standard_value) AS median_standard_value FROM compound_properties cp JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN activities a ON cp.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON ass.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assay2target a2t ON ass.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE ( (cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 456.69 AND 515.89 AND cp.alogp >= 0.43) OR (cp.hba >= 3.45 AND cp.hbd <= 0.34 AND cp.num_ro5_violations < 0.2) ) AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2012.19 AND 2020.88 AND (td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' OR a2t.assay_organism = 'Human') AND NOT (tc.l1 = 'Enzyme' AND tc.l2 = 'Protease') AND a.standard_flag = 1 GROUP BY cp.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 69.58 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 651.46 AND MIN(cp.mw_freebase) >= 287.14 ORDER BY total_activities DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 995.53;

SELECT t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_potency, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_potency FROM target_dictionary t JOIN assay2target a2t ON t.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a ON a2t.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compounds c ON act.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE d.year::integer BETWEEN 2018 AND 2012 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_units = 'nM' AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN '200' AND '200' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 GROUP BY t.tid, t.pref_name, t.organism HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 25 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC, avg_potency ASC LIMIT 85;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1 AS target_class_l1, tc.l2 AS target_class_l2, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(act.standard_value) FILTER (WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) DESC) AS activity_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS dense_rank_by_class FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE act.standard_value >= 609609.76 AND act.standard_value <= 380328.7 AND cp.alogp >= -2.41 AND cp.alogp <= -2.31 AND cp.hba >= 12.17 AND cp.hba <= 23.19 AND d.year >= '1900' AND d.year <= '1900' AND a2t.confidence >= 6.05 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 657.26 AND AVG(act.standard_value) <= 467438.86 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno AND cs.synonyms IS NOT NULL) AS synonym_count, (SELECT MIN(d.year) FROM docs d WHERE d.doc_id IN (SELECT cr.doc_id FROM compound_records cr WHERE cr.molregno = c.molregno)) AS earliest_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.l1 ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_class FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON at.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value > 16976.57 AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 2 AND d.year::INTEGER BETWEEN 2011 AND 1964 AND cl.confidence >= 5 AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) > 34 AND AVG(act.standard_value) < 61755.61 ORDER BY avg_activity DESC, rank_by_class LIMIT 647;

SELECT c.molregno, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, AVG(ac.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(cp.alogp) AS min_alogp, MAX(cp.mw_freebase) AS max_mw FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities ac ON c.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN assays a ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.alogp > 8.96 AND d.year::integer >= 2007 GROUP BY c.molregno HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) > 31 AND AVG(ac.standard_value) < 570.94 ORDER BY assay_count DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, tc.l1 AS target_class FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities act ON c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON (SELECT confidence FROM assay2target WHERE assay_id = a.assay_id ORDER BY confidence DESC LIMIT 1) = cl.confidence JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE act.standard_value >= 93784.35 AND act.standard_value <= 5426.24 AND cp.alogp >= -2.69 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = c.molregno) > 4 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, a.assay_id, a.assay_type, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, cl.confidence_summary, td.pref_name, tc.l1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 4 ORDER BY act.standard_value DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) AS activity_count, COUNT(DISTINCT syn.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT doc.pubmed_id) AS pubmed_count, MAX(act.published_value) AS max_published_value, MIN(act.published_value) AS min_published_value, SUM(CASE WHEN act.standard_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_flag_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.assay_type ORDER BY AVG(act.standard_value) DESC) AS rank_by_assay FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON c.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN activities act ON cr.record_id = act.record_id AND c.molregno = act.molregno JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN docs doc ON a.doc_id = doc.doc_id AND cr.doc_id = doc.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms syn ON c.molregno = syn.molregno LEFT JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > '0' AND cp.num_ro5_violations <= 3 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN '-5' AND '0' AND doc.year::INTEGER >= 2018 AND a2t.confidence >= 6 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.num_ro5_violations, a.assay_type, at.assay_desc, td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2 HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) > '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT act.activity_id) >= 12 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH ranked_activities AS ( SELECT a.molregno, a.assay_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, td.pref_name, td.organism, tc.l1, tc.l2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molregno ORDER BY a.standard_value DESC) AS rn FROM activities a JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 98320.08 AND a2t.confidence >= 5 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 179.18 AND 738.05 ) SELECT molregno, pref_name, organism, l1, l2, COUNT(*) AS activity_count, AVG(standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(standard_value) AS max_standard_value, CASE WHEN ro3_pass = 'Y' AND med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 'High Quality' WHEN ro3_pass = 'Y' OR med_chem_friendly = 'Y' THEN 'Medium Quality' ELSE 'Low Quality' END AS compound_quality, CASE WHEN mw_freebase < 300 THEN 'Small' WHEN mw_freebase BETWEEN 300 AND 500 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS molecular_size_category FROM ranked_activities WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY molregno, pref_name, organism, l1, l2, ro3_pass, med_chem_friendly, mw_freebase HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 AND AVG(standard_value) < 43666.76 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH compound_activity_summary AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.ro3_pass, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(CASE WHEN a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 THEN a.standard_value END) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(CASE WHEN a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 THEN a.standard_value END) AS min_standard_value, MAX(CASE WHEN a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_flag = 1 THEN a.standard_value END) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT at2.tid) AS target_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tc.l1, '; ') AS target_classes FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno LEFT JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno LEFT JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id LEFT JOIN assay2target at2 ON ass.assay_id = at2.assay_id LEFT JOIN target_class tc ON at2.tid = tc.tid WHERE cp.hba BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND cp.hbd BETWEEN 4 AND 3 AND c.molweight BETWEEN '100.0' AND '300.0' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.ro3_pass ) SELECT cas.molregno, cas.molweight, cas.mw_freebase, cas.alogp, cas.hba, cas.hbd, cas.ro3_pass, cas.assay_count, cas.activity_count, cas.avg_standard_value, cas.min_standard_value, cas.max_standard_value, cas.target_count, cas.target_classes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compound_synonyms cs WHERE cs.molregno = cas.molregno AND LENGTH(cs.synonyms) > 35) AS synonym_count FROM compound_activity_summary cas WHERE cas.assay_count >= 1 AND cas.activity_count >= 11 AND cas.target_count >= 1 AND cas.avg_standard_value BETWEEN '0.1' AND '1.0' ORDER BY cas.avg_standard_value DESC, cas.activity_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT td.pref_name AS target_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) AS compound_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_activity FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assay2target at ON td.tid = at.tid JOIN assays asy ON at.assay_id = asy.assay_id JOIN activities a ON asy.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compounds c ON a.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value > 91762.95 AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 573.31 AND 714.19 AND td.tid IN ( SELECT tid FROM target_class WHERE l1 = 'Enzyme' ) GROUP BY td.pref_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molregno) > 12 ORDER BY compound_count DESC, avg_activity ASC;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON at.tid = td.tid WHERE act.standard_value > 66939.54 AND a.assay_type = 'A' GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) > 100 ORDER BY avg_standard_value DESC LIMIT 100;

a.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN assay2target a2t ON a.assay_id = a2t.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = COUNT(DISTINCT a2t.tid) >= 5 ORDER BY avg_standard_value ASC, activity_count DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT a.assay_id, a.assay_type, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(act.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(act.standard_value) AS max_standard_value FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id WHERE act.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND act.standard_value > 854056.37 AND a.assay_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT a2t.assay_id FROM assay2target a2t JOIN target_dictionary td ON a2t.tid = td.tid WHERE td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' ) GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.assay_type HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < 2512.59 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC;

SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(cp.mw_freebase) AS avg_mw_freebase, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN docs d ON s.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND d.year::integer >= 1992 AND d.year::integer <= 2015 AND cp.mw_freebase > '200' GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 35 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < '10' ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_compounds AS ( SELECT c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS assay_count FROM compounds c JOIN compound_properties cp ON c.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN activities a ON c.molregno = a.molregno WHERE cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 618.26 AND 612.29 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN 4.99 AND 0.82 AND a.standard_value > 794989.85 GROUP BY c.molregno, c.molweight, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) >= 30 ), activity_summary AS ( SELECT fc.molregno, fc.molweight, fc.mw_freebase, fc.alogp, fc.hba, fc.hbd, fc.assay_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_activity, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_activity, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT a.assay_id) AS unique_assays, COUNT(DISTINCT a.doc_id) AS unique_docs FROM filtered_compounds fc JOIN activities a ON fc.molregno = a.molregno WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' GROUP BY fc.molregno, fc.molweight, fc.mw_freebase, fc.alogp, fc.hba, fc.hbd, fc.assay_count ) SELECT asum.molregno, asum.molweight, asum.mw_freebase, asum.alogp, asum.hba, asum.hbd, asum.assay_count, asum.avg_activity, asum.min_activity, asum.max_activity, asum.unique_assays, asum.unique_docs, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cs.synonyms, '; ') AS all_synonyms FROM activity_summary asum LEFT JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON asum.molregno = cs.molregno GROUP BY asum.molregno, asum.molweight, asum.mw_freebase, asum.alogp, asum.hba, asum.hbd, asum.assay_count, asum.avg_activity, asum.min_activity, asum.max_activity, asum.unique_assays, asum.unique_docs ORDER BY asum.avg_activity DESC LIMIT 609;

SELECT a.assay_id, t.pref_name, COUNT(DISTINCT act.molregno) AS unique_compounds, AVG(act.standard_value) AS avg_potency FROM assays a JOIN assay2target at ON a.assay_id = at.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON at.tid = t.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(d.year || '-01-01' AS DATE)) BETWEEN 2002 AND 1991 AND act.standard_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.assay_id, t.pref_name HAVING AVG(act.standard_value) < 76.82 ORDER BY unique_compounds DESC;

SELECT td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, a2t.assay_organism, at.assay_desc, cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly, COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) AS activity_count, AVG(a.standard_value) AS avg_standard_value, MIN(a.standard_value) AS min_standard_value, MAX(a.standard_value) AS max_standard_value, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) AS synonym_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_id) AS doc_count FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_class tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN assay2target a2t ON td.tid = a2t.tid JOIN assays a_s ON a2t.assay_id = a_s.assay_id JOIN assay_type at ON a_s.assay_type = at.assay_type JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_properties cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno JOIN compounds c ON cp.molregno = c.molregno JOIN compound_synonyms cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON cp.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN confidence_lookup cl ON a2t.confidence = cl.confidence LEFT JOIN target_protein tp ON td.protein_accession = tp.protein_accession WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cp.mw_freebase BETWEEN 720.28 AND 706.21 AND cp.alogp BETWEEN -0.55 AND -4.69 AND cp.hba BETWEEN 16.36 AND 8.5 AND cp.hbd BETWEEN 6.7 AND 1.28 AND a_s.assay_type IN ('A', 'A', 'A') AND d.year BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY td.pref_name, tc.l1, tc.l2, a2t.assay_organism, at.assay_desc, cp.molregno, cp.mw_freebase, cp.alogp, cp.hba, cp.hbd, cp.psa, cp.rtb, cp.num_ro5_violations, cp.ro3_pass, cp.med_chem_friendly HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) > 58.47 AND AVG(a.standard_value) < 3632.88 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cs.synonyms) >= 35.21 ORDER BY activity_count DESC, avg_standard_value ASC LIMIT 1000;
